jobs.title: Stage Office Management (mbo/hbo)
jobs.description:
Een kerstviering organiseren waar collega's nog lang over napraten? Een externe bijeenkomst tot in de puntjes regelen? Of zorgen dat alles op kantoor lekker loopt?

Bij Zibber krijg je de kans om het allemaal te doen. We zoeken een enthousiaste stagiair Office Management die energie krijgt van organiseren, regelen en dingen voor elkaar krijgen.

Geen stage waarin je alleen maar meekijkt. Hier doe je écht mee!

Over Zibber

Met zo'n 240 collega's in Nederland, België en Duitsland zijn we marktleider in vastgoedmedia. Met fotografie, video en slimme technologie helpen we makelaars om woningen perfect te presenteren.

Op ons hoofdkantoor in Eindhoven werken zo'n 60 collega's samen. De sfeer? Informeel, energiek en altijd in beweging. We werken hard, lachen veel en houden van mensen die initiatief nemen.

De rol

Binnen de stage Office Management werk je nauw samen met onze Executive Assistant en helpt bij alles wat ons kantoor en onze interne projecten nét wat beter maakt.

Denk aan:

  • Het organiseren van Zibber-events, borrels en teamactiviteiten.

  • Het regelen van offsites en externe bijeenkomsten, van locatie tot catering.

  • Zorgen dat alles op kantoor soepel verloopt.

  • Contact met leveranciers en het oppakken van praktische verzoeken.

  • Meewerken aan leuke interne projecten en verbeterideeën.

En zie jij iets dat slimmer, leuker of makkelijker kan? Laat van je horen!

Wat je van ons krijgt

  • Een afwisselende stage waarin je écht iets kunt bijdragen.

  • Ruimte om zelfstandig dingen op te pakken en eigen ideeën uit te voeren.

  • Persoonlijke begeleiding van onze Executive Assistant.

  • De kans om veel te leren over office management, events en projectmatig werken.

  • Een werkplek op ons gezellige hoofdkantoor in Eindhoven.

  • Korte lijnen, enthousiaste collega's en volop Zibber-events, lunches en gezelligheid.

  • Een stagevergoeding van €450,- bruto per maand bij een fulltime stage.

  • Bij een fulltime stage in principe vier dagen meewerken en één dag ruimte voor school.

  • Starten in januari of februari 2027!


Je volgt een mbo 4- of hbo-opleiding en zoekt een meewerkstage.

Verder vinden we vooral belangrijk dat je:

  • Positieve energie meebrengt en graag de handen uit de mouwen steekt.

  • Zelf initiatief neemt en niet afwacht.

  • Makkelijk communiceert en vragen durft te stellen.

  • Houdt van organiseren en overzicht bewaren.

  • Goed Nederlands spreekt en schrijft.

Ervaring? Mooi meegenomen. De juiste instelling? Veel belangrijker!

Klinkt dit als jouw stage?

Ben jij iemand die liever zegt 'Ik regel het!' dan 'Wie gaat dat doen?'?

Dan pas je waarschijnlijk perfect bij Zibber. Solliciteer en laat ons weten waarom jij graag dingen voor elkaar krijgt. We maken graag kennis met je!

jobs.title: Senior Medewerker Finance & Accounting
jobs.description:
Krijg jij energie van een financiële administratie die tot in de puntjes klopt? Heb je ruime ervaring met boekhouding en houd je graag overzicht over financiële processen? Bij Normec Foodcare zoeken we een ervaren Senior Medewerker Finance & Accounting die zelfstandig de financiële administratie beheert, afwijkingen signaleert en bijdraagt aan een correcte maand- en jaarafsluiting.

Jouw rol

Als Boekhoudkundig Medewerker ben je verantwoordelijk voor een correcte en tijdige verwerking van de financiële administratie. Je houdt je bezig met debiteuren, crediteuren, cashmanagement en grootboekcontroles. Daarnaast bereid je de maand- en jaarafsluiting voor en werk je nauw samen met de Financial Controller en andere collega's binnen Finance. Je maakt deel uit van een Finance-team van zeven collega's en rapporteert rechtstreeks aan Patricia Pouw, Finance Manager.

Jouw verantwoordelijkheden zijn verder:

  • Debiteuren- en crediteurenbeheer: Je beheert de openstaande posten, verwerkt ontvangsten en inkoopfacturen en onderhoudt contact met klanten en leveranciers over betalingen en factuurverschillen.

  • Cashmanagement: Je verwerkt bankmutaties, bewaakt de geldstromen en bereidt betalingen voor. Ook ondersteun je bij de liquiditeitsplanning.

  • Voorbereiden van de maand- en jaarafsluiting: Je zorgt dat de administratie volledig en tijdig is bijgewerkt. Je bereidt boekingen, reserveringen en balansspecificaties voor en ondersteunt bij de jaarafsluiting en accountantscontrole.

  • Grootboek en financiële controles: Je controleert grootboekrekeningen en financiële aansluitingen, onderzoekt afwijkingen en bereidt correcties voor.

  • Aanvullende administratie: Je houdt je bezig met intercompany-afstemmingen, vaste activa en de voorbereiding van btw-aangiften.

  • Procesverbetering: Je signaleert knelpunten, doet verbetervoorstellen en helpt de kwaliteit en efficiëntie van de financiële administratie verder te verbeteren.

Daarnaast ben je een inhoudelijk aanspreekpunt voor collega's bij complexere boekhoudkundige vraagstukken en ondersteun je hen met jouw kennis en ervaring.

Ons aanbod

Een afwisselende functie bij Normec Foodcare, met ruimte om zelfstandig te werken, mee te denken en jezelf verder te ontwikkelen. Je komt terecht in een betrokken team waarin samenwerking centraal staat. Wat je verder mag verwachten:

  • Een jaarcontract met uitzicht op een vast dienstverband

  • Een salaris tussen € 4.000 en € 4.500 bruto per maand op basis van een fulltime dienstverband, afhankelijk van jouw ervaring

  • Een dienstverband van bij voorkeur 40 uur per week. Een dienstverband van 32 uur per week is ook bespreekbaar

  • Hybride werken en flexibele werktijden: je kunt je werkdag indelen tussen 07.00 en 19.00 uur

  • 25 vakantiedagen en 8% vakantietoeslag

  • De mogelijkheid om extra vakantiedagen te kopen

  • Een goede pensioenregeling

  • Een reiskostenvergoeding

  • De mogelijkheid om deel te nemen aan het fietsplan

  • Een continu ontwikkelprogramma waarin je wordt gestimuleerd om je talenten verder te ontwikkelen

  • Een collectieve ziektekostenverzekering bij VGZ

  • Een actieve personeelsvereniging die het hele jaar door diverse leuke activiteiten organiseert

Jouw profiel

Je bent een positief kritisch ingestelde en betrokken professional, die graag meedenkt en bouwt aan onze Finance-afdeling.

Daarnaast beschik je over:

  • Mbo+/hbo werk- en denkniveau in een financiële of boekhoudkundige richting

  • Minimaal 3 jaar relevante werkervaring als Boekhouder, Financieel Administratief Medewerker of in een vergelijkbare financiële functie

  • Ruime ervaring met zelfstandig boekhouden, debiteuren- en crediteurenbeheer en het voorbereiden van maandafsluitingen

  • Een goed begrip van grootboekadministratie, balansposten, btw en de samenhang tussen boekingen en financiële rapportages

  • Goede vaardigheden in Excel en ervaring met een ERP-systeem. Kennis van Exact Online of Business Central is een pré

  • Je hebt een goede beheersing van de Engelse taal, zowel mondeling als schriftelijk

  • Een nauwkeurige, gestructureerde en proactieve werkwijze. Je voert niet alleen werkzaamheden uit, maar onderzoekt ook zelfstandig afwijkingen en denkt mee over oplossingen

  • Goede communicatieve vaardigheden en het vermogen om prettig samen te werken met klanten, leveranciers en collega's. Je deelt graag je kennis en ondersteunt anderen waar nodig

  • Je bent bij voorkeur 40 uur per week beschikbaar

Over Normec

Normec Foodlab Ede is onderdeel van Normec, toonaangevend in de Testen, Inspectie, Certificering en Compliance (TICC) industrie. Onze expertise raakt essentiële gebieden zoals water-, lucht- en bodemkwaliteit, brandveiligheid en voedselveiligheid, waarbij we de hoogste normen van kwaliteit en veiligheid garanderen in verschillende sectoren. Normec is opgericht in 2016 en is een ambitieuze, onafhankelijke en snelgroeiende organisatie.

We bieden onze collega’s de kans om actief bij te dragen aan onze missie én tegelijkertijd hun eigen carrière te ontwikkelen binnen een dynamische en snelgroeiende organisatie. Samen werken we aan impactvolle oplossingen voor onze klanten en aan een duurzame toekomst. De cultuur binnen Normec is informeel, open, energiek en ondernemend en is verankerd in onze GROWTH-principes. Middels ons The Normec Fit-programma, waarmee de deze principes tot leven brengen, zorgen we ervoor dat niet alleen ons bedrijf groeit, maar ook iedereen die er deel van uitmaakt.

Interesse? Laten we kennismaken!

Ben je geïnteresseerd in deze vacature? Dan kijken we uit naar jouw sollicitatie! We behandelen jouw gegevens vertrouwelijk en zorgen ervoor dat je binnen vijf werkdagen een reactie van ons ontvangt.  Voor vragen over deze vacature kun je contact opnemen met team Recruitment, via . Zij helpen je graag verder.

De procedure:

  • Eerste telefonische screening en verdere bespreking van de vacature

  • Persoonlijk gesprek bij Normec

  • Referentiecheck (na jouw goedkeuring)/ assessment

  • Tweede gesprek/bespreken arbeidsvoorwaarden bij Normec

  • Gefeliciteerd, je hebt je nieuwe uitdaging gevonden

 Op zoek naar een nieuwe uitdaging binnen de voedingsmiddelenindustrie, maar is deze functie niet helemaal wat je zoekt? Volg Careers at Normec Foodcare op LinkedIn en blijf op de hoogte van al onze vacatures.

Ongevraagde acquisitie door bureaus wordt niet op prijs gesteld en zal niet worden beantwoord.

jobs.title: Stage: Optimalisatie Processen Industry
jobs.description:
Over Nedlin

Nedlin is een industriële textielverzorger voor Healthcare, Hospitality en Industry, waar veiligheid, kwaliteit, continu verbeteren en verantwoord ondernemen centraal staan. Als groeiend B-Corp familiebedrijf investeren we graag in jong talent en versterken we de verbinding tussen onderwijs en arbeidsmarkt. Daarom bieden we studenten de kans om praktijkervaring op te doen, zich te ontwikkelen en Nedlin te leren kennen, met waar mogelijk mooie doorgroeikansen na het afstuderen.

De stageopdrachten

Tijdens deze stage binnen Nedlin Industry ga je aan de slag met een actueel vraagstuk uit onze dagelijkse operatie. Je onderzoekt waar verbeterkansen liggen, brengt processen en knelpunten in kaart en werkt jouw bevindingen uit tot concrete verbetervoorstellen.

Afhankelijk van jouw interesse kun je kiezen uit één van de volgende stageopdrachten:

  1. Klantcompleetheid verbeteren
    Onderzoek waar en waarom klantorders niet volledig worden geleverd, breng knelpunten binnen productie en expeditie in kaart en werk concrete verbeteringen.

  2. Transportkosten reduceren
    Analyseer transportkosten en routes, onderzoek de beladingsgraad en leverfrequenties en breng mogelijke kostenbesparingen in kaart.

  3. Doorlooptijden magazijn verbeteren
    Breng de magazijnprocessen in kaart, identificeer wachttijden en onnodige handelingen en werk verbeteringen uit om de doorlooptijd te verkorten.

  4. Gebruik van AI binnen de organisatie
    Onderzoek de mogelijkheden voor AI binnen de organisatie, bepaal kansrijke toepassingen voor de dagelijkse operatie en werk deze concreet uit.

  5. Werkinstructies vouwers en inpak verbeteren
    Beoordeel de huidige werkinstructies en onderzoek hoe deze eenvoudiger, duidelijker en visueler kunnen worden gemaakt voor medewerkers.

Wat bieden wij?

  • Stagevergoeding:

    • € 300,- bruto per maand voor mbo-studenten (op basis van 40 uur per week);

    • € 400,- bruto per maand voor hbo-studenten (op basis van 40 uur per week);

  • Een leerzame stage binnen één van de modernste en duurzaamste wasserijen van Europa;

  • Ruimte en begeleiding om te werken aan jouw (afstudeer)opdracht;

  • Persoonlijke begeleiding en korte lijnen;

  • Een familiaire en positieve sfeer: samen feestdagen vieren, een jaarlijkse familiedag en leuke uitjes;

  • Kans op een (bij)baan bij Nedlin na afronding van je stage, bij wederzijdse match.


Wie ben jij?

  • Je volgt een hbo-opleiding of een mbo-4-opleiding en kunt aantoonbaar zelfstandig werken.

  • Je studeert bijvoorbeeld Technische Bedrijfskunde, Operations Management, Kwaliteitsmanagement, Human Factors, Communicatie of een vergelijkbare richting.

  • Je bent analytisch en oplettend, schrijft helder en kunt informatie eenvoudig en visueel overbrengen.

  • Je werkt zorgvuldig en zelfstandig en legt gemakkelijk contact met collega’s op de werkvloer.

  • Je zoekt een onderzoeks- en implementatiestage, waarbij gedeeltelijk meewerken in de praktijk mogelijk is..

Pak het moment

Wil jij tijdens je stage niet alleen werken aan een interessante opdracht, maar vooral ook leren, ervaring opdoen en jezelf ontwikkelen? Bij Nedlin krijg je de ruimte om jouw kennis vanuit je opleiding toe te passen in de praktijk, mee te kijken binnen onze organisatie en samen te werken met ervaren collega’s. jobs.title: Werkstudent Medisch Acceptatie
jobs.description:
Over ons

Europa verandert. Steeds meer mensen kiezen voor vrijheid — als zzp'er, freelancer of ondernemer. Ze bepalen zelf wanneer, hoe en met wie ze werken. Maar die vrijheid komt met een keerzijde: onzekerheid.

Bij Insify geloven we dat ondernemers zich geen zorgen moeten maken over verzekeringen. Daarom bouwen we iets wat de verzekeringswereld hard nodig heeft: transparante, eerlijke en volledig digitale verzekeringen, speciaal voor mensen die voor zichzelf werken. Geen ingewikkeld papierwerk, geen gedoe. Vandaag geregeld, morgen verzekerd.

We verzekeren inmiddels duizenden klanten in heel Europa — en we zijn nog maar net begonnen.


Het Operations Team

Wij zijn het gezicht van Insify. Bij elk telefoontje, elke e-mail en elk gesprek bouwen we vertrouwen op. We zorgen ervoor dat klanten zich gehoord, gesteund en goed geholpen voelen — ook als het ingewikkeld wordt. Snelheid en kwaliteit gaan bij ons hand in hand, en we verbeteren continu op basis van wat we leren. Met een groeiend medisch acceptatieteam en uitbreiding naar meerdere Europese landen, speel jij een directe rol in iets wat echt impact maakt.


Jouw rol

Als Medisch Acceptatie Werkstudent ben jij het eerste aanspreekpunt voor onze klanten in een van de meest persoonlijke momenten van hun ondernemerschap. Je werkt nauw samen met medische specialisten en zorgt ervoor dat aanvragen soepel, nauwkeurig en klantgericht verlopen. Dit is geen standaard bijbaan — je draait mee in een snel groeiend team waar jouw bijdrage echt telt.


Wat ga je doen
  • Klantcontact. Je beantwoordt vragen via telefoon, e-mail en chat. Je legt complexe verzekeringspolissen en medische beslissingen uit op een manier die klanten écht begrijpen.
  • Gegevensbeheer. Je vraagt medische dossiers op bij huisartsen en specialisten, controleert de volledigheid en verwerkt alles nauwkeurig in ons systeem.
  • Samenwerken met specialisten. Je fungeert als schakel tussen de klant en de medisch specialist — je vat informatie samen, signaleert complexe vraagstukken en houdt de communicatie helder.
  • Administratie. Je houdt klantgegevens up-to-date, verwerkt poliswijzigingen en bewaakt deadlines.

    • Wat je meebrengt
  • Je studeert momenteel, bij voorkeur in een richting met raakvlakken aan zorg, communicatie of bedrijfskunde.
  • Je bent beschikbaar voor 24 tot 32 uur per week.
  • Je Nederlands is uitstekend — zowel mondeling als schriftelijk. Dit is een harde eis, omdat je dagelijks contact hebt met Nederlandstalige klanten.
  • Je bent georganiseerd, schakelt makkelijk tussen taken en verliest deadlines nooit uit het oog.
  • Je hebt een oprechte klantgerichte instelling — je vindt het fijn om mensen echt te helpen, ook als het niet makkelijk is.
  • Je bent bereid het WFT-examen te halen als onderdeel van je professionele ontwikkeling. Wij betalen het en begeleiden je erdoorheen.

    • Wat wij bieden
  • 💰 Marktconforme vergoeding — we betalen goed, omdat we de besten willen aantrekken.
  • 🏖️ 25 vakantiedagen — plus een extra vrije dag op kerstavond als het een werkdag is.
  • 🏠 Hybride werken — twee dagen per week thuiswerken als je eenmaal ingewerkt bent.
  • 🚆 Reiskostenvergoeding — we helpen je met je woon-werkverkeer.
  • 🎯 €50 netto per maand via Alleo — op te sparen en te besteden aan wat jij wilt, van sportschool tot UberEats.

jobs.title: Insurance Product Manager / Underwriter (P&C)
jobs.description:
Most insurance product roles ask you to perfect one product in one market. This one asks you to build Europe’s SME insurance products: decide what we cover and who we insure, negotiate it with our carriers and get it live, market after market.

Deep in the wording. Fast in the build.

About Insify

Insurance for entrepreneurs is still built the old way: one market at a time, wordings nobody reads, and cover that leaves out the very businesses that need it most.

We're doing it differently.

Insify is a high-growth scale-up backed by €43M in total funding from world-class investors like Accel, Munich Re Ventures, and Formula 1 champion Nico Rosberg. In five years, we've expanded from the Netherlands into France, Germany and Ireland, and we're just getting started. Our mission: become the European leader in AI-powered SME insurance.

We aren't just building a company; we're leading a revolution. Our culture is intense, high-stakes, and mission-driven. We hire smart, ambitious "owners" who possess a relentless drive to win. This is an environment for those who thrive on challenges, value intellectual honesty, and share our mindset of becoming a global category leader.

Our founding team consists of seasoned entrepreneurs who have previously built iconic businesses like HelloFresh, Bloomon, and SumUp. We bring that same bias for speed, scale, and high standards to one of the most structurally broken experiences in financial services. Together, we combine that deep fintech and e-commerce expertise with cutting-edge AI to stay ahead of the curve.


What you’ll own in your first year

You won’t inherit a finished product shelf. You’ll build the engine that fills it.

  1. Build the product engine. Turn how we benchmark a market into a system: compare cover, limits and exclusions across local players, our Dutch home product and our other markets, so every new product starts from facts, not gut feeling.
  2. Make the call on cover. Decide what we cover, what we don’t and who we insure, and turn it into a proposal. The tools do the comparison; the judgment is yours.
  3. Get it signed. Take the proposal to our risk carriers and negotiate it. You know what to push on, what to let go and which clause will set off six red flags.
  4. Get it live. Adapt our wordings to each new market, run the legal review and launch. Less writing from scratch, more making one strong product fit the next market. Then track loss ratios, competition and customer feedback, and sharpen it.
  5. Build what doesn’t exist yet. In the markets where we double down, own custom products from the insurance side, including cover for the trades and businesses others decline.

Who you are

You’re an insurance expert first and a builder second, but a real one.

  • You have 5+ years hands-on in commercial P&C (Property & Casualty) at an insurer, MGA, (re)insurer or specialist broker, across underwriting, product and wordings, ideally for SMEs.
  • You know what is covered, what isn’t and what should be. Hand you a wording from a market you’ve never worked in and you’ll spot the gaps within minutes.
  • You’ve worked across more than one line, product or market, and you can apply what you know to a market you’ve never seen.
  • You’ve sat at the table with insurers or capacity providers and know where the red lines are.
  • You’d rather fix insurance than complain about it. Maybe you already tried: at an insurtech, an MGA, your own startup, or on the carrier side building products with insurtechs.
  • You think like the customer: plain questions, fair cover, and no excluding everything just to be safe.
  • You’re at home in Excel and data, and curious about what automation and LLMs can take off your plate. You don’t need to code; our product and tech teams build the digital journey with you.
  • You work fluently in English; German, French or Dutch is a big plus.

    • What we offer
  • Real ownership. You decide what we cover and work directly with the MT, close to where decisions get made.
  • Range. More products and markets in a year than most people see in a decade at an incumbent.
  • A share in what we build. Equity, so you share in the value you build.
  • A team that cares. We live by four values: Grit, Care, Impact and Entrepreneurship.
  • Growth. Room to grow into leading our insurance product work as we add markets, plus an in-house coaching and leadership program.
  • The package. Competitive salary package + 6% pension, holidays, well-being budget and rich social events (ski trip, summer and winter party).
  • The basics, done well. Office in central Amsterdam, laptop, hybrid working. Relocation support.

    • If you know insurance inside out and you’d rather build products than maintain them, we’d like to meet you. No cover letter needed.

jobs.title: Senior Security Operations Engineer
jobs.description:
Who we are

Samsara (NYSE: IOT) is the pioneer of the Connected Operations™ Cloud, which is a platform that enables organizations that depend on physical operations to harness Internet of Things (IoT) data to develop actionable insights and improve their operations. At Samsara, we are helping improve the safety, efficiency and sustainability of the physical operations that power our global economy. Representing more than 40% of global GDP, these industries are the infrastructure of our planet, including agriculture, construction, field services, transportation, and manufacturing — and we are excited to help digitally transform their operations at scale.

Working at Samsara means you'll help define the future of physical operations and be on a team that's shaping an exciting array of product solutions, including Video-Based Safety, Vehicle Telematics, Apps and Driver Workflows, and Equipment Monitoring. As part of a recently public company, you'll have the autonomy and support to make an impact as we build for the long term.

About the role:

As a member of our Security Operations Team, you will collaborate with a global team of engineers to monitor and respond to security events, lead security incidents as Incident Commander, and lead digital forensic investigations in support of Employee Relations, Legal, Compliance, or Information Security cases.

Although you will be focused on security incident response, you will also have the opportunity to create and maintain runbooks, and automated workflows, and assist in process refinement and implementation. You will collaborate with a diverse team of engineers, and key stakeholders on security initiatives across the company. Above all, your focus is bringing Security expertise to the table in a collaborative, humble, and practical manner.

Location: This role is open to candidates residing in the UK

You should apply if:

  • You want to impact the industries that run our world: Every phone call you answer and every email you send can affect whether truck drivers deliver goods on time and without accidents, whether students get dropped off safely from school, or whether power gets restored quickly after a natural disaster.
  • You thrive the most when solving problems: Our constantly expanding technology and the complexities faced by our customers provide an exciting range of challenges for our Customer Success teams. With a growth mindset and a desire to learn, you will strategically partner with our customers to find unique solutions to help keep their operations safe, efficient, and sustainable.
  • You are a natural relationship builder: Whether the relationship is with our customers or with cross-functional teams in Samsara, you are in constant communication and collaboration with key stakeholders to win as a team.
  • You are the architect of your own career: If you put in the work, this role won't be your last at Samsara. This Customer Success team is still shaping its future and you will have plenty of autonomy and opportunities to master your craft in a hyper growth environment.
  • You want to be with the best: At Samsara, we win together, celebrate together and support each other. You will be surrounded by the best and brightest professionals out there.

In this role, you will: 

  • Monitor security events and provide technical analysis on alerts
  • Lead information security incidents and employee insider investigations by developing the incident response strategy, lead the execution through incident closure, while providing incident updates to key stakeholders throughout the incident
  • Deliver security guidance clearly and concisely for incident response and insider threat initiatives
  • Coordinate the building of services, capabilities, integrations, and implementations of technologies to support security operations, incident response, and insider threat
  • Champion, role model, and embed Samsara's cultural principles (Focus on Customer Success, Build for the Long Term, Adopt a Growth Mindset, Be Inclusive, Win as a Team) as we scale globally and across new offices
  • Participate in our on-call rota covering weekends

Minimum requirements for the role:

  • 5+ years of experience in Security Incident Response
  • Ability to communicate investigative findings and strategies to technical staff, executive leadership, and legal
  • Ability to build scripts or tools to support Samsara's investigation processes, with proficiency in Python
  • Mentor and train security operation engineers on data collection, analysis, and reporting technical analysis
  • Practical experience acting as a lead during security incident response, including monitoring and triaging alerts, and coordinating across teams
  • Understanding of analysis and forensics techniques on macOS, Windows, and Linux
  • Experience utilizing SIEM tools to perform log reviews
  • Experience in cloud architecture and security (AWS, GCP) and cloud-based services
  • Participation in an on-call rotation, with the potential to work outside standard business hours, including late evenings, when responding to high-severity incidents as part of our global incident response team.
  • This role will be part of our EMEA so your hours will be aligned to the UK. As an operational time you may be expected to work flexible hours around this to support the load of the team

An ideal candidate also has:

  • 2+ years of experience working on insider threat initiatives or employee investigations
  • Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Information Security, or a related field - or relevant industry experience
  • GIAC Certified Incident Handler (GCIH) or similar Certification
  • Familiarity with common security frameworks and standards, including NIST Cybersecurity Framework, ISO 27001, FedRAMP

Total Rewards

At Samsara, we build for the people who keep the global economy moving. We want owners, not passengers, which is why our rewards are designed to fuel high-impact builders. Our compensation program delivers above-market total compensation through a combination of base salary, performance-based bonus/variable pay, and equity (for eligible roles) in a high-growth public company. We meaningfully differentiate pay for our top performers, who have the opportunity to earn above-market compensation that can outpace the broader market over time.

Beyond compensation, we provide the foundations that enable long-term success: a flexible, employee-led remote model, a professional development stipend, comprehensive health and parental leave plans, and more. If you're ready to build for the long term and own the outcome, your journey starts here.

Flexible Working 

At Samsara, we embrace a flexible working model that caters to the diverse needs of our teams. Our offices are open for those who prefer to work in-person and we also support remote work where it aligns with our operational requirements. For certain positions, being close to one of our offices or within a specific geographic area is important to facilitate collaboration, access to resources, or alignment with our service regions. In these cases, the job description will clearly indicate any working location requirements. Our goal is to ensure that all members of our team can contribute effectively, whether they are working on-site, in a hybrid model, or fully remotely. All offers of employment are contingent upon an individual's ability to secure and maintain the legal right to work at the company and in the specified work location, if applicable.

Belonging at Samsara

At Samsara, we welcome everyone regardless of their background. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, sex, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, protected veteran status, disability, age, and other characteristics protected by law. We depend on the unique approaches of our team members to help us solve complex problems and want to ensure that Samsara is a place where people from all backgrounds can make an impact.

Accommodations 

Samsara is an inclusive work environment, and we are committed to ensuring equal opportunity in employment for qualified persons with disabilities. Please email click here if you require any reasonable accommodations throughout the recruiting process.

Our Commitment to Authenticity

We use Tofu, a fraud detection tool, to validate the authenticity of applications and protect against identity fraud. This ensures we are connecting with real people and allows us to prioritize genuine candidates. Please see Samsara's Candidate Privacy Notice for more information.

Fraudulent Employment Offers

Samsara is aware of scams involving fake job interviews and offers. Please know we do not charge fees to applicants at any stage of the hiring process. Official communication about your application will only come from emails ending in ----- ----- or ----- For more information regarding fraudulent employment offers, please visit our blog post here.

jobs.title: Senior Business Controller (Operations)
jobs.description:
Would you like to work closely with the business as a Senior Business Controller and use your financial expertise to make a real impact on decisions? You will bring financial structure and insight, while keeping a forward-looking perspective: where can we improve, which decisions will make a financial difference, and what will they mean for our results?

HG is a compact, international organisation. This means considerable responsibility, direct contact with decision-makers and room to drive change yourself. We are therefore looking for someone who takes ownership, works pragmatically and is not afraid to challenge existing ways of working.

You will be based at our head office in Almere. Hybrid working opportunities are limited: regular office attendance is important in this role because of the close collaboration with Finance, Operations and other stakeholders. You will also travel to the United Kingdom or Germany several times a year.

About the role

As Senior Business Controller, you will be responsible for business control within Operations and will also support our subsidiaries in the United Kingdom and Germany. You have a clear vision of what the best operational business control model looks like and have proven experience in realizing this. The Senior Business Controller plays a key role in strengthening financial control, transparency and decision-making across Operations. The scope covers procurement and product costing, as well as warehouse and transport operations. Working closely with Finance, Procurement and Operations, the Senior Business Controller translates operational developments and improvement initiatives into clear financial insights and P&L impact

Our business is undergoing significant change. HG has recently changed its logistics service arrangements, consolidating most local warehouses into one central location as part of a cost-saving initiative. At the same time, a new ERP system is being implemented. This creates an interesting and dynamic environment in which existing budget models, cost allocation models, reporting and financial processes need to be further developed to reflect the new operating model and provide a solid basis for financial control and decision-making.

What you will do

Your responsibilities will include:

  • Owning the operational cost lines between Net Sales and Contribution Margin for the whole group and. act as a strong Finance business partner to the Chief Operating Officer and his team, translating operational developments into actionable financial insights;

  • Identifying and driving continuous improvements to the operational business, improving insights while reducing costs.

  • Being the financial business partner for the country managers in the UK and Germany, including reviewing commercial deals and business cases.

  • Analyzing budget versus actuals and explaining significant variances.

  • Developing a clear understanding of budgeted versus actual purchase prices and identifying the key drivers behind price variances.

  • Providing insight into raw material and purchase price developments and translating these into expected P&L impact.

  • Quantifying and tracking the financial impact of Procurement and product-costing initiatives and other savings programmes.

  • Establishing and further developing standard COGS based on expected cost developments.

  • Build a thorough understanding of the warehouse and distribution budget, operational performance and key savings initiatives. 

  • Track whether the expected savings from the recently implemented warehouse and transport provider change are being realized in the P&L. 

  • Further developing cost allocation models for individual markets, using meaningful drivers, and working towards more complete and reliable management reporting.

  • Ensuring the Operations P&L, budget and actual costs are consistently captured and reported in the same structure.

  • Translating inventory developments into financial impact and creating a clear link between stock levels, budget assumptions and cost allocation.

  • Supporting and improving an efficient month-end closing process, ensuring Operations costs are accurately and consistently booked, allocated and reconciled.

  • Establish or improve proper accounting entries together with Finance Administration and relevant operational partners.

  • Co-lead the annual budget cycle and budget presentations to the Board.

  • Using and improving Power BI, ERP data and financial processes to reduce manual work and increase transparency.

You will report directly to the Chief Financial Officer and work closely with colleagues in Finance, Procurement and Operations. You will also have regular contact with the Germany and UK country managers.

This position requires more than strong analytical skills. You will need to explain your insights clearly, engage stakeholders and constructively challenge where necessary. You will be a knowledgeable sparring partner who asks questions, brings structure and takes responsibility from analysis through to implementation. You proactively identify opportunities to improve financial processes, controls, reporting and transparency across Operations.

HG is a compact, fast-growing and international organization where you can directly see the impact of your work. This requires ownership, initiative and a pragmatic, results-oriented mindset. The team culture is open, pragmatic and focused on results, encouraging you to bring ideas forward, challenge constructively and take responsibility. Everything we do is guided by our three core values: Aim High, Be Brave, Be Connected.


What you bring

We are looking for a financially strong, hands-on and improvement-oriented controller who combines analytical capability with a practical understanding of Operations. The ideal candidate is comfortable working across Finance, Procurement and Operations and is able to turn complex cost drivers into clear insights and concrete actions. 

You bring a proactive mindset, strong stakeholder-management skills and a natural drive to simplify and improve processes. You are comfortable challenging existing ways of working, creating structure in a changing environment and taking ownership from analysis through implementation. 

You will also have:

  • A completed university master’s degree in Finance, Economics, Business Administration or a related field. A Registered Controller (RC) qualification is a strong advantage.

  • Around 10 years of relevant experience in business control, operations control or a comparable financial role.

  • Experience in a manufacturing environment is important, including knowledge of production processes, procurement and cost calculations.

  • A sound understanding of business control, financial controls and treasury.

  • Experience with ERP systems and an understanding of how financial data and accounting flows are structured.

  • Good knowledge of Power BI. You do not need to build everything from scratch, but you can independently investigate, improve and develop analyses.

  • Experience working with consolidation tools.

  • Strong analytical, communication and stakeholder management skills.

  • A proactive, hands-on and improvement-oriented mindset, with the ability to create structure in a changing environment.

  • Fluency in English. Knowledge of Dutch is desirable, and German is an advantage.

  • Experience with AI tools, such as Copilot.

  • Willingness to travel to the United Kingdom and Germany several times a year.

Please note that we do not offer visa or work permit sponsorship for this position. You must therefore hold a valid EU work permit

What do we offer

At HG, you will not be stepping into a role where everything is already set in stone. Changes in our logistics operations, systems and reporting create opportunities to further professionalize financial control and implement improvements yourself.

You can expect:

  • a senior role with broad responsibility and direct influence on financial and operational decision-making;

  • a salary appropriate to the seniority of the role, with an indicative range of €85,000 to €100,000 gross per year;

  • an annual on-target bonus of 25% of your gross annual salary; 

  • full-time employment with 30 days of annual leave; 

  • a pension scheme; 

  • a commuting allowance; 

  • a full-time role based at our head office in Almere. Hybrid working is possible on a limited basis, with office attendance being an important part of the role;

  • a dynamic and ambitious working environment where initiative and ownership are valued;

  • a friendly, welcoming team, with a free shared lunch every Monday and monthly social drinks.

We are HG

HG is a leading European brand in specialist cleaning and maintenance products.

We believe a home should be a place where people can live carefree, with confidence in the products they use to care for the spaces and belongings around them. Our products are developed to do exactly what they promise: deliver effective, reliable and specialist cleaning solutions that help consumers solve real household problems.

HG’s mission is to help people enjoy their homes without worrying about what might go wrong. We do this through high-quality products, specialist expertise, clear advice and a relentless focus on performance.

We are dedicated to delivering superiority, innovation, quality and customer satisfaction. With a strong presence across Europe and beyond, we are continuously investing to make an even bigger impact.

HG does what it promises.


Do you have any questions?

Our colleague Ilse de Groot, Corporate Recruiter, will be happy to answer any questions. You can contact her at .

Would you like to apply for the senior business controller position at HG? You can apply directly by uploading your CV. We aim to respond within 5 working days.

Acquisition in response to this vacancy is not appreciated.

jobs.title: Senior AI Engineer - VLA Foundation Model
jobs.description:
RIVR, part of Amazon is a robotics company pioneering Physical AI through real-world doorstep delivery. Founded in 2024 as an ETH Zurich spin-off, RIVR developed wheeled-legged robots designed to operate in complex, unstructured environments such as stairs, gates, doors, and uneven urban terrain. We believe that achieving general physical intelligence requires solving real customer problems in the real world, where robots can learn from rich operational data at scale.

Following our acquisition by Amazon in March 2026, we are continuing this mission with greater reach and speed. By combining custom robot hardware, onboard autonomy, and cloud-based coordination, RIVR, part of Amazon is building the next generation of safe, reliable autonomous robots for last-mile delivery


Job Description
 
Our fleet of delivery robots operates globally today, generating vast amounts of robotic real-world data. By utilizing state-of-the-art Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models, large-scale generalist models (like Transformers), generative AI, and similar methods, we can leverage this pool of data to significantly enhance its autonomy, navigation, and manipulation skills. In this role, you will develop multi-modal models that enable robots to autonomously generate actions from demonstrations, real-time sensor data, and natural language commands. We are seeking an expert in VLA models, imitation learning, and generative AI techniques with a deep knowledge of supervised, and self-supervised learning algorithms. If you are passionate about pushing the boundaries of AI we invite you to join us in shaping the future of intelligent robotics.
 
 

What you’ll be doing
  • Develop and implement cutting-edge Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models, generalist robot transformers, and imitation learning algorithms (e.g., diffusion policies) to enable robots to autonomously execute complex tasks.

jobs.title: GTM Recruiter, Singapore
jobs.description:
WHO WE ARE

Notion is the collaborative AI workspace where teams and agents think together https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=vkpYpWfEK5s. We're building one place where your knowledge, projects, meetings, and AI tools live side by side, so work is faster, clearer, and less fragmented. Millions of individuals, small teams, and large companies run their work on Notion.



Notinos (our employees) are customer zero in bringing this future of work to life. We care about craft, building things that last, and the belief that great work is still fundamentally human. Our goal isn’t to ship the next feature. Each and every team of Notinos is working to set the standard for how humans work together in the AI era. From building a business’s system of record to making and managing AI agents to automating away the busy work, we care deeply about giving our customers more time for their life’s work.




ABOUT THE ROLE:

 

We’re hiring the first recruiter on the ground in Singapore to build Notion’s GTM team across Southeast Asia. You’ll own GTM hiring end to end and help build the next evolution of our go-to-market organization, recruiting for new and evolving customer-facing roles, including BDRs, Solutions Consultants, Outcomes Architects, Forward Deployed Architects, Forward Deployed Engineers, and field sales leadership, that bring stronger technical fluency, deeper customer ownership, and fewer handoffs to enterprise selling. You’ll partner closely with the Country Manager, Singapore, sales leadership, and cross-functional teams to turn an emerging business strategy into clear profiles, thoughtful processes, and exceptional hires.

You’ll inherit a global recruiting playbook and develop the operating rhythm for the region. You’ll also have a direct hand in shaping the culture of the SEA team as it forms, and be the subject matter expert on the ground.

You’ll use Notion every day in the same way our customers do, giving you firsthand insight into the workflows and AI transformation behind the roles you are hiring for, and help build a new GTM motion at the intersection of AI, workflow design, enterprise transformation, and customer outcomes. The work requires craft, clarity, speed, and strong judgment, balancing business urgency with a high bar for talent density. We work from our Singapore office on Mondays, Tuesdays, and Thursdays (our Anchor Days) because we do our best thinking and building together in person. We’re looking for someone who’s excited to work alongside the team during those days.




WHAT YOU'LL ACHIEVE:

 - Own Singapore and SEA GTM hiring, from BDRs and Solutions Consultants to Outcomes Architects and field sales leadership, and help shape what the team looks like as it scales.

 - Establish the recruiting motion locally by building the process, systems, stakeholder rhythms, and candidate experience for SEA.

 - Help shape the culture of the SEA team as it forms, setting the hiring bar and the candidate experience that define what it feels like to join Notion here.

 - Partner directly with APAC GTM leadership on org design, role definition, market realities, and hiring decisions, and be the advisor they trust on what is achievable in the market.

 - Own complex and ambiguous searches end to end, setting strategy, diagnosing problems, pivoting when needed, and driving toward an outcome without waiting for direction.

 - Build deep Singapore and APAC talent networks and market intelligence, and use both to improve where and how Notion competes for talent.

 - Navigate high-stakes candidate and stakeholder situations, including compensation and closing conversations, with clarity and strong judgment.

 - Identify patterns across roles and regions and drive solutions that improve how the wider Recruiting team works.

 - Mentor teammates and share repeatable practices as the APAC team scales.




SKILLS YOU'LL NEED TO BRING: 

 - A strong record of GTM hiring in Singapore and APAC across BDR, sales, solutions consulting, and field leadership roles.

 - Deep recruiting craft across sourcing, assessment, candidate engagement, offer strategy, and close.

 - A strong record of delivering complex, ambiguous, or first-of searches and building the playbook when one does not exist.

 - Experience influencing senior sales leaders as a talent advisor and recruiting subject matter expert.

 - Strong situational awareness and business maturity, with the judgment to navigate competing priorities and know when to push back or escalate.

 - A systems mindset and evidence of improving team practices beyond your own portfolio.

 - Curiosity, learning agility, and a hands-on approach to AI tools that improve recruiting quality and leverage.




NICE TO HAVES:

 - Experience as an early recruiting hire in a market or region, setting up the motion while hiring at pace.

 - Experience owning the end-to-end hiring process at a global SaaS company.

 - Experience hiring across multiple APAC markets.

Osoba koja ne podnese pravodobnu i/ili urednu prijavu ili za koju se utvrdi da ne ispunjava formalne uvjete iz Javnog poziva, neće se smatrati kandidatom prijavljenim na Javni poziv. Urednom prijavom smatra se prijava koja sadržava sve podatke i priloge navedene u Javnom pozivu. Javni poziv bit će objavljen 9. studenog 2026. godine na mrežnoj stranici Hrvatskog zavoda za zapošljavanje i otvoren do 17. studenog 2026. Radni odnos sa školom zasnovat će se nakon provedenog postupka selekcije kandidata. S kandidatom izabranim za pomoćnika u nastavi, OŠ Vugrovec-Kašina sklopit će ugovor o radu.

jobs.title: UČITELJ/UČITELJICA RAZREDNE NASTAVE
jobs.description:
Temeljem članka 107. st. 1. Zakona o odgoju i obrazovanju u osnovnoj i srednjoj školi (Narodne novine, br. 87/08, 86/09,92/10, 105/10, 90/11, 5/12, 16/12, 86/12, 126/12, 94/13, 152/14, 7/17, 68/18, 98/19, 64/20, 151/22 i 156/23), članka 13. Pravilnika o radu i čl. 8. i 9. Pravilnika o postupku zapošljavanja te procjeni i vrednovanju kandidata za zapošljavanje OŠ „Stjepan Radić“ Imotski,

OSNOVNA ŠKOLA „STJEPAN RADIĆ“ Imotski objavljuje

N A T J E Č A J

za zasnivanje radnog odnosa

  1. UČITELJ/ICA RAZREDNE NASTAVE

-1 izvršitelj/ica na određeno, puno radno vrijeme (40 sati tjedno)

mjesto rada – OŠ „Stjepan Radić“Imotski-područna škola Vinjani Donji

Uvjeti:

Uz opće uvjete za zasnivanje radnog odnosa prema Zakonu o radu (Narodne novine br. 93/14., 127/17.,98/19.,151/22.,64/23) kandidati trebaju ispunjavati i posebne uvjete propisane člankom 105. Zakona o odgoju i obrazovanju u osnovnoj i srednjoj školi (Narodne novine 87/08., 86/0.9, 92/10., 105/10., 90/11., 5/12., 16/12., 86/12., 126/12., 94/13., 152/14., 7/17., 68/18., 98/19., 64/20., 151/22., 156/23.) i čl. 4. Pravilnika o odgovarajućoj vrsti obrazovanja učitelja i stručnih suradnika u osnovnoj školi (Narodne novine 6/19., 75/20.).

Na natječaj se mogu prijaviti osobe oba spola sukladno Zakonu o ravnopravnosti spolova (Narodne novine br. 82/08. i 69/17.).

Izrazi koji se koriste u natječaju, a imaju rodno značenje, koriste se i odnose se jednako na muške i ženske osobe.

Radni odnos u školi ne može se zasnovati s osobom za koju postoje zapreke iz članka 106. Zakona o odgoju i obrazovanju u osnovnoj i srednjoj školi.( Narodne novine, br. 87/08, 86/09,92/10, 105/10, 90/11, 5/12, 16/12, 86/12, 126/12, 94/13, 152/14, 7/17, 68/18, 98/19, 64/20, 151/22 i 156/23).

U prijavi na natječaj potrebno je navesti naziv radnog mjesta za koje se prijavljuje i osobne podatke (ime i prezime, adresu stanovanja, broj telefona odnosno mobitela, po mogućnosti e-mail adresu na koju će biti dostavljena obavijest o datumu i vremenu procjene odnosno testiranja).

Uz pisanu i vlastoručno potpisanu prijavu na natječaj potrebno je priložiti:

1. Životopis

2. Diplomu odnosno dokaz o odgovarajućem stupnju obrazovanja

3. Dokaz o državljanstvu

4. Uvjerenje nadležnog suda da se protiv podnositelja prijave ne vodi kazneni postupak i da nije

pod istragom za neko od kaznenih djela iz čl. 106. Zakona o odgoju i obrazovanju u osnovnoj

i srednjoj školi (ne starije od 30 dana od dana objave Natječaja)

5. Elektronički zapis ili potvrdu o podacima evidentiranim u matičnoj evidenciji Hrvatskog

zavoda za mirovinsko osiguranje (ne starije od mjesec dana od raspisivanja Natječaja

Svi prilozi dostavljaju se u neovjerenoj preslici, a izabrani/a kandidat/kinja prije sklapanja ugovora o radu dužan je sve navedene priloge odnosno isprave dostaviti u izvorniku ili u preslici ovjerenoj od strane javnog bilježnika sukladno Zakonu o javnom bilježništvu ( Narodne novine broj 78/93, 29/94/, 162/98, 16/07, 75/09, 120/16 i 57/22). Natječajna dokumetacija neće se vraćati kandidatima.

Kandidat/kinja koji je stekao obrazovnu kvalifikaciju izvan Republike Hrvatske, dužan je dostaviti ispravu(e) kojom se dokazuje priznavanje inozemne obrazovne kvalifikacije i kojom se ostvaruje pravo na pristup i obavljanje regulirane profesije.

Kandidat/kinja koji ostvaruje pravo prednosti pri zapošljavanju na temelju članka 102. stavaka 1.-3. Zakona o hrvatskim braniteljima iz Domovinskog rata i članovima njihovih obitelji (Narodne novine br.121/17., 98/19., 84/21.,156/23.), članka 48.f Zakona o zaštiti vojnih i civilnih invalida rata (Narodne novine br. 33/92., 57/92., 77/92., 27/93., 58/93., 02/94., 76/94., 108/95, 108/96., 82/01., 103/03., 148/13.,98/19), članka 9. Zakona o profesionalnoj rehabilitaciji i zapošljavanju osoba s invaliditetom (Narodne novine br. 157/13., 152/14., 39/18., 32/20). te članka 48. Zakona o civilnim stradalnicima iz Domovinskog rata (Narodne novine br. 84/21), dužan je u prijavi na javni natječaj pozvati se na to pravo i uz prijavu na natječaj pored navedenih isprava, odnosno priloga, priložiti svu propisanu dokumentaciju prema posebnom zakonu te ima prednost u odnosu na ostale kandidate/kinje samo pod jednakim uvjetima.

Kandidat/kinja koji pravo prednosti pri zapošljavanju ostvaruje na temelju članka 102. stavka 1.-3. Zakona o hrvatskim braniteljima iz Domovinskog rata i članovima njihovih obitelji (Narodne novine 121/17, 98/19, 84/21 i 156/23), dužan je u prijavi na natječaj na to pravo se pozvati i dostaviti dokaze iz članka 103. st. 1. navedenog zakona koji se mogu pronaći na internet stranicama Ministarstva hrvatskih branitelja:

https://branitelji.gov.hr/UserDocsImages/dokumenti/Nikola/popis%20dokaza%20za%20ostvarivanje%20prava%20prednosti%20pri%20zapo%C5%A1ljavanju-%20ZOHBDR%202021.pdf

Kandidat/kinja koji se poziva na pravo prednosti pri zapošljavanju u skladu s člankom 48. Zakona o civilnim stradalnicima iz Domovinskog rata (NN 84/21) uz prijavu na natječaj dužan je priložiti sve dokaze o ispunjavanju uvjeta iz natječaja te priložiti dokaze o ispunjavanju uvjeta za ostvarivanje prava prednosti pri zapošljavanju (čl.49.st.1. Zakona) dostupne na poveznici Ministarstva hrvatskih branitelja:

https://branitelji.gov.hr/UserDocsImages/dokumenti/Nikola/popis%20dokaza%20za%20ostvarivanje%20prava%20prednosti%20pri%20zapo%C5%A1ljavanju-%20Zakon%20o%20civilnim%20stradalnicima%20iz%20DR.pdf

Najkasnije do isteka roka za podnošenje prijava na natječaj na mrežnoj stranici škole http://os-sradic-im.skole.hr/natjecaji bit će objavljen način procjene odnosno testiranja kandidata, a najmanje pet dana prije same procjene odnosno testiranja bit će objavljeni datum, vrijeme i mjesto procjene odnosno testiranja kandidata.

Kandidati koji su pravodobno podnijeli potpunu prijavu te ispunjavaju uvjete natječaja obvezni su pristupiti procjeni odnosno testiranju prema odredbama Pravilnika o postupku zapošljavanja te procjeni i vrednovanju kandidata za zapošljavanje koji se može pronaći na stranicama O.Š. “Stjepan Radić” Imotski: http://os-sradic-im.skole.hr/dokumenti

Svi kandidati svojom prijavom na natječaj daju privolu za obradu osobnih podataka koji su navedeni u svim dostavljenim prilozima odnosno ispravama za potrebe provedbe javnog natječaja sukladno odredbama Opće uredbe o zaštiti podataka 2016/679 i Zakona o provedbi Opće uredbe o zaštiti osobnih podataka (NN 42/18).

Natječaj je objavljen na mrežnim stranicama i oglasnoj ploči Hrvatskog zavoda za zapošljavanje te mrežnim stranicama i oglasnoj ploči Škole 5. studenog 2026. godine. Rok za prijavu na Natječaj je do13. studenog 2026. godine.

Prijave s potrebnom dokumentacijom dostaviti u roku osam (8) dana od dana objave natječaja neposredno ili na adresu:

Osnovna škola „Stjepan Radić“ Imotski, Fra Stjepana Vrljića 13, 21 260 Imotski – s naznakom „za natječaj-upisati naziv radnog mjesta za koje se kandidat prijavljuje“

Nepravodobne i nepotpune prijave neće se razmatrati.

Rezultati natječaja bit će objavljeni na mrežnoj stranici Škole u roku od 15 dana od sklapanja ugovora o radu s izabranim kandidatom/kinjom, te će se objavom rezultata natječaja smatrati da su svi kandidati obaviješteni. U slučaju da se na natječaj prijave kandidati/kinje koji se pozivaju na pravo prednosti pri zapošljavanju prema posebnom propisu, svi će kandidati biti obaviješteni prema članku 23. stavku 4. Pravilnika o postupku zapošljavanja te procjeni i vrednovanju kandidata za zapošljavanje OŠ „Stjepan Radić“ Imotski.

jobs.title: 1.	LIJEČNIK/CA SPECIJALIST/ICA PULMOLOGIJE – U KLINICI ZA PLUĆNE BOLESTI
jobs.description:
Uvjeti:

•završen sveučilišni diplomski studij ili sveučilišni integrirani prijediplomski i diplomski studij medicine, •specijalizacija iz grane medicine iz djelatnosti klinike odnosno kliničkog zavoda, •odobrenje za samostalan rad, •uvjerenje da se ne vodi kazneni postupak.

Uz prijavu na natječaj treba priložiti:

•životopis, •preslike: diplome, uvjerenja o položenom specijalističkom ispitu, odobrenja za samostalan rad, uvjerenja da se ne vodi kazneni postupak, ne starije od 30 dana od dana objave natječaja.

Radni odnos zasniva se na neodređeno vrijeme, uz uvjet probnog rada u trajanju od šest mjeseci.

Prijave na natječaj dostavljaju se pisanim putem na adresu:

Klinički bolnički centar Zagreb,

Zagreb, Ulica Mije Kišpatića 12

„za natječaj za (navesti redni broj i naziv radnog mjesta na koje se kandidat prijavljuje)“

Rok za podnošenje prijava na natječaj je 8 dana od dana objave na internetskoj stranici i oglasnoj ploči KBC-a Zagreb i Hrvatskog zavoda za zapošljavanje.

Kandidatom prijavljenim na natječaj smatra se samo osoba koja podnese pravovremenu i urednu prijavu na natječaj te ispunjava formalne uvjete iz natječaja.

Urednom se smatra prijava koja sadrži sve podatke i priloge, odnosno dokaze o ispunjavanju uvjeta. Nepravovremene i neuredne prijave neće se razmatrati.

Ukoliko kandidat uz prijavu priloži dokumente u kojima osobni podaci nisu istovjetni, dužan je dostaviti i dokaz o njihovoj promjeni (presliku vjenčanog ili rodnog lista).

Radnim iskustvom smatra se vrijeme koje je radnik proveo obavljajući određene poslove u struci, sukladno završenoj stručnoj spremi.

Molimo kandidate da na molbi točno navedu redni broj i naziv radnog mjesta za koje se prijavljuju.

Ukoliko se prijavljuju na više radnih mjesta, za svako pojedino radno mjesto potrebno je dostaviti posebnu zamolbu s pripadajućom dokumentacijom.

Pozivi na razgovore objavit će se na internetskoj stranici Kliničkog bolničkog centra Zagreb https://www.kbc-zagreb.hr/.

Prije donošenja odluke o odabiru, kandidati koji ispunjavanju formalne uvjete prema Odluci Ravnatelja mogu biti testirani u svrhu provjere znanja, vještina i sposobnosti, bitnih za obavljanje poslova radnog mjesta za koje se kandidiraju.

Obavijesti o rezultatima natječaja objavit će se na internetskoj stranici KBC-a Zagreb https://www.kbc-zagreb.hr/ te na oglasnoj ploči KBC- a Zagreb u sjedištu Ustanove.

Kandidat koji ostvaruje pravo prednosti pri zapošljavanju pod jednakim uvjetima prema posebnim propisima, dužan je priložiti svu propisanu dokumentaciju.

Kandidat koji može ostvariti pravo prednosti pri zapošljavanju u skladu s člankom 102. Zakona o hrvatskim braniteljima iz Domovinskog rata i članovima njihovih obitelji (NN 121/17, 98/19, 84/21, 156/23) te kandidat koji može ostvariti pravo prednosti pri zapošljavanju u skladu s člankom 48. Zakona o civilnim stradalnicima iz Domovinskog rata (NN 84/21, 13/26) uz prijavu na natječaj dužan je priložiti, osim dokaza o ispunjavanju traženih uvjeta i sve potrebne dokaze dostupne na poveznici Ministarstva hrvatskih branitelja: https://branitelji.gov.hr/zaposljavanje-843/843.

Ako se na natječaj prijavi kandidat koji se poziva na pravo prednosti prema Zakonu o zaštiti vojnih i civilnih invalida rata (NN 33/92, 57/92, 77/92, 27/93, 58/93, 2/94, 76/94, 108/95, 108/96, 82/01, 94/01, 103/03, 148/13, 98/19) za ostvarivanje prednosti prilikom zapošljavanja pod jednakim uvjetima, dužan je u prijavi priložiti dokaze o ispunjavanju uvjeta natječaja, kao i ostale dokaze o ispunjavanju uvjeta iz članka 6., 7., 8. i 48. f navedenog zakona.

Ako se na natječaj prijavi kandidat koji se poziva na pravo prednosti prema Zakonu o profesionalnoj rehabilitaciji i zapošljavanju osoba s invaliditetom (NN 157/13, 152/14, 39/18, 32/20) za ostvarivanje prednosti prilikom zapošljavanja pod jednakim uvjetima, dužan je u prijavi priložiti dokaze o ispunjavanju uvjeta natječaja, kao i ostale dokaze o ispunjavanju uvjeta iz članka 9. navedenog zakona – dokaz o priznatom statusu osobe s invaliditetom.

Izrazi koji se koriste u ovom natječaju, a koji imaju rodno značenje, odnose se na jednak način i na ženski i muški rod, a prema Zakonu o ravnopravnosti spolova (NN 82/08, 125/11, 20/12, 138/12, 69/17) na ovaj natječaj mogu se prijaviti osobe oba spola.

Pravna osnova za obradu osobnih podataka temelji se na čl. 6. st.1. (b) i (c) Opće uredbe o zaštiti podataka (Uredba EU 2016/679), a provodi se u svrhu provedbe natječajnog postupka. Osobni podaci prikupljaju se izravno od kandidata. KBC Zagreb kao voditelj obrade osobnih podataka prikuplja, koristi i obrađuje dostavljene osobne podatke isključivo u svrhu provedbe natječajnog postupka u skladu s navedenim propisima i propisima koji uređuju zaštitu osobnih podataka.

Za sva pitanja vezana uz obradu osobnih podataka ili ostvarivanje prava ispitanika možete se obratiti službeniku za zaštitu podataka na e-mail: zastitapodataka@kbc-zagreb.hr.

Detaljnije informacije možete pronaći web stranici KBC-a Zagreb odnosno na poveznici https://www.kbc-zagreb.hr/zastita-osobnih-podataka.aspx .

jobs.description:
REPUBLIKA HRVATSKA OSNOVNA ŠKOLA PRELOG TRG BANA JELAČIĆA 2, PRELOG KLASA: 112-03/26-01/01 URBROJ: 2109-40-01-26-18 Prelog, 6. studenog 2026. Na temelju članka 107. Zakona o odgoju i obrazovanju u osnovnoj i srednjoj školi (NN 87/08., 86/09., 92/10., 105/10.-ispr, 90/11.,5/12., 16/12., 86/12., 94/13., 136/14.-RUSRH, 152/14., 7/17. i 68/18., 98/19., 64/20., 151/22, 156/23) članka 10. Pravilnika o radu, te članaka 6. i 7. Pravilnika o zapošljavanju Osnovne škole Prelog (u daljnjem tekstu: Pravilnik ), ravnateljica Osnovne škole Prelog objavljuje: NATJEČAJ za popunu radnog mjesta
  • Učitelj/ica RAZREDNE NASTAVE 1 izvršitelj/ica, na određeno puno radno vrijeme, zamjena
mjesto rada: Osnovna škola Prelog, Trg bana Jelačića 2, 40 323 Prelog Uvjeti: Osim općih uvjeta sukladno općim propisima o radu kandidati trebaju zadovoljiti i posebne uvjete propisane u članku 105. Zakona o odgoju i obrazovanju u osnovnoj i srednjoj školi i u skladu s Pravilnikom o stručnoj spremi i pedagoško-psihološkom obrazovanju učitelja i stručnih suradnika u osnovnoj školi (NN 6/19. i 75/20.) Na natječaj za radno mjesto mogu se ravnopravno prijaviti osobe oba spola, a izrazi koji se koriste u ovom natječaju za osobe u muškom rodu korišteni su neutralno i odnose se i na muške i ženske kandidate. Uz pisanu i vlastoručnu potpisanu prijavu kandidati su obvezni priložiti (u izvorniku, ovjerenoj preslici ili elektroničkom zapisu):
  • životopis,
  • diplomu odnosno dokaz o stečenoj stručnoj spremi,
  • dokaz o državljanstvu,
  • uvjerenje nadležnog suda da podnositelj prijave nije pod istragom i da se protiv podnositelja prijave ne vodi kazneni postupak glede zapreka za zasnivanje radnog odnosa iz članka 106. Zakona o odgoju i obrazovanju u osnovnoj i srednjoj školi, ne starije od dana raspisivanja natječaja,
  • elektronički zapis ili potvrdu o podacima evidentiranim u matičnoj evidenciji Hrvatskog zavoda za mirovinsko osiguranje (HZMO)
U prijavi na natječaj kandidati trebaju navesti osobne podatke (osobno ime, adresu stanovanja, broj telefona odnosno mobitela i e-mail adresu na koju će biti dostavljena obavijest o datumu i vremenu procjene odnosno testiranja), te naziv radnog mjesta na koje se prijavljuje. Kandidati koji će pravodobno dostaviti potpunu prijavu sa svim prilozima odnosno ispravama (u izvorniku, ovjerenoj preslici ili elektroničkom zapisu) i ispunjavaju uvjete natječaja dužni su pristupiti procjeni odnosno testiranju prema odredbama Pravilnika o zapošljavanju OŠ Prelog objavljenog na sljedećoj poveznici: http://www.os-prelog.skole.hr/dokumentacija Procjena, odnosno testiranje kandidata koji ispunjavaju uvjete natječaja vršit će se iz poznavanja odredbi Zakona o odgoju i obrazovanju u osnovnoj i srednjoj školi, Pravilnika o načinima, postupcima i elementima vrednovanja učenika u osnovnoj i srednjoj školi, Pravilnika o kriterijima za izricanje pedagoških mjera, Pravilnik o osnovnoškolskom i srednjoškolskom odgoju i obrazovanju učenika s teškoćama u razvoju, Pravilnika o načinu postupanja odgojno-obrazovnih radnika školskih ustanova u poduzimanju mjera zaštite prava učenika, te prijave svakog kršenja tih prava nadležnim tijelima, Pravilnik o pedagoškoj dokumentaciji i evidenciji te javnim ispravama u školskim, ustanovama, Godišnji izvedbeni kurikulum za razrednu nastavu, te odredbi Statuta OŠ Prelog. Kandidat koji ostvaruje pravo prednosti pri zapošljavanju na temelju članka 102. stavaka 1.-3. Zakona o hrvatskim braniteljima iz Domovinskog rata i članovima njihovih obitelji (Narodne novine 121/17.), članka 48.f Zakona o zaštiti vojnih i civilnih invalida rata (Narodne novine broj 33/92., 57/92., 77/92., 27/93., 58/93., 02/94., 76/94., 108/95., 108/96., 82/01., 103/03 i 148/13) ili članka 9. Zakona o profesionalnoj rehabilitaciji i zapošljavanju osoba s invaliditetom (Narodne novine broj 157/13., 152/14., 39/18. i 32/20.) dužni su u prijavi na javni natječaj pozvati se na to pravo i uz prijavu na natječaj pored navedenih isprava odnosno priloga priložiti svu propisanu dokumentaciju prema posebnom zakonu te ima prednost u odnosu na ostale kandidate samo pod jednakim uvjetima. Kandidat koji se poziva na pravo prednosti pri zapošljavanju na temelju članka 102. stavaka 1.-3. Zakona o hrvatskim braniteljima iz Domovinskog rata i članovima njihovih obitelji dužan je uz prijavu na natječaj pored navedenih isprava odnosno priloga priložiti i sve potrebne dokaze iz članka 103. stavka 1. jobs.description:
Opis posla:
  • Priprema, kuhanje i posluživanje naše stalne fast-food ponude.
  • Pomaganje u pripremi i posluživanju dnevne ponude
  • Održavanje čistoće i organizacije u kuhinji
  • Osiguravanje pravovremenog i učinkovitog posluživanja tijekom prometnih razdoblja
  • Suradnja s članovima tima kako bismo održali kvalitetu hrane i dosljednost
  • Vaše radno vrijeme je 9-17 i jedan dan u tjednu 10-18, radi se 5 dana u tjednu (nedjelja i jedan dan tijekom tjedna su slobodni).
  • Svi blagdani su neradni. Bistro se nalazi u Blok centru 2 u Osijeku.

Na ovoj poziciji bit ćete odgovorni za našu stalnu fast-food ponudu jela - od pripreme i organizacije do posluživanja - a pružit ćemo vam temeljitu obuku kako biste se uspješno snašli u svojim dužnostima. Kvalifikacije:
  • Prethodno iskustvo u fast-food restoranu, restoranskoj kuhinji ili sličnom brzom okruženju preferirano
  • Izražene organizacijske vještine i sposobnost obavljanja više zadataka istovremeno
  • Fleksibilnost i volja za učenjem
  • Sposobnost rada pod pritiskom

jobs.title: VODITELJ/VODITELJICA GRADITELJSTVA, KOMUNALNIH USLUGA I UPRAVLJANJA  STAMBENIM ZGRADAMA
jobs.description:
Obavlja poslove tehničke i operativne pripreme u graditeljstvu i komunalnim uslugama, posebice:

  • u suradnji sa direktorom i drugim voditeljima obavlja poslove ishođenja lokacijskih i građevinskih dozvola,
  • izrađuje idejna rješenja, projektne zadatke i izvedbene troškovnike u graditeljstvu i komunalnim uslugama,
  • izrađuje privremene i okončane situacije u graditeljstvu,
  • planira i prati izvođenje radova u graditeljstvu i komunalnim uslugama,
  • priprema dokumentaciju za izvođenje i praćenje radova u graditeljstvu i komunalnim uslugama i sl.,
  • planira i prati potrebno radno vrijeme, i sl.,
  • organizira i prati tekuće i investicijsko održavanje,
  • prati i planira izvođenje obveznih, periodičkih i po narudžbi radova na održavanju stambenih zgrada,
  • provodi mjere zaštite na radu u skladu sa Zakonom o zaštiti na radu i elaboratom procjene opasnosti:
  • ako za to postoji zakonska obaveza, prije početka radova na privremenom radilištu osigurava izradu Plana uređenja privremenog radilišta i prijavu radova nadležnoj inspekciji rada, i s tim povezanih radnji:
  • prije početka radova urediti privremeno radilište i osigurati da se poslovi obavljaju u skladu s pravilima zaštite na radu i kako je to utvrđeno Planom uređenja privremenog radilišta,
  • kada je imenovan koordinatorom zaštite na radu na gradilištu, organizirati suradnju između poslodavaca izvođača radova s naglaskom osiguranja primjene zaštite na radu, te sprečavanje ozljeda na radu i opasnosti po zdravlje radnika,
  • kada je koordinatorom zaštite na radu imenovana druga osoba, surađivati sa koordinatorom za zaštitu na radu privremenog zajedničkog radilišta u primjeni mjera za sprečavanje ozljeda na radu i opasnosti po zdravlje radnika,
  • ne dopustiti da se na samostalno obavljanje poslova rasporedi radnik koji nije osposobljen za rad na siguran način i pravovremeno organizirati osposobljavanje i provjeru osposobljenosti na mjestu rada,
  • ne dopustiti da se na poslove s posebnim uvjetima rada zaposli radnik za kojega na propisan način nije utvrđeno da ispunjava tražene uvjete, odnosno da se radnik koji tražene uvjete više ne ispunjava zadrži na poslovima s posebnim uvjetima rada,
  • osigurati nužnu zalihu osobnih zaštitnih sredstava na gradilištu da se omogući kontinuirano zaduživanje radnika, zaduživati radnike propisanim osobnim zaštitnim sredstvima i o tome voditi evidenciju,
  • isključiti iz uporabe strojeve i uređaje, te osobna zaštitna sredstva koja nisu ispravna,
  • osigurati da radnici rade sa dužnom pozornošću sukladno odredbama Zakona o zaštiti na radu, propisa donesenih na temelju njega, drugih propisa zaštite na radu, uputa za rad na siguran način, uputa proizvođača strojeva i uređaja, osobnih zaštitnih sredstava i radnih tvari, te da za vrijeme rada koriste propisana osobna zaštitna sredstva,
  • zabraniti radniku rad ako ga obavlja suprotno odredbi iz prethodnog stavka,
  • osigurati da se za vrijeme rada ne piju alkoholna pića, te uzimaju druga sredstva ovisnosti, zabraniti rad radnicima koji su na radu pod utjecajem alkohola i drugih sredstava ovisnosti, te da ih privremeno udaljiti s rada,
  • kontrolira i odgovara za kvalitetu radova,
  • pravovremeno daje potrebe za naručivanje komunalno-građevinskog materijala,
  • brine za kontinuirano funkcioniranje komunalnih usluga,
  • obavlja sve poslove koji nisu pobrojeni a odnose se na tu djelatnost,
  • obavlja i druge poslove prema nalogu Uprave društva,
  • za svoj rad odgovara Rukovoditelju komunalnih i gospodarskih organizacionih cjelina, Zamjeniku direktora i Direktoru.

Uvjeti za zasnivanje radnog odnosa, dostaviti:

  • zamolba
  • životopis
  • dokaz o stručnoj spremi, (preslika diplome)
  • potpisnu izjavu o poznavanju rada na računalu
  • preslika vozačke dozvola „B“ kategorije,
  • dokaz o radnom stažu (elektornički zapis ili potvrda izdana od strane HZMO)
-probni rok: 3 mjeseca

- Uprava Društva zadržava pravo poništenja ovog natječaja u bilo kojoj fazi postupka, kao i pravo neizbora niti jednog kandidata, bez obveze obrazlaganja svoje odluke i bez ikakve odgovornosti prema prijavljenim kandidatima

jobs.title: ELEKTROTEHNIČAR/KA U LOGISTIČKO-DISTRIBUTIVNOM CENTRU
jobs.description:
VAŠE ODGOVORNOSTI:

  • Montaža i instalacija: Postavljanje i spajanje novih elektroinstalacija, razvodnih ormara, rasvjete te opreme za automatizaciju unutar centra.
  • Preventivno održavanje: Redoviti pregledi i servisiranje elektroenergetskih postrojenja, sustava za hlađenje, ventilaciju i transportnih traka prema planu održavanja.
  • Otklanjanje kvarova: Brza dijagnostika i hitne intervencije u slučaju zastoja na strojevima ili električnim sustavima.
  • Nadzor sustava: Praćenje rada automatiziranih sustava za kontrolu temperature i vlage u komorama za povrće.
  • Tehnička dokumentacija: Vođenje uredne evidencije o provedenim radovima, intervencijama i utrošenom materijalu te čitanje tehničkih nacrta i elektro-shema.
  • Suradnja: Asistencija vanjskim izvođačima i serviserima prilikom većih popravaka ili implementacije novih tehnologija.

OD VAS OČEKUJEMO:

  • Stručna sprema: Srednja stručna sprema (SSS) elektrotehničkog smjera (elektrotehničar, elektromonter ili srodno).
  • Iskustvo: Minimalno 2 godine radnog iskustva na istim ili sličnim poslovima (prednost je iskustvo rada u industrijskim pogonima, logističkim centrima ili hladnjačama).
  • Stručna znanja: Odlično snalaženje u čitanju elektro-shema te poznavanje industrijske automatike i frekventnih pretvarača.
  • Dozvole: Vozačka dozvola B kategorije.
  • Vještine: Samostalnost u rješavanju problema, preciznost, odgovornost i spremnost na timski rad. Spremnost na povremeni rad u smjenama ili dežurstva.

ŠTO NUDIMO:

  • Stabilnost: Ugovor o radu na neodređeno vrijeme uz probni rok od 6 mjeseci.
  • Uvjeti: Stimulativna i iznadprosječna primanja uz plaćene putne troškove i dodatke za eventualni rad vikendom/praznikom.
  • Razvoj: Rad u modernom postrojenju s najnovijim tehnologijama hlađenja i logistike te kontinuirano stručno usavršavanje.

jobs.title: SAMOSTALNI PROSTORNI PLANER/PLANERKA - URBANIST /URBANISTKINJA
jobs.employer: Zavod za prostorno uređenje Grada Rijeke
jobs.description:
Uvjeti:
  • završen diplomski sveučilišni studij arhitekture ili arhitekture i urbanizma,
  • položen stručni ispit za stručne poslove prostornog uređenja,
  • najmanje četiri godine radnog iskustva na odgovarajućim poslovima,
  • poznavanje rada na računalu
Opis poslova:
  • obavlja najsloženije poslove programske, tehničke i grafičke obrade elaborata;
  • sudjeluje u izradi prostornih planova te programa, planova, izvješća, analiza i stručnih dokumenata iz djelokruga odnosno nadležnosti Zavoda;
  • kontinuirano prati provedbu prostornih planova te obavlja druge poslove koje mu ravnatelj povjeri.
Uz prijavu na natječaj potrebno je priložiti:
  • životopis,
  • dokaz o odgovarajućoj stručnoj spremi (presliku diplome); kandidati koji su razinu obrazovanja stekli u inozemstvu trebaju priložiti i presliku rješenja o nostrifikaciji odnosno priznavanju inozemne kvalifikacije iz kojeg je vidljivo koji je to stupanj i razina obrazovanja i s kojim je stupnjem odnosno razinom obrazovanja to u Republici Hrvatskoj izjednačeno;
  • dokaz o ukupnom radnom iskustvu (ispis elektroničkog zapisa o radno pravnom statusu ilie-radna knjižica koja se vodi pri Hrvatskom zavodu za mirovinsko osiguranje), koji sadrži podatke o poslodavcu, početku i prestanku osiguranja, stvarnoj i potrebnoj stručnoj spremi, radnom vremenu i trajanju staža osiguranja,
  • dokaz o radnom iskustvu na odgovarajućim poslovima (potvrdu poslodavca, ugovor o radu, rješenje ili drugi odgovarajući dokaz iz kojeg su vidljivi vrsta poslova i razdoblje njihova obavljanja),
  • dokaz o položenom stručnom ispitu za stručne poslove prostornog uređenja (ukoliko kandidat ima položen ispit)
  • dokaz o promjeni osobnog imena, ako je ono mijenjano u odnosu na isprave koje se prilažu uz prijavu (vjenčani ili rodni list i sl.)
  • vlastoručno potpisanu izjavu o poznavanju rada na računalu, uz navođenje konkretnih računalnih programa i alata kojima se kandidat služi.
