jobs.description:
Daten im Kopf? SEO im Blut? Dann suchen wir genau dich! Wir bieten dir die passende Stelle als Digital Analytics & SEO Consultant (w/m/x) bei Digital Leverage in Zürich. Der Starttermin ist flexibel.

Wir sind Digital Leverage, eine erfahrene SEO- & GEO-Agentur mit Sitz in Zürich und grossen Plänen. Unsere Kund:innen sind vielfältig und dynamisch – B2B, B2C, vom agilen KMU bis zum etablierten Grossunternehmen. So bekommst du spannende Einblicke in verschiedene Branchen und Unternehmen.

Unsere Kundschaft will verstehen, was digitale Sichtbarkeit – von der klassischen Suche bis zu KI-Antworten – bewirkt. Dafür brauchen wir verlässliche Daten, durchdachte Messkonzepte und Menschen, die daraus klare Handlungsempfehlungen ableiten. Hier kommst du ins Spiel.

Aufgaben

Als Digital Analytics & SEO Consultant arbeitest du an der Schnittstelle zwischen SEO/GEO und KPI-Tracking und -Reporting. In deinen Projekten übernimmst du vom ersten Moment an das Ruder. Du berätst unsere Kund:innen, entwickelst passende Messkonzepte und Dashboards und begleitest deren Umsetzung. Du hilfst ihnen, die Wirkung ihrer digitalen Aktivitäten zu verstehen und ihre Sichtbarkeit in Suchmaschinen und KI-Antworten gezielt weiterzuentwickeln.

Dabei arbeitest du eng mit unserem Team an SEO-, GEO- und Content-Spezialist:innen sowie den Marketing- und Entwicklungsteams unserer Kund:innen zusammen. Du bekommst viel Freiraum, Verantwortung und die Gelegenheit, unser Angebot im Bereich Digital Analytics aktiv mitzugestalten.

Die interne Weiterentwicklung zur/zum Lead Digital Analytics wird begrüsst und gefördert!

Zu deinen Aufgaben gehören u.a.:

  • Entwicklung von Messkonzepten, KPI-Frameworks und Tracking-Plänen entlang der Customer Journey

  • Einrichtung und Weiterentwicklung von Tracking-Lösungen mit Google Analytics 4 und Google Tag Manager unter Berücksichtigung der Consent-Anforderungen

  • Durchführung von Analytics- und Tracking-Audits sowie Qualitätssicherung und Verbesserung der Datenqualität

  • Aufbau und Betreuung von Prompt-Trackings zur Messung der Sichtbarkeit unserer Kund:innen in KI-Antworten, beispielsweise mit Peec AI oder Rankscale

  • Begleitung von Relaunch-Projekten aus Analytics- und Tracking-Perspektive

  • Analyse von Traffic, Nutzerverhalten und Conversions sowie Ableitung konkreter Optimierungsmöglichkeiten

  • Analyse der KI-Sichtbarkeit, Markennennungen und Quellenverweise im Wettbewerbsvergleich sowie Einordnung des messbaren Traffics aus KI-Plattformen

  • Erstellung und Interpretation verständlicher Dashboards (bspw. Data Studio, Adobe Analytics etc.) und Reportings, die Ergebnisse und Handlungsmöglichkeiten auf den Punkt bringen

  • Eigenständige Beratung und Betreuung unserer Kund:innen sowie Entwicklung datenbasierter Empfehlungen für ihre GEO-Strategie

Med våra värdeord relation, innovation och kvalitet som grund bygger vi långsiktiga samarbeten och skapar lösningar som gör verklig skillnad för våra kunder.Hos oss går professionalism och arbetsglädje hand i hand. jobs.title: Finance Manager till Yllw!
jobs.description: Vill du bygga en ekonomifunktion som håller samma tempo som ett av Europas snabbast växande bolag? Vill du hellre bygga det som kommer än förvalta det som finns? Då är rollen som Finance Manager på Yllw för dig!Om YllwYllw förändrar en hel bransch. Bolaget är ett av Europas snabbast växande inom inredning, relocation management och cirkulära lösningar för kontor, hotell, restauranger och offentliga miljöer. Yllw levererar helheten, från rådgivning, design och inköp till leverans, montage, flytt, återbruk och abonnemang. Genom Yllw Factory får möbler nytt liv, och cirkularitet är en självklar del av affären.På fem år har Yllw gått från noll till en omsättning på väg mot en miljard kronor, med lönsamhet från dag ett. Bolaget finns i dag på fyra nordiska marknader, och det är bara början. Siktet är inställt på en betydligt större internationell närvaro. Här är besluten snabba, ansvaret stort och arbetssätt till för att utmanas.Om tjänsten som Finance ManagerSom Finance Manager blir du CFO:s högra hand och tar det operativa ansvaret för ekonomifunktionen. Du leder ett team med en bolagsansvarig, en financial controller och tre redovisningsekonomer. Du är prestigelös och kavlar upp ärmarna när det behövs och är lika hemma i en komplex redovisningsfråga som i ett förändringsprojekt.Ditt uppdrag är att bygga en ekonomifunktion som kan växa internationellt utan att administration och kostnader växer i samma takt. Du får mandat att ifrågasätta hur arbetet görs i dag, att automatisera bort det manuella och att använda AI och ny teknik för att skapa ett försprång.Dina huvudsakliga arbetsuppgifter:    Leda och utveckla ekonomiteamet    Äga kvaliteten i redovisning, bokslut, rapportering och konsolidering i en växande internationell koncern    Driva automatisering och AI-baserade lösningar som tar bort manuellt arbete och gör funktionen skalbar    Bygga gemensamma processer och system som är redo för nästa marknad innan den öppnar    Ta fram analyser och beslutsunderlag tillsammans med CFO som gör affären snabbare och skarpareOm digDu är en skicklig ekonom med gedigen erfarenhet av redovisning och ekonomistyrning, till exempel som ekonomichef, redovisningschef, finance manager eller business controller. Du väntar inte på att någon ska peka ut vad som behöver förbättras eller förändras utan ser det själv och ser till att det händer. jobs.description: [https://images.teamtailor-cdn.com/images/s3/teamtailor-production/original-v3/image_uploads/f5413876-6eaf-de9c-adab-ff01b112497b/original.jpeg]Škoda Brand Store Helsinki on huippuhieno juuri avattu Škodan myyntiin erikoistunut autotalo, joka toimii itsenäisenä jälleenmyyjänä Škoda-maahantuojan Helkama-Auto Oy:n jälleenmyyjäverkostossa ja tarjoaa kaikki autoiluun liittyvät palvelut saman katon alta.HALUATKO TEHDÄ TULOKSELLISTA AUTOKAUPPAA, KASVATTAA OMAA ASIAKASKUNTAASI JA HYÖDYNTÄÄ ŠKODAN KATTAVAN MALLISTON TARJOAMAT MYYNTIMAHDOLLISUUDET?HAEMME ŠKODA-AUTOMYYJIÄ UUSIEN AUTOJEN MYYNTITIIMIINŠKODA BRAND STORE -MYYMÄLÄÄN HELSINGIN HERTTONIEMEEN!Profiilisi:Tunnet paloa myyntityöhön ja onnistuneisiin autokauppoihin. jobs.title: Markkinointi- ja viestintäasiantuntija
jobs.description: Primary location:TUUSULAHaemme markkinointi- ja viestintäasiantuntijaa Meira Novan markkinointi- ja viestintätiimiin. Tässä roolissa vastaat monipuolisesti yrityksemme markkinoinnin ja viestinnän suunnittelusta ja toteutuksesta.Keskeisiä tehtäviäsi ovat markkinointi- ja myyntimateriaalien suunnittelu, tuottaminen ja jalkauttaminen monikanavaisesti, valikoimajaksojen ja sesonkien tuotetietojen koordinointi, verkkosivuston sisältöjen kehittäminen, asiakastapahtumien ja messujen koordinointi sekä sisäinen viestintä. Teet tiivistä yhteistyötä myynnin ja hankinnan sekä mainostoimistokumppaneiden ja toimittajien kanssa ja osallistut markkinoinnin ja viestinnän kehityshankkeisiin. Yhdistät työssäsi kaupallisen ajattelun, luovuuden ja vahvan toteutuskyvyn ja tuet kaupallisen tiimin menestystä ajan hermolla olevalla tuoteviestinnällä.Mitä odotamme sinulta?Sinulla on kokemusta markkinoinnin ja viestinnän laaja-alaisista tehtävistä sekä aktiivinen, asiakaslähtöinen ja oma-aloitteinen työote. Olet järjestelmällinen ja huolellinen, toimit hyvin paineen alla ja työskentelet luontevasti sekä tiimissä että itsenäisesti. Sinulla on hyvä visuaalinen silmä, erinomaiset yhteistyö- ja viestintätaidot sekä kiinnostusta foodservice-toimialaan. Soveltuva kaupallisen alan tai markkinoinnin ja viestinnän korkeakoulututkinto antaa hyvän pohjan tehtävään. Hyödynnät tekoälyä arjessasi ja viestit sujuvasti suomeksi ja englanniksi. Hallitset Adobe InDesignin ja Photoshopin, ja sinulla on kokemusta HubSpotista, projektinhallinnasta.Eduksi katsomme kokemuksen elintarvikealalta tai mainostoimistosta sekä tuotetietojen hallinnasta esimerkiksi GS1 Synkka- tai Akeneo PIM -järjestelmissä. Lisäksi arvostamme valokuvausosaamista sekä Contentfulin ja Canvan tuntemusta.Tule voittavaan joukkueeseenMeira Novan kaupallisessa organisaatiossa, jonka osana markkinointi- ja viestintätiimi toimii, työskentelee noin 50 henkilöä. Tässä joukkueessa taidamme itsenäisen työskentelyn, mutta nautimme siitä, että saamme tehdä toistemme kanssa töitä. Tehtävän huolellinen ja tehokas hoitaminen tuottaa korkeaa asiakastyytyväisyyttä sekä yritysmielikuvamme vahvistumista ja varmistaa osaltaan yksikön tavoitteiden saavuttamista.Työtyytyväisyys on meille tärkeää, ja siksi varmistamme, että työntekijät pääsevät mukaan muutosten suunnitteluun ja toteutukseen. Uskomme, että osallistaminen lisää sitoutumista ja tekee kehityksestä sujuvampaa – yhdessä rakennamme toimivampia ratkaisuja ja parempaa työarkea. Meillä on S-ryhmän monipuoliset henkilöstöedut: https://s-ryhma.fi/tyopaikat/erinomaiset-edutMiltä tämä kaikki vaikutti? Oletko kiinnostunut tästä tehtävästä?Hae tehtävää hakulinkin kautta viimeistään 29.11.2026. Käymme hakemuksia läpi ja haastattelemme hakijoita jo hakuaikana, joten älä odota viime hetkeen.Lisätietoja tehtävästä antaa markkinointipäällikkö Laura Matilainen puh. 010 76 86508. Varmimmin saat Lauran kiinnipe 13.11.2026 klo 14–15 tai pe 20.11.2026 klo 14–15.Osana S-ryhmää toimiva, vuonna 1991 perustettu Meira Nova on Suomen johtavia foodservice-alan tukkukauppoja. Tarjoamme asiakkaillemme luotettavan kumppanuuden, johon on turvallista nojata nyt ja tulevaisuudessa. Palvelemme 250 ammattilaisen voimin ravintoloita, hotelleja, liikenneasemia sekä terveys- ja hoivapalvelusektorin sekä julkishallinnon toimijoita. Logistiikkakeskuksemme sijaitsee Tuusulassa.

jobs.title: Accounts Payable Specialist wanted in Boden
jobs.description: Are you a structured and detail-oriented Accounts Payable Specialist with a passion for order, structure, and efficiency? The position is located in Boden, with the possibility of working remotely two days a week.Your daily tasksIn the role of AP Specialist, you will work in a fast-paced environment where you will be responsible for all parts of the accounts payable process with high accuracy and compliance.These are the main focus tasks:    Manage and drive the accounts payable (AP) process with a focus on accuracy and adherence to internal controls    Work proactively to efficiently and accurately handle and correct historical transactions    Maintain order and structure in AP processes and ensure clear documentation    Adapt to a changing business environment and contribute with problem-solving skills and flexibility    Create stability, focus, and a calm, structured work atmosphere even under high pressureYour characteristicsWe are looking for someone who is highly structured, detail-oriented, and passionate about order and efficiency. You are a flexible thinker who understands the importance of correcting historical transactions and easily adapts to changing business needs. You thrive in a high-tempo, energetic environment where you maintain your focus and contribute calm and stability even in high-pressure situations.Is this a challenge you would like to take on? We look forward to reading your application, welcome with your application today!Qualifications:    Experience working with accounts payable within production, warehouse, or logistics    Fluent in English (written and spoken)Meritorious:    Experience in SAP or Medius is highly advantageousContract type and hoursFull-time, consulting assignment until 2027-11-02. Always enter the reference number 36077 in the subject line. Our vision is to ensure that everyone thrives and feels engaged at work. We have grown steadily since our founding in 2003 and now have over 1,500 employees across the country, including around fifty internal staff at our headquarters in Stockholm and Gothenburg. As a Perido consultant, you’ll play a key role in our organization, growing alongside us while strengthening our clients' businesses with your skills. Please visit our website www.perido.se for more information.

jobs.title: Børnehuset Damgården søger souschef
jobs.description:
I børnehuset Damgården, søger vi ikke bare en souschef, der kan få hverdagen til at hænge sammen. Vi søger en souschef, der har lyst til at gøre en forskel, sætte en faglig retning og skabe rammerne for, at både børn og medarbejder kan lykkes. 

Albertslund er en grøn kommune med store ambitioner. Vi er stolte af vores kommune, og gør os umage i vores opgaver og indsatser for borgerne, foreningerne og virksomhederne. Vi er én kommune og én organisation. Vi har engagerede og dygtige medarbejdere samt en samarbejdskultur, der går på tværs af områder og niveauer. Det gør Albertslund Kommune til et godt sted at arbejde. 

Vil du være med til at sætte retning, skabe stærke fællesskaber og udvikle fremtidens pædagogiske praksis?

Børnehuset Damgården søger en engageret, fagligt stærk og nærværende souschef på 37 timer

Har du både hjerte for børnene, blik for den pædagogiske kvalitet og lyst til ledelse tæt på praksis? Så er det måske dig, vi leder efter.

I Børnehuset Damgården søger vi en souschef, der brænder for pædagogisk udvikling, stærke børnefællesskaber og et arbejdsmiljø, hvor vi sammen lykkes med kerneopgaven

Vi leder efter dig, der er hjertevarm, nysgerrig, reflekterende og modig. Dig, der tør stille spørgsmål, tage ansvar, sætte retning og gå forrest – samtidig med at du formår at skabe følgeskab og få andre til at lykkes.

Hos os bliver du en del af et stærkt arbejdsfællesskab, hvor vi spiller hinanden gode, tager fælles ansvar for det praktiske, sociale, fysiske og psykiske arbejdsmiljø og aldrig glemmer betydningen af et godt grin i hverdagen. Vi tror på, at de bedste resultater skabes sammen – med faglighed, nærvær, engagement og plads til forskellighed.

Velkommen til Damgården – et børnehus fuld af liv, leg og fællesskab.

Børnehuset Damgården er et integreret dagtilbud med børn i alderen 0-6 år. Vi har cirka 130 børn og 30 engagerede medarbejdere.

Vi ser os selv som ét samlet hus, hvor fællesskabet går på tværs af vuggestue og børnehave. Derfor forventer vi også, at alle medarbejdere kan arbejde begge steder, og at vi sammen tager ansvar for hele huset.

Når man træder ind ad døren i Damgården, mødes man af nysgerrige børn, liv, energi og en hverdag fuld af muligheder. Vi tror på, at børn udvikler sig bedst gennem leg, tryghed, forudsigelighed og nærværende voksne, der er tæt på dem.

Vores pædagogiske arbejde bygger på et positivt og respektfuldt børnesyn, hvor vi tager udgangspunkt i det enkelte barns ressourcer, behov og muligheder for deltagelse i fællesskabet.

Vi er optagede af at skabe læringsmiljøer, hvor børn oplever glæden ved samvær, udforskning, leg og relationer – og hvor alle børn får mulighed for at være betydningsfulde deltagere i fællesskabet.

Vi har en ambition – og vi er godt på vej!

I Damgården tror vi på, at god pædagogik ikke opstår af sig selv. Den kræver faglig nysgerrighed, fælles retning, tydelige rammer og medarbejdere, der tør undersøge og udvikle deres praksis.

Vi har derfor et stærkt fokus på struktur og tydelige roller gennem hele dagen. Vi prioriterer at planlægge og organisere hverdagen, så medarbejderne kan bruge deres energi på det vigtigste: samværet med børnene og udviklingen af den pædagogiske kvalitet.

Legen er et særligt fokusområde hos os.

Vi er i gang med et udviklingsforløb, hvor vi styrker vores lege faglige praksis. For os er leg ikke en pause fra læring – leg ER læring, dannelse, relationer og fællesskab.

Vi har et forløb med Kit Nørgaard, som med afsæt i Legepaletten skal inspirere og guide os til at udvikle et fælles fundament for vores legekultur.

Som souschef får du en central rolle i at fastholde, understøtte og videreudvikle denne faglige retning sammen med medarbejderne.

Vi er samtidig privilegerede med et tæt samarbejde med vores praksisfællesskab, som blandt andet består af psykologer, pædagogiske vejledere, logopæder og børneterapeuter. De kommer jævnligt i huset, så vi har mulighed for hurtig sparring, tværfaglig refleksion og kvalificeret støtte i vores pædagogiske processer.

Du bliver en vigtig del af ledelsen – tæt på både mennesker og praksis.

Som souschef bliver du lederens nærmeste samarbejds- og sparringspartner og en central del af den daglige ledelse.

Du får en vigtig rolle i at sætte retning for børnehuset, omsætte faglige ambitioner til konkret pædagogisk praksis og sikre, at vi hele tiden har fokus på kerneopgaven.

Du skal kunne bevæge dig naturligt mellem ledelse, faglig sparring, administrative opgaver og nærvær i hverdagen. Du bliver en faglig rollemodel og en vigtig kulturbærer, der bidrager til både medarbejdernes trivsel og den fortsatte udvikling af vores fælles arbejdsfællesskab.

Vi forventer ikke, at du skal kunne alt fra første dag. Men vi forventer, at du har lyst til at tage ansvar, være nysgerrig og udvikle dig sammen med os.

Dine vigtigste opgaver bliver blandt andet at:

- Drive, koordinere og udvikle pædagogiske og faglige indsatser.

- Være tovholder på udviklingsprocesser både internt og i samarbejde med eksterne samarbejdspartnere.

- Understøtte og videreudvikle vores lege, faglige praksis og læringsmiljøer.

- Sikre høj pædagogisk kvalitet og skabe sammenhæng mellem faglige ambitioner og hverdagspraksis\.

- Samarbejde tæt med vores tværfaglige praksisfællesskab.

- Varetage administrative og ledelsesmæssige opgaver.

- Være en aktiv og konstruktiv sparringspartner i ledelsesteamet.

Der er gode muligheder for, at du sammen med lederen kan få indflydelse på fordelingen af opgaver og ansvarsområder i ledelsesteamet. Vi ønsker at bringe dine kompetencer og styrker bedst muligt i spil.

Vi søger dig, der kan se dig selv i følgende:

- Du er uddannet pædagog og har lyst til at tage næste skridt ind i ledelse.

- Du har stærke pædagogiske kompetencer og et blik for kvalitet i praksis.

- Du er nysgerrig, reflekterende og tør udfordre vaner og stille de vigtige spørgsmål.

- Du er robust, handlekraftig og kan træffe beslutninger, når det er nødvendigt.

- Du er en naturlig tovholder, der kan samle trådene, skabe overblik og sikre fremdrift.

- Du møder børn, forældre og medarbejdere med anerkendelse, empati og respekt.

- Du er tydelig, nærværende og aktiv i din ledelsesstil.

- Du arbejder struktureret og kan navigere i en hverdag med mange opgaver og forskellige perspektiver.

- Du har gode samarbejdsevner og kan skabe følgeskab omkring fælles mål.

- Du ser værdien i at lykkes sammen og bidrager aktivt til et positivt arbejdsmiljø.

Allervigtigst er det, at du har lyst til at gøre en forskel – for børnene, medarbejderne og fællesskabet.

I Albertslund Kommune arbejder vi målrettet for at skabe stærkere og mere inkluderende fællesskaber i dagtilbud, skoler og fritidstilbud.

Ambitionen er, at flere børn skal trives, udvikle sig og lære i de almene fællesskaber med den rette støtte tæt på hverdagen.

Det kræver stærke pædagogiske læringsmiljøer, tidlige og forebyggende indsatser, kompetente medarbejdere og et tæt samarbejde på tværs af faggrupper.

Som souschef i Damgården bliver du en vigtig medspiller i denne ambition. Du får mulighed for at præge udviklingen og være med til at skabe rammer, hvor endnu flere børn oplever deltagelse, mestring, trivsel og udvikling.

Kan du se dig selv i Damgården?  Så glæder vi os til at høre fra dig!

Vi håber, at du har fået lyst til at blive en del af vores fællesskab og være med til at sætte retning for et børnehus, hvor faglighed, nærvær, leg og arbejdsglæde går hånd i hånd.

Har du spørgsmål til stillingen, hverdagen eller ønsker du at høre mere om vores ambitioner og forventninger, er du meget velkommen til at kontakte:

Leder Linda Borch Haugaard på mail: idx@albertslund\.dk eller Telefon: 24 46 75 28

Ansøgningsfrist: 6. december 2026 kl. 12.00.  Stillingen er ledig fra den 1. januar 2027 eller snarest derefter. Vi afholder samtaler løbende.

Vi afholder samtaler løbende.

Arbejdssted: Børnehuset Damgården Damgårdsvej 18-22, 2620 Albertslund Lønindplacering sker efter forhandling mellem kommunen og den forhandlingsberettigede organisation.Det er en del af Albertslund Kommunes ansættelsespolitik at fremme mangfoldighed og ligestilling.Det er en forudsætning for din ansættelse i Albertslund Kommune, at du har en gyldig arbejds- og opholdstilladelse. Albertslund Kommune har røgfri arbejdstid.

Albertslund Kommune støtter positivt op omkring fuldtidsindsatsen i henhold til Trepartsaftalen om Løn og arbejdsvilkår, og kommunen ansætter derfor som altovervejende udgangspunkt på 37 timer. 

Velkommen til Albertslund - den bæredygtige by for børnene, det grønne og fællesskaber. Albertslund Kommune har mange kvaliteter, som skaber fantastiske rammer for hverdagslivet – både for borgere og medarbejdere. Midt i naturen og med et rigt forenings- og kulturliv, som børn og voksne cykler til og fra på byens mange kilometer cykelstier, der er adskilt fra bilerne på vejene. Der er S-tog lige til døren og flere supercykelstier, bl.a. mellem Albertslund og Vesterport i hjertet af København. Desuden skaber letbanen gode forbindelser til hele hovedstadsområdet. 

I Albertslund Kommune har vi samme tilgang til vores opgaver, som vi selv ville ønske at opleve som borgere. Vi er vidt forskellige, men er fælles om vores opgave for borgere, foreninger og virksomheder. Du kan møde nogle af vores dygtige medarbejdere på www.albertslund.dk/indefra og få et indtryk af bredden af arbejdsområder, opgaver og fagligheder i Albertslund Kommune. 

I Albertslund Kommune er der højt til loftet og gode udviklingsmuligheder - vi glæder os til at høre fra dig.

jobs.title: Software Developer for Test Framework (Python)
jobs.description: Are you a Python programmer? Are you driven by system-level challenges? Join the Software Test Solutions at Westermo as a Software Developer!Are you our next Software Developer?Software Test Solutions develops our in-house test framework, which is used to test our products, and plays a critical role in ensuring product quality and reliability. Many teams rely on the accuracy of our test results, which makes our work essential for validating our products against their specifications.We are looking for a software developer who thrives in an agile environment and wants to be part of a team that builds and maintains this framework and its tools. The framework is used for system-level testing of our products in network solutions, running on dedicated test systems.Our department is made up of two teams: the Test Framework team (the role described here), which schedules and runs tests, processes the test results and maintains the test systems, and the Test Developer team, which develops and maintains tests for our operating system WeOS. We promote close collaboration between the two teams, so your work won't necessarily stay limited to the framework – there's plenty of room to explore and contribute across both.In your role, you will be:    Programming primarily in Python (and Go), working with tools such as Docker and Kubernetes.    Analysing test results and troubleshooting and refining the framework to keep it reliable.    Maintaining and developing the test systems, with the devices under test, that the framework relies on.    Extending the framework to support new WeOS functionality.    Developing the next generation of our test framework to meet future demands on scalability, including virtual testing, and reduced complexity for end users.    Working with both front-end and back-end development of the web interfaces for configuration and visualization of test results.We think about automation in everything we do, and we are always trying out new technologies that help us meet current and future demands. We use Jira for planning and tracking work, and keep improving our Agile methods. AI is also a natural part of our daily software work, and we are exploring how to put it to even better use.So, who are we looking for?You have an academic background in computer science or similar, and you’re motivated by solving real problems with smart solutions. We value teamwork, and hope you do, too. You enjoy both technical development and team collaboration, and you share your knowledge just as readily as you ask for help. You are curious and innovative, comfortable in an agile environment, and like to try, test, and learn with colleagues.Further, we want you to be:    Experienced in Python development and eager to deepen your skills.    Comfortable working in a Linux environment.    Familiar with software engineering tools such as source code management, CI/CD, containers, and web development (front-end and/or back-end).    Interested in networking technologies.    Fluent in English and Swedish.Oh, and don't worry, if you're not an expert in all the things described – you'll learn.In return, we offer: You will be working at the forefront of technology in a friendly, open culture where you get the opportunity to learn from skilled colleagues every day. A mature and caring leadership in a flat organization. Through our collective bargain agreement you will be covered in terms of insurance, pension and other benefits. We like to have fun together and we regularly enjoy sports and other social activities as a team. We believe that magic happens when people meet. We are a learning organization and we truly love to try new things, think outside the box and be innovative together!Basic information:    Location: Kopparlunden, Västerås    Job type: Full time    Employment contract: PermanentDon’t miss out on this opportunity – apply today! We look forward to meeting you!For further information please contact:Hiring Manager: Alexander Falk at alexander.falk@westermo.comRecruiter: Elin Sandell at elin.sandell@westermo.comAbout Westermo:Welcome to a rapidly growing international company, thriving at the forefront of cutting edge technology. Westermo develops and manufactures advanced devices for industrial data communication, used in mission-critical installations and harsh industrial environments. The very robust and secure communication networks built with our products provide a high value for our customers.We are focused on leveraging growth opportunities in our market and are devoted to delivering the world's best industrial networks. This is achieved through a very dynamic work environment where teamwork and loyalty are valued. Strong and honest relationships with colleagues, customers, and suppliers are important to us. We have an open culture where we share knowledge, learn from one another and explore new ideas, allowing us to constantly improve.Westermo is a leading provider of Industrial Data Communications equipment to the global market. Sales are conducted through our own offices in key markets in Europe, North America, Australia and Asia, as well as through distributors and OEM customers worldwide. Development and manufacturing take place in Sweden, Ireland, Germany and Switzerland. Westermo was founded in 1975 and today has over 580 employees with a turnover of around 1.4 Billion SEK. The company is a wholly owned subsidiary of Ependion, listed on the Nasdaq OMX Nordic stock exchange.

jobs.description: We are seeking a Senior Buyer for an international company in the powertrain industry. This role offers the opportunity to develop sourcing strategies and supplier partnerships for engine systems and accessories in a technically complex environment.Working alongside procurement colleagues in Europe and Asia, you will collaborate with stakeholders across R&D, business strategy, manufacturing, logistics, supplier quality and aftermarket. Your focus will be to secure production materials that meet quality, cost and delivery requirements while supporting competitive powertrain solutions.The position combines strategic sourcing with day-to-day purchasing responsibilities. You will also have opportunities to contribute beyond your core area, broaden your expertise and develop professionally.Your responsibilities    Lead and develop purchasing activities for base engine components.    Identify and implement cost-saving opportunities.    Act as the primary commercial contact for suppliers.    Conduct market benchmarking and supplier assessments.    Manage strategic sourcing activities and commercial negotiations.    Collaborate with internal stakeholders to align purchasing decisions with business and technical needs.    Manage purchase orders, agreements and related documentation.    Develop and optimise the supplier base to strengthen performance and long-term value.Your profileYou are commercially minded, results-oriented and comfortable working with complex challenges. You identify opportunities, propose practical solutions and constructively challenge established approaches.You build effective working relationships and bring integrity, accountability and a collaborative approach to your work. You can manage several projects simultaneously, set clear priorities and deliver against agreed objectives. With bases in Sweden and Spain, we offer a unique combination of local expertise and global reach. Our strong network and deep industry insights make us the obvious partner for companies looking to stay ahead in their recruitment efforts.

jobs.title: Specialistläkare Allmänmedicin, Ålidhems Hälsocentral, Umeå
jobs.description: Region Västerbotten arbetar för att god hälsa och hållbar utveckling ska stärka varandra. Vi tar ansvar för en jämlik välfärd och för att forskning och innovation ger resultat.Region Västerbotten bedriver bred primärvårdsverksamhet inom hela Västerbottens län och möter patienter i alla åldrar, både i tätort och glesbygd. Med 33 hälsocentraler och sjukstugor finns vi där du finns. Vi arbetar aktivt med forskning och utveckling och tar tillvara medicinska resultat för att erbjuda vård med hög kvalitet där patienten är delaktig. Vi vill att våra medarbetare ska vara delaktiga, ha inflytande och känna stolthet över att arbeta i primärvården. Viktiga utvecklingsområden för oss är behovsanpassat vårdutbud och utveckla digitala tjänster. Vi ser ett stort värde i samarbete med andra aktörer i samhället.Primärvårdsområde Öst i Umeå är en basenhet bestående av Ålidhems och Holmsund/Obbolas hälsocentraler. Ålidhems hälsocentral är belägen på Tvistevägen nära Ålidhems centrum, Umeå universitet samt Iksu sportanläggning. Hälsocentralen har ca 22 700 listade invånare i ett varierat upptagningsområde med generellt ung befolkning. Här arbetar ca 97 medarbetare på hälsocentralen som även innefattar familjecentralen vid Ålidhems centrum och paramedicinsk mottagning på Tvistevägen 48 i Tietohusen.Nu söker vi en ny kollega till vårt läkarteam på Ålidhems hälsocentral. Vi är en stor läkargrupp som besitter en hög och varierande kompetens inom området allmänmedicin. Hos oss finns styrkan och fördelarna i att vara en stor hälsocentral samtidigt som vi har en nära och prestigelös relation mellan oss som jobbar på hälsocentralen. Samarbete och aktiv dialog kring förbättringsområden är något vi värderar högt. Vi erbjuder en varierande och utvecklande arbetsplats med tydligt patientfokus. Denna tjänst innebär ett särskilt riktat uppdrag mot äldrevård. Vi jobbar nu med att ta fram ett nytt arbetssätt som möjliggör utveckling av verksamheten, stärker samarbetet med andra yrkeskategorier samt skapar en mer strukturerad och effektiv arbetsvardag. Genom att arbeta på nya sätt kan vi ta tillvara på våra gemensamma kompetenser, tydliggöra ansvar och roller samt skapa bättre förutsättningar för kommunikation och samverkan.1 plats(er). ARBETSUPPGIFTERSom specialistläkare hos oss bidrar du med kunskap och engagemang som får människor att känna sig trygga.Denna tjänst innebär ett riktat uppdrag mot äldrevård där du har ett ansvarsområde som är viktig del av hälso- och sjukvården och primärvårdens uppdrag. Det innebär att du en majoritet av arbetstiden  med hemsjukvårdspatienter samt mot äldreboende.  Arbetet innebär ett nära samarbete med sjuksköterskor från äldreboende och hemsjukvården i Umeå kommun. En mindre del av arbetstiden är sedvanligt arbete på hälsocentralen, där du kan möta individer av olika åldrar och med skiftande hälsoproblem. Som specialist förväntas du stötta läkare som är under utbildning i deras löpande arbete samt handleda vid avsatt handledningstid. Du förväntas även vara en aktiv del i läkargruppens och hälsocentralens möten, dialoger och förbättringsarbeten. Jourtjänstgöring på primärvårdsakuten och primärvårdsbakjour ingår i arbetet.KVALIFIKATIONERFör detta jobb behöver du vara specialistläkare inom allmänmedicin eller geriatrik. Du kan även söka om du är i slutskedet på din ST-tjänstgöring inom allmänmedicin alternativt geriatrik. Intresse för handledning av studenter och utbildningsläkare är viktigt. Vi ser även att du har ett intresse för äldrevård. Det är meriterande om du har erfarenhet av att ha arbetat mot särskilda boenden samt med hemsjukvård. Du är en närvarande och positiv person som med kunskap och omsorg ser patienten och kan anpassa vården efter det behov som finns. Du tycker om att samarbeta och att finnas där för andra människor, både patienter och kollegor. Du fungerar väl i de arbetssätt som krävs inom primärvården och får din arbetsdag att fungera utifrån det åtagande som förväntas av en specialistläkare. Du ser möjligheter och kan hantera din arbetsdag även de gånger som patienttrycket är högt genom att du självständigt kan ta beslut i de frågor du ställs inför.Vi kräver goda kunskaper i svenska språket.Anställningsform: Tillsvidareanställning.Varaktighet: Tillsvidare, tillträde: Tillträde enligt överenskommelse.Läs mer om våra förmåner för dig som jobbar med oss på webbsidan https://www.regionvasterbotten.se/nar-du-jobbar-hos-oss/formanerVi strävar efter en jämn könsfördelning och ser mångfald som en styrka och välkomnar därför sökande med olika bakgrund.Inför rekryteringsarbetet har vi tagit ställning till rekryteringskanaler och marknadsföring. Vi undanbeder oss därför bestämt kontakt med mediesäljare, rekryteringssajter och liknande.Om du har skyddad identitet och vill ansöka så kontaktar du rekryterande chef och skickar sedan in dina ansökningshandlingar via post.

jobs.title: Order Fulfillment Export Coordinator
jobs.description: Company description:Epiroc is a leading productivity partner for the mining, infrastructure and natural resources industries. With cutting-edge technology, Epiroc develops and produces innovative drill rigs, rock excavation and construction equipment, and provides world-class service and consumables. The company was founded in Stockholm, Sweden, and has passionate people supporting and collaborating with customers in more than 150 countries. Learn more at www.epirocgroup.com.Job description: Would you like to work at the centre of an international supply chain, coordinating orders, exports and transportation across global markets? Join us as an Order Fulfillment Export Coordinator and take on a varied role where collaboration, accuracy and your ability to keep things moving make a real difference.   Join our team    We are looking for an Order Fulfillment Export Coordinator to join our Order Fulfillment team in Örebro.     Our Global/Regional Distribution Center in Ghent is a logistics provider within Epiroc Supply Chain in the Tools division. Our task is to manage and develop a high-quality and cost-effective supply chain for our customers, including distribution of spare parts and aftermarket products for our PSD and RGD divisions, as well as orders and delivery of rock drilling equipment. Goods are shipped from our third-party warehouse (3PL) in Ghent, and our primary goal is to help our Customer Centers succeed through high-quality deliveries on time.   Your mission As an Order Fulfillment Export Coordinator, you will manage customer orders throughout the order fulfilment process and make sure that deliveries are prepared and shipped according to established schedules. You will coordinate several activities simultaneously and maintain close communication with both internal and external stakeholders. Each team member is primarily responsible for a number of Customer Centers (sales companies), and you will act as a logistics coordinator from order received to delivery, including invoicing and shipping of spare parts.    Your responsibilities will include: Managing customer orders and monitoring them throughout the fulfilment process. Ensuring that goods are shipped according to schedule. Handling export, invoicing and shipping of spare parts, from order received to delivery. Coordinating transport bookings across different modes of transportation. Ensuring that export documentation and customs clearance are completed correctly and on time. Keeping customers and sales companies updated with accurate and timely information. Communicating with the 3PL, freight forwarders, customs brokers, logistics partners and internal functions. Taking responsibility for orders connected to an assigned group of countries. Contributing to collaboration, knowledge sharing and continuous improvement within the team.               The role combines independent responsibility with teamwork. You will be expected to take ownership of your area while actively supporting colleagues and asking for assistance when needed.  Profile description:  Your profileYou are structured, attentive to detail and comfortable managing several activities at the same time. Because you will work with international shipments and export documentation, you understand the importance of accuracy and following through on commitments.   You communicate clearly and enjoy building relationships with different stakeholders. You are comfortable working independently and taking responsibility for your own tasks, while also contributing to a supportive and collaborative team environment. We believe you have:   A university degree, vocational qualification or equivalent education within logistics, supply chain, business administration, economics or a related field.A good understanding of logistics, order management or international transportation. Experience from logistics, distribution and customer orders. The ability to communicate effectively with both internal and external stakeholders. A structured and responsible approach, with strong attention to detail. Experience with IT tools such as Word and Excel. Good written and spoken English. Desirable: trade compliance and customs knowledge, and knowledge of the M3 business system.    Previous experience from logistics, export, customer service, order management or transportation is beneficial, but not essential. We welcome applications from both recent graduates and candidates with relevant professional experience. You do not need to know our internal systems when you join, as you will receive training and support from the team    Location and other This position is located in Örebro, Sweden. The role is daytime-based and offers the possibility of hybrid work up to two days per week.      The team is currently based at Holmen in Örebro and is expected to relocate to Epiroc’s new distribution center in Pilängen during the summer.   We offer:   Application and contact information    We encourage you to submit your application through our online career site as soon as possible, but no later than November 25, 2026.     We are committed to a thorough recruitment process, including interviews, reference checks and assessments. To ensure a safe working environment, we conduct identity checks and drug and alcohol screening. Our process is designed to be fair and inclusive; you can expect transparent communication and a balanced evaluation of your skills and experience.

jobs.title: Technical Sales Manager, Finland / Nordic region
jobs.description:
Are you ready to grow a business and make a difference in plant health?

Lallemand Plant Care is looking for a commercially driven and technically skilled Technical Sales Manager to lead business development across Sweden, Denmark and Norway.

This is an exciting opportunity for a professional who combines a passion for agriculture and plant health with strong sales capabilities and a strategic business mindset. You will play a key role in expanding Lallemands market presence and bringing innovative microorganism-based plant protection and biofertilizer products to distributors, growers and industry partners.

Your role and key responsibilities

 * Principle contact to sales for Lallemand Plant Care customers in assigned territory.
 * Take ownership of the annual sales budget and maximize sales growth.
 * Build and strengthen long-term relationships with existing and new customers.
 * Lead commercial negotiations with distributors, strategic partners and key accounts.
 * Identify new business opportunities, monitor market trends and translate customer needs into growth opportunities.
 * Collaborate with sales, marketing, regulatory and field solutions teams to ensure consistent market offering and high customer satisfaction.
 * Report on business development and sales performance regularly to the Commercial Director.

Be a trusted technical partner

 * Manage and provide technical support to customers, including support for product demonstrations and field trials.
 * Deliver customer training and technical presentations, helping customers understand product performance and best practices.
 * Represent Lallemand Plant Care at industry events, trade shows and professional forums.

What will help you succeed?

We are looking for an experienced professional who understands the micro-organism-based solutions market and knows how to turn technical expertise into commercial success.

You will ideally bring:

 * A bachelors or masters degree in agricultural sciences or a related field. Additional qualifications in business, management or plant protection are an advantage.
 * At least 10 years of relevant professional experience, including proven success in technical sales and business development within the agricultural input sector.
 * A strong understanding of agricultural markets, distribution channels and commercial business practices.
 * Excellent sales, negotiation and business development skills.
 * An established network within the agricultural input industry is an advantage.
 * Fluency in English and Swedish – Finnish and other Scandinavian language skills are a bonus.
 * Proficiency with Microsoft 365 tools.

In addition

You are likely to thrive in this role if you are:

 * Entrepreneurial and self-motivated, with a strong drive to achieve results.
 * Adaptable and curious, willing to learn quickly and embrace new challenges.
 * Collaborative and communicative, able to build trust with customers and colleagues.
 * Reliable and honest, with a strong work ethic and a commitment to delivering on promises.

What to expect

 * A regional role with responsibility for business growth across Sweden, Denmark and Norway.
 * The opportunity to combine commercial leadership with technical expertise in plant care.
 * Close collaboration with customers, distributors and cross-functional teams.
 * A hybrid working arrangement.
 * Travel of up to approximately 50% of working time, mainly within Nordic territory, with occasional international travel for training and meetings.

A valid passport and driving license are required. The role also involves occasional visits to agricultural, field and factory environments.

How to get more information about the position 

For further information about the position, please email professional@visiohr.fi  or contact Visio Professionals Talent Managers Sanna Majava, tel. +358 45 860 7556 or Tarja Laakso, tel. +358 45 858 8441.

About Lallemand Plant Care

Lallemand is a privately held Canadian company founded in the late 19th century, which develops, produces, and markets microorganisms for various markets. Lallemand Plant Care brings value to growers through innovative microorganism-based solutions for agriculture, horticulture, forestry, and turf. From selecting the right strains to delivering high-quality products and application expertise, we focus on solutions growers can trust. Our broad portfolio is designed to integrate easily into existing practices and address specific challenges. Read more: Lallemand Plant Care  or Lallemand Finland Oy 

Visio Professional

Visio Professional is a recruitment company specialising in professional and white-collar recruitment. It is part of the Visio Group, established in 2020. We are constantly looking for talented professionals across a wide range of industries and experience levels, from entry-level positions to senior roles. We take a personal approach to recruitment and strive to find solutions that benefit both candidates and employers. Whether you are at the beginning of your career or an experienced professional, we are here to help you find a role that matches your skills and expertise.

jobs.title: Scientist / Process Engineer Pharmaceutical Manufacturing
jobs.description: Do you have a passion for manufacturing technology and a practical, engineering mindset? Are you motivated by hands-on problem solving and interested in developing and optimizing processes for the next generation of oral medicines? Then this could be the role for you.Pharmaceutical Technology & Development (PT&D) develops drug products and technologies to support new medicines from development through scale-up and transfer to commercial manufacturing. Within PT&D, Global Product Development (GPD) develops oral, inhaled and parenteral drug products, working to turn innovative science into medicines for patients.Continuous Direct Compression (CDC) is a key technology for oral drug development at AstraZeneca, enabling the development of sustainable oral products for commercialization. We are now looking for a Scientist / Process Engineer to join the Process Technology and Engineering team within GPD, based at our Gothenburg site in Sweden. In this role, you will work with CDC technology and contribute to its development and the next generation of oral medicines.AccountabilitiesWe are developing Phase 3 and commercial-ready CDC manufacturing technology and are looking for an engineer or scientist who is eager to further develop their expertise in this area.In this hands-on role, you will operate, troubleshoot and optimize CDC equipment, prepare associated technical documentation, and develop towards becoming an expert in CDC technology and the mechanical operation of the CDC line. You will contribute directly to product delivery and provide key data and insights to our drug development projects.You will bring a passion for manufacturing and process technology, a hands-on approach to problem solving, and the curiosity to find new ways to optimize and maximize the use of the equipment.You will also play an active part in GPD's journey to become an agile, digital-first organization that harnesses data, models and AI to accelerate development, elevate quality and deliver sustainable productivity.You will:    Act as a GPD expert on the CDC process, working with and sharing knowledge across project teams to support delivery of the drug project portfolio.    Assemble, operate, troubleshoot, disassemble, and clean CDC equipment.    Ensure all work is performed safely and in accordance with applicable quality systems and procedures.    Develop and optimize robust manufacturing processes and technologies, using experimental and process data to understand and improve process and equipment performance.    Prepare technical documentation and formal reports in line with current standards and, where appropriate, GLP (Good Laboratory Practice) and GMP (Good Manufacturing Practice).    Support the development and implementation of manufacturing processes and technologies for control strategy, scale-up, marketing applications, technology transfer to commercial manufacturing sites, and launch.    Assess and interpret technical and process data and communicate conclusions and recommendations to project teams, within GPD and across other functions.    Work flexibly and prioritize effectively, applying a continuous improvement mindset and contributing to improvement projects.    Continuously develop your technical expertise while sharing knowledge and supporting the development of others.    Contribute to the development, validation, and use of CDC process models and digital twins to support product development and technology transfer.    Generate and structure high-quality CDC process data in line with GPD data standards, supporting FAIR and AI-ready data for reuse in data products and models.    Act as a Digital champion for CDC team by applying a digital-first mindset, including the appropriate use of GenAI and digital tools, to improve efficiency and ways of working.Essential skills & experience    MSc or equivalent in pharmaceutical sciences, chemical engineering or related discipline.    Recent and substantial hands-on experience assembling, operating, troubleshooting and cleaning manufacturing equipment in a laboratory, pilot-scale or manufacturing environment.    Experience working in GLP, GMP or similarly regulated environments, with a strong focus on safety, quality systems, and accurate documentation.    Strong knowledge of formulation and process development for oral solid dosage forms, including how material properties and process parameters affect product quality.    Strong communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to interpret technical and process data, communicate clear conclusions and recommendations to cross-functional project teams, and prioritize flexibly to deliver project objectives.Desirable skills & experience    Experience with continuous manufacturing, ideally Continuous Direct Compression (CDC), including Process Analytical Technology (PAT) and real-time process monitoring and control.    Demonstrated practical experience with engineering tools, data analysis and digital modelling, for example process modelling, statistics, Python or MATLAB, to analyze and understand process performance.    Experience with, or a strong interest in, applying AI, GenAI and data-driven approaches to scientific or engineering work.    Experience of scale-up and technology transfer to commercial manufacturing sites, including contributing to regulatory submissions.    Familiarity with continuous improvement methodologies, such as Lean or Six Sigma. Are you ready to develop your expertise in Continuous Direct Compression and contribute to the future of oral drug development? Apply today and join us in Gothenburg. We welcome your application by 22 November 2026. Please submit your application as soon as possible, as we will review applications and conduct interviews on an ongoing basis throughout the application period.

jobs.title: Erfaren kosmetisk sygeplejerske søges til barselsvikariat med mulighed for fast ansættelse hos Klinik Nygaard
jobs.description:
Vil du være en del af et af markedets dygtigste teams inden for avanceret æstetisk hudpleje og kosmetiske behandlinger? Og brænder du lige som os for hud og kosmetiske behandlinger med høj faglighed? Så skal du læse med her.

 

Vi søger nu en dygtig, ambitiøs og engageret kosmetisk sygeplejerske til et barselsvikariat på 20-30 timer om ugen med opstart den 1. april. For den rette kandidat er der gode muligheder for forlængelse eller fast ansættelse efter vikariatets udløb.

 

Om klinikken

Vi er en veletableret og anerkendt klinik beliggende på Bredgade 45, i Herning. Vi kendt for at være et erfarent team med høje faglige standarder. Vores team består af en dygtig dermatolog, to erfarne kosmetiske sygeplejersker, en kosmetolog samt en tilknyttet webshop. Vi har en hyggelig hverdag hvor vi sammen arbejder ud fra en fælles vision om at levere behandlinger af absolut højeste kvalitet i et sikkert og trygt miljø. Vores omgangstone er uformel og hyggelig, mens vores faglige ambitioner er høje.

Vores ønsker til dig:

  • At du gerne har omkring 1-2 års erfaring eller mere inden for det kosmetiske felt og er vant til at arbejde selvstændigt.

  • At du mestre og har stor rutine inden for botox og filler

  • At du altid arbejder sikkert og ansvarligt, og har høje krav til dig selv, når det gælder æstetiske resultater.

  • At du er udadvendt og bidrager til det gode samarbejde i teamet.

  • At du har gode kommunikations- og samarbejdsevner.

  • Det er et kæmpe plus, hvis du har erfaring med behandlinger som IPL, kemisk peeling, microneedling, karbehandling og PRF-behandlinger. (Bemærk: Der er gode muligheder for yderligere oplæring og kompetenceudvikling hos os).

Vi tilbyder:

  • Et spændende og udfordrende barselsvikariat på 20-30 timer om ugen med mulighed for forlængelse eller fast ansættelse.

  • Opstart pr. 1. april.

  • En attraktiv løn, der modsvarer dine kvalifikationer.

  • Et sikkert, trygt og professionelt arbejdsmiljø med erfarne og engagerede kolleger.

  • Rig mulighed for faglig og personlig udvikling samt grundig introduktion.

  • Gode personalefordele (bl.a. fordelagtige rabatter på klinikkens produkter og behandlinger).

 

Ansøgning og kontakt

Hvis du deler vores passion og kan se dig selv i denne stilling, vil vi meget gerne høre fra dig. Vigtigt: Vi indkalder til samtaler løbende, så stillingen kan blive besat før ansøgningsfristen udløber. Send derfor din ansøgning snarest muligt.

jobs.title: Research assistant on vegetation-atmosphere interactions
jobs.description: Department of Soil and EnvironmentA 2-month research assistant position is available in the Soil and Environmental Physics group at the Department of Soil and Environment, Swedish University of Agricultural Sciences (SLU), in Uppsala. We are looking for a researcher with interest in vegetation-atmosphere interactions, in particular using eddy-covariance data. We offer a stimulating research environment with opportunities to collaborate with soil scientists and ecologists, within SLU, in Sweden and internationally).About the positionAs a research assistant in the project, you will be expected to drive independent research, including data collection from online databases and statistical data analyses, writing scientific papers in collaboration with the project group and external collaborators, and presenting research results at seminars and conferences.Your profileWe are seeking a highly motivated postdoctoral researcher with excellent skills and experience in collection, harmonization, and statistical analysis of eddy covariance data on carbon fluxes. We are particularly interested in candidates able to link eddy covariance data to remote sensing products.Given the nature of the research project, we expect the selected candidate to be able to interact with soil scientists, ecologists, and biogeochemists. Experience in publishing in highly ranked scientific journals in English is also important.About usThe Department of Soil and Environment is a leading soil research institution, both nationally and internationally. Our research focuses on fundamental soil properties and processes, as well as how soil functions are affected by changes in environmental conditions, including climate change. Through research, environmental analysis and education, we contribute knowledge about future sustainable land use and develop new solutions as a basis for decision-making in agriculture, forestry and the urban environment. The working environment at the department is international and we have around 100 employees.Our research is carried out in seven subject groups with a focus on Soil Biology, Soil Nutrient Cycling, Soil Chemistry, Agricultural Water Management, Soil and Environmental Physics, Soil Mechanics and Soil Management, and the Biogeochemistry of Forest Soils. We are responsible for important research infrastructure in the form of soil chemistry and soil physics laboratories, an X-ray scanner, long-term field experiments, a lysimeter facility, and the field research stations at Lanna and Lövsta. The Department participates in approximately 30 courses at undergraduate and advanced level.We are a part of the Soil, Water and Environment Center at SLU (MVM-center), which provides links to research on water systems, recycling and bioenergy. Our work is aligned to national environmental and climate goals as well as to the Sustainable Development Goals. We are situated at Campus Ultuna in Uppsala and in Skara. Read more about the department here (https://www.slu.se/en/departments/soil-environment/).Read more about our benefits and working at SLU by visiting: https://www.slu.se/en/about-slu/work-at-slu/Location:UppsalaForm of employment:Temporary substitute employment 2 monthsScope:100%Start date:As agreed. Application:Please submit your application before deadline 25 November 2026. Applications cannot be submitted through the recruitment system on 20–22 November due to a system update.You can submit your application by clicking the button below.Union representatives:https://internt.slu.se/en/my-employment/employee-associations/kontaktpersoner-vid-rekrytering/ The Swedish University of Agricultural Sciences (SLU) has a key role in the development for sustainable life, based on science and education. Through our focus on the interaction between humans, animals and ecosystems and the responsible use of natural resources, we contribute to sustainable societal development and good living conditions on our planet. Our main campuses are located in Alnarp, Umeå and Uppsala, however, the university also operates at research stations, experimental forests and teaching sites throughout Sweden. SLU has around 4,000 employees, 6,000 students and doctoral students and a turnover of over SEK 4,5 billion. We are investing in attractive environments on all of our campuses. We strive to provide a work environment characterised by inclusivity and gender equality, where different experiences generate conversations between people and pave the way for science, creativity and development. Therefore, we welcome applications from people with diverse backgrounds and perspectives.

jobs.title: PhD Fellow in Evolutionary Biochemistry
jobs.employer: UNIVERSITETET I TROMSØ - NORGES ARKTISKE UNIVERSITET UIT CAMPUS TROMSØ
jobs.description:
The position

A 4-year PhD position in Evolutionary Biochemistry is available at the Department of Medical Biology, Faculty of Health Sciences, within the Host–Microbe Interaction (HMI) research group. The position is part of the LacZymes project, led by Dr. Christopher Frøhlich.

General information about the position.

The position is for a period of four years. The nominal length of the PhD programme is three years. The fourth year is distributed as 25 % each year and will consist of teaching and other duties. The objective of the position is to complete research training to the level of a doctoral degree. Admission to the PhD programme is a prerequisite for employment, and the programme period starts on commencement of the position.

The workplace is at UiT in Tromsø. You must be able to start in the position within a reasonable time after receiving the offer.

The project 

Do you hold a Master’s degree in molecular biology (or a related field) and have a strong interest in the molecular mechanisms underlying antibiotic resistance development? Are you motivated to conduct interdisciplinary research at one of the northernmost universities in the world? If so, this PhD position may be of interest to you.

The successful candidate will join a project aiming to uncover the molecular mechanisms of AMR evolution at the enzymatic level. To address this, the project integrates ancestral sequence reconstruction, directed evolution, pre-steady-state and steady-state enzyme kinetics, and X-ray crystallography. Candidates with experience in one or more of these areas are encouraged to apply.

The PhD candidate will report to Dr. Christopher Frøhlich and is expected to contribute actively to the project while developing expertise at the interface of molecular biology, enzymology, and evolutionary biology.

The PhD candidate will work on the following tasks: 

  • Manage their own research project
  • Experimental design and execution
  • Enzyme evolution and selection
  • Enzyme production and purification
  • Biochemical enzyme characterization
  • Structural and functional characterization
  • Writing scientific papers and a PhD thesis
  • Presenting the work in national and international arenas

Personal characteristics:The applicant should be motivated, creative and ambitious, with a strong ability to work problem-solution orientated both in teams and independently. The applicant should be genuinely interested in the field of molecular evolution and AMR as well as scientific dissemination. In the evaluation of which applicant is best qualified, emphasis will be placed on education, experience, and personal suitability, in terms of the qualification requirements specified in this position announcement. The appointment is to be made in accordance with the regulations in force concerning State Employees and Civil Servants and national guidelines for appointment as PhD fellow

Applicants are required to submit a motivation letter describing how the position aligns with their research interests.

Contact

For further information about the position, please contact Dr. Christopher Frøhlich:

  • phone: +47 46 96 87 78
  • email: christopher.frohlich@uit.no
Qualifications

Required qualifications

  • Master’s degree in molecular biology, microbiology, chemistry or equivalent education, with a grade of C or better. Candidates who have not yet completed their Master’s education must submit a written statement from their main supervisor stating the tentative date of their Master’s defence.
  • Experience in at least two of the following areas: molecular cloning, protein expression and purification, biochemical characterization of enzymes (e.g. kinetic investigations), X-ray crystallography
  • Documented oral and written English skills

Applicants must document fluency of in English and be able to work in an international environment. Nordic applicants can document their English capabilities by attaching their high school diploma.  Working knowledge of Norwegian or a Scandinavian language is also beneficial.

Preferred qualifications

  • Experience in the field of AMR and AMR mechanisms
  • Experience in coding (e.g. Python) and competence with computer-based analytical tools (e.g., Pymol)
  • Knowledge of a Scandinavian language
  • Experience in writing publications
  • Experience in a biosafety level-2 laboratory environment

In the assessment, the emphasis is on the applicant's potential to complete a research education based on the master's thesis or equivalent, and any other scientific work. (The motivation letter will also be considered.) In addition, professional experience and other experience of significance for the completion of the doctoral programme will be taken into consideration.

We will also emphasize motivation and personal suitability for the position. We are looking for candidates who:

  • Have good collaboration skills
  • Have good communication and interaction with colleagues and students
  • Wants to contribute to a good working environment

As many people as possible should have the opportunity to undertake organized research training. If you already hold a PhD or have equivalent competence, we will not appoint you to this position.

Admission to the PhD programme 

For employment in the PhD position, you must be qualified for admission to the PhD programme at the Faculty of Health Sciences and participate in organized doctoral studies within the employment period.

Admission normally requires:  

  • A bachelor's degree of 180 ECTS and a master's degree of 120 ECTS, or an integrated master's degree of 300 ECTS. 
  • A master's thesis with a scope corresponding to at least 30 ECTS for a master's degree of 120 ECTS. 
  • A master's thesis with a scope corresponding to at least 20 ECTS for an integrated master's degree of 300 ECTS. 

 

Applicants must have a grade of C or better on the master's thesis and have a grade point average of C or better for the master's degree. A more detailed description of admission requirements can be found here.

If you are employed in the position, you will be provisionally admitted to the PhD programme. Application for final admission must be submitted no later than two months after taking up the position. 

Applicants with a foreign education will be subjected to an evaluation of whether the educational background is equal to Norwegian higher education, following national guidelines from Norwegian Directorate for Higher Education and Skills. Depending on which country the education is from, one or two additional years of university education may be required to fulfil admission requirements, e.g. a 4-year bachelor's degree and a 2-year master's degree. UiT normally accepts higher education from countries that are part of the Lisbon Recognition Convention.

Inclusion and diversity

UiT The Arctic University of Norway is working actively to promote equality, gender balance and diversity among employees and students, and to create an inclusive and safe working environment. We believe that inclusion and diversity are a strength, and we want employees with different competencies, professional experience, life experience and perspectives.

If you have a disability, a gap in your CV or immigrant background, we encourage you to tick the box for this in your application. If there are qualified applicants, we invite at least one in each group for an interview. If you get the job, we will adapt the working conditions if you need it. Apart from selecting the right candidates, we will only use the information for anonymous statistics.

We offer
  • Involvement in an interesting research project 
  • Good career opportunities 
  • A good academic environment with dedicated colleagues  
  • Flexible working hours and a state collective pay agreement  
  • Pension scheme through the state pension fund 
  • PhD Fellows are normally given a salary of 580 000 NOK/year with a 3% yearly increase

Norwegian health policy aims to ensure that everyone, irrespective of their personal finances and where they live, has access to good health and care services of equal standard. As an employee you will become member of the National Insurance Scheme which also include health care services.

More practical information about working and living in Norway can be found here: https://uit.no/staffmobility

Application 

Please note that the application will only be assessed based on the information submitted by the application deadline via Jobbnorge. It is therefore important that you include all necessary documents demonstrating your qualifications for the position.

Your application must include: 

  • A motivation letter describing how this position aligns with the applicant’s research interests.
  • CV, including a list of publications, if applicable. 
  • Official diplomas for Bachelor's and Master's degree in the original language 
  • Official transcripts of grades/academic record for Bachelor's and Master's degree in the original language
  • Official translation of diplomas and transcripts of records (ToR) to English or a Scandinavian language, if applicable
  • Explanation of the grading system for foreign education (Diploma Supplement if available)
  • Documentation of English proficiency
  • Two references with contact information

Qualification with a master’s degree is required before commencement in the position. If you are near completion of your master’s degree, you may still apply and submit a statement from your supervisor or institution indicating when the degree will be obtained. You must still submit your transcript of grades for the master’s degree with your application.

All documentation to be considered must be in a Scandinavian language or English. If English proficiency is not documented in the application, it must be documented before starting in the position. 

Assessment 

The applicants will be assessed by an expert committee. The committee's mandate is to undertake an assessment of the applicants' qualifications based on the written material presented by the applicants, and the detailed description draw up for the position. A copy of the assessment report will be sent to all applicants. 

The applicants who are assessed as best qualified will be called to an interview. The interview should among other things, aim to clarify the applicant’s motivation and personal suitability for the position. 

General information 

The appointment is made in accordance with State regulations and guidelines at UiT. At our website, you will find more information for applicants. 

Remuneration for the position of PhD Fellow is in accordance with the State salary scale code 1017. A compulsory contribution of 2 % to the Norwegian Public Service Pension Fund will be deducted. You will become a member of the Norwegian Public Service Pension Fund, which gives you many benefits in addition to a lifelong pension: You may be entitled to financial support if you become ill or disabled, your family may be entitled to financial support when you die, you become insured against occupational injury or occupational disease, and you can get good terms on a mortgage. Read more about your employee benefits at: spk.no.

A shorter period of appointment may be decided when the PhD Fellow has already completed parts of their research training programme or when the appointment is based on a previous qualifying position PhD Fellow, research assistant, or the like in such a way that the total time used for research training amounts to three years. 

We process personal data given in an application or CV in accordance with the Personal Data Act (Offentleglova). According to the Personal Data Act information about the applicant may be included in the public applicant list, also in cases where the applicant has requested non-disclosure. You will receive advance notification in the event of such publication, if you have requested non-disclosure.

jobs.title: Technical Support & Operations Specialist
jobs.description:
We are looking for a Technical Support & Operations Specialist to bridge the gap between our Customer Care and DevOps teams. You will troubleshoot technical issues by connecting the dots between customer reports and multiple systems and forming a clear hypotheses.

Hva vi ser etter Qualifications

  • Practical understanding of web applications (SaaS), mobile app sync, and how software runs in production.

  • Comfortable using application telemetry, monitoring, or server logs to validate your hypotheses efficiently without getting lost in the data.

  • Strong communication skills in Norwegian and English, with a knack for explaining technical topics simply.

  • Experience from 2nd-line technical support, IT operations, or QA is an advantage.

  • Skilled at taking vague user symptoms, deducing the underlying conditions, and attempting to reproduce or isolate the failure domain systematically without needing direct code access.

  • Candidates must pass a pre-employment background check (bakgrunnssjekk ) and meet the conduct requirements (krav til vandel/politiattest) for aviation background checks (Luftfartstilsynet) and/or customer-mandated security clearances.

Who You Are

  • Curious: You look at a strange error and immediately start asking the right scoping questions: Is it tenant-specific or platform-wide? Is it a data issue, a module edge case, or a sync conflict? You enjoy testing your theories through clean replication, knowing exactly when to resolve it yourself and when to package a well-scoped ticket for escalation.

  • Pedagogical: You enjoy talking to users and teaching others how a system works.

  • Structured: You keep tickets tidy, respect security standards, and follow issues through to resolution.

Arbeidsoppgaver

  • Debug & Troubleshoot: Analyze customer tickets and server/application logs to pinpoint root causes and resolve issues directly.

  • Ticket Management: Create, triage, document, and resolve support tickets, ensuring clean handoffs to DevOps when code changes are needed.

  • Customer Dialogue: Support Norwegian and international aviation customers via phone, video, and email with a clear, service-minded approach.

  • Customer Training: Run onboarding and training sessions on the Opscom platform once you know the system inside out.

  • Team Relief: Offload routine operational tasks from Support and DevOps, and keep internal guides updated.

Vi tilbyr

  • A key operational role in an international aviation tech company headquartered at Bodø Airport.

  • Thorough product onboarding and close mentorship from experienced DevOps engineers and aviation specialists.

  • Career growth paths toward DevOps, technical customer success, or product management.

  • Competitive salary and a close-knit team environment.

jobs.title: Job i dansk kundeservice på Cypern

Gaming og spillekonsoller

Du hjælper kunder med spørgsmål om spillekonsoller, brugerkonti og onlinetjenester. Det kan være en kunde, der har problemer med at logge ind, oplever en ustabil forbindelse eller har spørgsmål til en betaling. Du hjælper med fejlfinding og sender mere komplekse sager videre til det rette team.

Apps og digitale tjenester

Du guider brugere i at bruge apps og hjemmesider, hjælper med almindelige tekniske problemer og håndterer spørgsmål og klager. Når en sag kræver yderligere hjælp, sender du den videre til det relevante team.

  • Oplæring. Mandag til fredag kl. 09.00 til 17.30 lokal tid.

Løn og arbejdssted

Begge stillinger er på 40 timer om ugen og foregår på virksomhedens kontor i Larnaca. Den faste månedsløn er 1.350 euro før skat og stiger til 1.400 euro efter seks måneders ansættelse.

Hvem søger vi?

  • Du taler og skriver dansk på C2-niveau og har engelskkundskaber på mindst B2-niveau.

  • Du har afsluttet en gymnasial uddannelse eller tilsvarende.

  • Du er fortrolig med IT og kan forklare en løsning, så kunden kan følge med.

  • Du er tålmodig, serviceminded og god til at bevare overblikket.

  • Du er EU-borger og bor på Cypern eller er klar til at flytte dertil.

Erfaring med kundeservice eller teknisk support er en fordel. Til gamingstillingen er det også en fordel, hvis du interesserer dig for spillekonsoller.

Hjælp til at flytte til Cypern

Hvis du flytter til Cypern for jobbet, kan du vælge mellem to flyttepakker.

  • 1.500 euro i flyttetilskud. Tilskuddet udbetales to til tre uger efter jobstart. Du arrangerer og betaler i første omgang selv fly og bolig.

  • Op til 300 euro i refusion af flybilletten og mulighed for indkvartering i op til to måneder. Første måned er gratis, og anden måned koster 100 euro. Du booker selv flybilletten.

Vi gennemgår betingelserne for flyttepakken med dig under rekrutteringen.

Jobsun er med dig under hele opholdet

Jobsun er din kontaktperson og mentor før afrejse, under opstarten og gennem hele dit ophold. Du kan altid kontakte os, hvis du har spørgsmål til jobbet, hverdagen på Cypern eller har brug for hjælp til noget praktisk.

Interesseret? Et CV er nok

Der er løbende opstart med mulighed for at starte i november eller december 2026.

Send dit CV via ansøgningsmuligheden i opslaget. Du behøver ikke skrive en ansøgning. Hvis du allerede ved, hvilken af de to stillinger du foretrækker, må du gerne nævne det.
