jobs.title: Make Things Happen: We’re Hiring a Contract Manager Who Loves Action!
jobs.description:
Do you love the buzz of a fast-moving environment where you get real responsibility and make an impact from day one? Do you want to join a team of bold, curious and driven people who are building something extraordinary together? Does negotiating excite you? Then you might just be the Contract Manager we are looking for.

About us

Since 1981, Delta of Scandinavia has been crafting unforgettable travel experiences across the Nordics, from the magic of Iceland’s northern lights to the timeless beauty of Norway’s fjords. Luxury escapes, wild adventures, sustainable journeys: all designed with passion, creativity and a true love for the North.

What do we offer

Join a young, international team where ideas travel fast and every day feels different.

Work in a vibrant environment that inspires creativity, collaboration and fun.

Grow fast, with real career opportunities and intense hands-on training that will boost your skills from day one.

Your responsibilities

As Contract Manager you negotiate and manage our supplier agreements, securing the best commercial conditions and building strong partnerships. Your work supports product quality, operational efficiency and our wider company objectives.

You will be involved in many exciting areas, including:

•      Identify, collect, analyse and negotiate a wide variety of contracts with suppliers. Optimise every agreement to maximise value and keep Delta competitive.

•      Ensure that all contractual terms align with company standards and objectives.

•      Build and maintain strong, long-term relationships with suppliers, and act as the main point of contact for contractual matters.

•      Foster collaboration with suppliers to improve product quality and commercial outcomes.

•      Troubleshoot contract-related issues.

•      Make sure that booking procedures with suppliers work well, and identify and implement solutions that improve processes and efficiency.

•      Be in contact with the Department Managers to establish the strategy for the product and stay aware of the departments’ needs.

•      Contribute insights that support product strategy and development.

•      Collaborate with destination partners to stay up to date on product knowledge and market developments, and make sure Delta is involved in the strategies of the Tourist Boards and DMOs, including invitations to events and FAM trips.

•      Keep the communication about the product flowing between staff at all times: exchange news and keep a regular update.

What we expect from you

You bring an exceptional work ethic and a strong sense of urgency. You are driven by ambition and always push yourself to reach the highest standards. You take full ownership of your work, and you are proactive, reliable and committed to delivering results. At the same time, you stay humble and share our enthusiasm for creating and growing new ventures.

We love working from the office: it is where teamwork, creativity and growth truly thrive, when we are together in person. From 1 December 2026 our office will be located at Axeltårn: difficult to find a better location in town.

jobs.description:
Tööülesanded: Dream Stay OÜ on pikaajalise kogemusega lühiajalise rendiga tegelev ettevõte, kelle hallata on üle 120 külaliskorteri Tallinnas. Otsime oma meeskonda külaliskorterite koristajaid nii täis- kui osalise koormusega. Võimalik on töötada ka ainult nädalavahetustel (näiteks laupäevast esmaspäevani) — töö sobib hästi lisatööks. Enamik külaliskortereid asub Tallinna vanalinnas ja kesklinnas või nende vahetus läheduses. Pakume tööd külaliskorterites. Palun arvestage, et kõik korterid – kokku umbes 120 – asuvad erinevates hoonetes. Autot tööks vaja ei ole — liikumine objektide vahel toimub ühistranspordiga ning see aeg on samuti tasustatud. Linna peal pesu vedama ei pea: puhta pesu toob kohale meie kuller. Kõik vajalikud puhastusvahendid on olemas apartementides või keldriruumides. Koristaja peab endaga kaasas kandma vaid meilt saadud lappe, kindaid ja mõned švammid. Töö sisaldab vahetusi nädalavahetustel ja pühade ajal — see on turismisektoris töötamise loomulik osa. Esmaspäevast reedeni töögraafikut kahjuks pakkuda ei ole võimalik ning väikeste lastega tööl viibimine ei ole lubatud.

Varasem töökogemus sarnasel ametikohal on väga hinnatud ja annab eelise. Oluline tingimus on nutitelefoni kasutamise oskus, kuna põhiline suhtlus ja töökorraldus toimub grupivestluses.

jobs.title: Sales Manager – Packaging Equipment and Automated Packaging Solutions
jobs.description:
Your main responsibility will be to identify industrial companies whose production and packaging processes could be automated or made more efficient using our equipment. Automated packaging lines and packaging equipment.

Work tasks: Alpina Electronics OÜ is expanding its activities in the field of automated packaging equipment and packaging lines and is looking for a Sales Manager for the Estonian and Finnish markets. Your main responsibility will be to identify industrial companies whose production and packaging processes could be automated or made more efficient using our equipment. Our range of solutions includes: Automated packaging lines and equipment in cooperation with the Polish manufacturer RADPAK. Palletizing equipment, including solutions developed by Alpina Electronics. Thermoforming packaging machines for the food industry, primarily for the Finnish market, supplied by Colimatic. Your Key Responsibilities Identifying potential customers and establishing new business relationships in Estonia and Finland. Visiting customers to understand their production processes and packaging requirements. Presenting suitable packaging equipment and automated packaging solutions. Working closely with equipment manufacturers and technical specialists. Managing sales projects from initial customer contact through to order confirmation. Every manufacturing company and project is different. Your role will be to understand each customer's specific needs and work together with our team and the manufacturers' technical specialists to develop the most suitable solution.

We offer: We offer an opportunity to play an active role in establishing a new sales division and developing the market for automated packaging equipment and packaging lines in Estonia and Finland. We offer: A competitive base salary combined with performance-based bonuses. An independent and responsible position with a high degree of autonomy. Flexible working arrangements, including the opportunity to work from home. A company car, computer, mobile phone, and all other necessary work equipment. Comprehensive technical support from equipment manufacturers and our own specialists. Manufacturer-provided training and opportunities to attend international trade fairs. The opportunity to contribute to the development of a new business area and influence the range of solutions we offer. The position involves regular customer visits throughout Estonia and Finland. Administrative and office-based tasks can be carried out from a home office. We prefer a full-time employee but are also open to part-time arrangements for the right candidate.

Other requirements: This position is ideal for someone who values independence, enjoys planning their own work, and wants to see a direct connection between their efforts and achievements.

Option to work from home: Yes

Working load, shifts: 0,5

jobs.title: Senior Raft Guide & Safety Kayaker / Kayak leiðbeinandi
jobs.description: Arctic Rafting is looking for a Senior Raft Guide and Safety Kayaker / Kayak Instructor for the upcoming summer season of 2027. Our season is May – September, with our high season in the summer time; June – August. There are some operations and preparations to do also before and after, in April and October. In particular, we are looking for someone to come in March, to repair equipment and do admin office work for the river operation, to prepare for the summer. This position will extend to be all year round, working part time over the winter months and taking a long leave (1-3 months). Arctic Rafting has a base camp on the well known tourist circuit of “The Golden Circle” in the southern part of Iceland, in just over an hour drive from Reykjavík capital city. Our operations include family friendly rafting trips on the mighty Hvítá River (class II-III), which is the third longest river in Iceland, originating from Langjökull Glacier. Our base camp has other amenities like a bar, restaurant, sauna and hot tubs, so clients can wind down after an action-packed adventure on the river.The qualities we are looking for is experience with good customer service, and good team work skills. Any added language skills are appreciated, operational skills for safe and high quality river trips, repairing skills for river rafting gear and other equipment, and skills for cooking, cleaning, photography, marketing/office, mechanics and general handy man skills. Job description and responsibilities of a Senior Raft Guide:* Operate safe and entertaining river tours for clients (rafting or kayaking)* Be a team leader and trip lead a group of guides in rafting trips of the size of 100+ clients* Kitchen worker and general work in the restaurant and bar serving clients* Work around the property (repair gear, cleaning, laundry, gardening and handy man jobs)Requirements:* Current WRT (Whitewater Rescue Technician) or similar* Current IRF (International Rafting Federation) certification or similar* Up to date Advanced First Aid training* Minimum 5 seasons of raft guide experience* Good English skills to communicate with clientsExtras, good to have, but not a requirement:* A big bus license to drive the river shuttle (45 seater)* Kitchen and bar experience* Photography skills* Sales / marketing skillsWork arrangements:* We generally have one morning trip and one afternoon trip every day; you either do two trips per day, or one trip and then base work for the rest of the day (cooking, cleaning, repair gear, etc.)* The work days can be anything from 4-12 hours per day, but the normality is generally 8-9 hours* A full time job means 160-170 hours per month, and as the hours vary, the pay is by hourly rates* Normally you would get 2 days off per week, but this can vary to 1-3 days off weeklyHousing and food:* Living arrangements is at an old farm in the countryside 1,5 hour from Reykjavík city, next to the river rafting base / restaurant* Everyone gets their own private room, including shared facilities (bathroom with shower)* We do daily communal dinners and everyone is expected to partake in the cooking and cleaning at the end of the day* We supply breakfast, lunch and dinner; while you are at the raft base for work Rates:* Depending on your skill level and experience the pay would be around 2.500 – 2.900isk per hour* In addition to this we offer free housing and food for your stay during your work periodPlease note that in Iceland we pay around 40% tax, and other fees will be deducted too (union, pension fund etc.)Benefits:* Some great times living in the countryside, being a raft guide for an Icelandic summer season* Private room with shared facilities (bathroom with shower)* Use of base facilities (staff kitchen, hot pots and sauna)* Occasional use of communal work car; we strongly recommend having a valid driver’s license, as public transport in Iceland is quite horrid when you live at an old farm in the middle of nowhere.About the Company:This is one of the oldest adventure activities to do in Iceland, but the first river rafting trip with clients was made here in 1985. Around 1990 they started renovations at the old barn and farm house to make the raft base into what it is today; changing rooms, showers, sauna, hot pots, restaurant, bar and guide facilities; for around 10-12 staff members to live there for the summer season. Our clients are mostly from Iceland, Europe and USA, so the minimal language requirements are good English skills. Owned by a local raft guide and kayaker, and more details can be found on our website: www.arcticrafting.com This video sums up what a normal day in the summer looks like – https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=6OXFlZTrEzQTo apply; please send a CV and cover letter to drumbo@arcticrafting.is before 1st of December 2026Best regards,The Arctic Rafting teamdrumbo@arcticrafting.iswww.arcticrafting.is / www.arcticrafting.comArctic Rafting leitar að reyndum flúðasiglingaleiðsögumanni (Senior Raft Guide) og öryggiskajakræðara/kajakkennara (Safety Kayaker / Kayak Instructor) fyrir komandi sumartímabil árið 2027.Starfstímabilið okkar er frá maí til september, en háannatíminn er yfir sumarmánuðina, júní til ágúst. Einnig þarf að sinna ýmsum undirbúnings- og rekstrarverkefnum fyrir og eftir tímabilið, í apríl og október.Við leitum sérstaklega að einstaklingi sem getur hafið störf í mars til að sinna viðgerðum á búnaði og skrifstofu- og stjórnsýsluverkefnum tengdum flúðasiglingarekstrinum, til undirbúnings fyrir sumarið.Starfið mun þróast yfir í heilsársstarf, þar sem unnið verður í hlutastarfi yfir vetrarmánuðina og möguleiki verður á lengra leyfi, í 1–3 mánuði.StarfsumhverfiðArctic Rafting er með bækistöð við hina þekktu ferðamannaleið Gullna hringinn á Suðurlandi, í rúmlega klukkustundar akstursfjarlægð frá Reykjavík.Starfsemin felur meðal annars í sér fjölskylduvænar flúðasiglingaferðir á hinni mikilfenglegu Hvítá (erfiðleikaflokkur II–III). Hvítá er þriðja lengsta á Íslands og á upptök sín við Langjökul.Á bækistöðinni er einnig bar, veitingastaður, gufubað og heitir pottar þar sem gestir geta slakað á eftir ævintýralega ferð niður ána.Eiginleikar sem við leitum aðVið leitum að einstaklingi sem hefur reynslu af góðri þjónustu við viðskiptavini og býr yfir góðri hæfni í teymisvinnu.Önnur tungumálakunnátta er kostur, sem og færni í að skipuleggja og framkvæma öruggar og vandaðar flúðasiglingaferðir.Einnig er kostur að hafa reynslu af viðgerðum á flúðasiglingabúnaði og öðrum tækjum, matreiðslu, þrifum, ljósmyndun, markaðssetningu, skrifstofustörfum, vélaviðgerðum og almennum viðhaldsverkefnum.Starfslýsing og ábyrgð yfirleiðsögumannsStjórna öruggum og skemmtilegum flúðasiglinga- og kajakferðum fyrir gesti.Sinna ýmsum verkefnum á svæðinu, svo sem viðgerðum á búnaði, þrifum, þvotti, garðvinnu og almennu viðhaldi.HæfniskröfurGilt WRT-skírteini (Whitewater Rescue Technician – sérhæfð björgun í straumvatni) eða sambærileg réttindi.Gild IRF-réttindi (International Rafting Federation – Alþjóðasamband flúðasiglinga) eða sambærileg réttindi.Gild og uppfærð réttindi í ítarlegri skyndihjálp (Advanced First Aid).Að lágmarki fimm tímabils reynsla sem flúðasiglingaleiðsögumaður.Góð enskukunnátta til að eiga samskipti við viðskiptavini.Viðbótarhæfni sem er kostur en ekki skilyrðiÖkuréttindi til að aka stórri rútu (45 farþega) sem notuð er til að flytja gesti til og frá ánni.Reynsla af eldhús- og barstörfum.Hæfni í ljósmyndun.Reynsla af sölu- og markaðsmálum.Vinnutími og starfskjörYfirleitt eru farnar tvær flúðasiglingaferðir á dag, ein að morgni og önnur síðdegis.Starfsmaður fer annaðhvort í tvær ferðir á dag eða eina ferð og sinnir síðan öðrum verkefnum á bækistöðinni, svo sem matreiðslu, þrifum eða viðgerðum á búnaði.Vinnudagar geta verið allt frá 4 upp í 12 klukkustundir, en algengast er að þeir séu um 8–9 klukkustundir.Fullt starf miðast við 160–170 vinnustundir á mánuði. Þar sem vinnustundir eru breytilegar eru laun greidd samkvæmt tímakaupi.Yfirleitt eru tveir frídagar í viku, en þeir geta verið frá einum upp í þrjá eftir aðstæðum.Húsnæði og fæðiStarfsfólk býr á gömlum sveitabæ í um 1,5 klukkustundar akstursfjarlægð frá Reykjavík, við hliðina á flúðasiglingabækistöðinni og veitingastaðnum.Allir starfsmenn fá sérherbergi en deila sameiginlegri aðstöðu, þar á meðal baðherbergi með sturtu.Sameiginlegur kvöldverður er á hverjum degi og ætlast er til að allir taki þátt í matreiðslu og frágangi í lok dags.Boðið er upp á morgunmat, hádegismat og kvöldmat á meðan starfsfólk er við vinnu á bækistöðinni.LaunTímakaup fer eftir hæfni og reynslu viðkomandi og er á bilinu 2.500–2.900 krónur á klukkustund.Auk launa er boðið upp á ókeypis húsnæði og fæði meðan á starfstímabilinu stendur.Athugið að á Íslandi geta skattar numið um 40% af launum og að önnur gjöld eru einnig dregin frá, svo sem stéttarfélagsgjöld og lífeyrissjóðsiðgjöld.FríðindiEinstakt tækifæri til að upplifa íslenskt sumar í sveitinni og starfa við flúðasiglingar.Sérherbergi með sameiginlegri baðaðstöðu.Aðgangur að aðstöðu á bækistöðinni, þar á meðal starfsmannaeldhúsi, heitum pottum og gufubaði.Stundum er hægt að nýta sameiginlegan starfsmannabíl.Við mælum eindregið með því að umsækjendur hafi gilt ökuskírteini, þar sem almenningssamgöngur á Íslandi eru afar takmarkaðar þegar búið er á gömlum sveitabæ úti í sveit.Um fyrirtækiðFlúðasiglingar eru ein elsta skipulagða ævintýraafþreying sem boðið hefur verið upp á á Íslandi. Fyrsta flúðasiglingaferðin með viðskiptavini á þessu svæði var farin árið 1985.Um 1990 hófst endurnýjun á gamla fjósinu og íbúðarhúsinu á bænum með það að markmiði að útbúa þá aðstöðu sem þar er í dag.Þar er nú að finna búningsklefa, sturtur, gufubað, heita potta, veitingastað, bar og aðstöðu fyrir leiðsögumenn. Á sumrin er aðstaða fyrir um 10–12 starfsmenn til að búa á staðnum.Viðskiptavinir okkar koma að mestu leyti frá Íslandi, Evrópu og Bandaríkjunum og því er góð enskukunnátta lágmarkskrafa.Fyrirtækið er í eigu flúðasiglingaleiðsögumanns og kajakræðara úr heimabyggð.Nánari upplýsingar um fyrirtækið má finna á vefsíðunni:www.arcticrafting.comMyndband sem sýnir dæmigerðan sumardag hjá Arctic Rafting:https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=6OXFlZTrEzQUmsóknir:Áhugasamir eru beðnir um að senda ferilskrá og kynningarbréf á netfangið:drumbo@arcticrafting.isUmsóknarfrestur er til 1. desember 2026.Með bestu kveðju,Starfsfólk Arctic Raftingdrumbo@arcticrafting.iswww.arcticrafting.is / www.arcticrafting.com

jobs.title: Servicegartner søges
jobs.description:
Har du en solid grøn faglighed, trives du med at tage fat, og kan du lide at arbejde selvstændigt i et tæt makkerskab? Så er det måske dig, vi søger til at holde Skjoldhøjparken grøn, sikker og i topform hele året.

Skjoldhøjparkens Grundejerforening søger en dygtig og engageret gartner til den daglige drift af vores fælles områder. Du kommer til at arbejde tæt sammen med en anden gartner og få en varieret hverdag, hvor du er med til at sikre, at området fremstår pænt, sikkert og velplejet hele året.

Dine arbejdsopgaver

Du bliver en del af et lille team på to gartnere ansat af bestyrelsen, og dine opgaver bliver blandt andet at:

  • Klippe græs og pleje områdets grønne arealer

  • Udføre snerydning og glatførebekæmpelse i vinterhalvåret

  • Beskæring af træer og buske

  • Vedligeholde og tjekke områdets legepladser

  • Have den daglige dialog med leverandører og samarbejdspartnere samt følge op på aftalte opgaver

  • Løse lettere administrative opgaver digitalt

  • Løse øvrige driftsopgaver i området, som opstår hen over året

  • Bidrage til gode arbejdsgange og fortløbende forbedringer i driften

Hvem er du?

Vi forestiller os, at du er uddannet gartner, anlægsgartner, landmand, bygningsservicetekniker eller har en anden relevant grøn uddannelse. Det vigtigste er, at du har praktisk erfaring, kan arbejde med frihed under ansvar og finder stor glæde ved pleje og vedligeholdelse af grønne områder.

Derudover lægger vi vægt på, at du:

  • Arbejder selvstændigt, struktureret og pålideligt

  • Er god til at samarbejde og dele opgaverne med din kollega

  • Kan kommunikere tydeligt og venligt med leverandører og med områdets beboere

  • Kan overskue og prioritere, når vejr og årstid ændrer opgaverne

  • Har almindelige IT-kompetencer

 

Det er en fordel, hvis du:

  • Har erfaring med drift af større boligområder, grundejerforeninger eller lignende

  • Kan lide at snakke med beboere i området

  • Har kendskab til kontrol og vedligeholdelse af legepladser

  • Har erfaring med at arbejde med leverandører og indhente tilbud

  • Kan udføre let administrativt arbejde

Vi tilbyder

  • En alsidig stilling med praktisk arbejde og ansvar for områdets drift

  • Et tæt samarbejde med en gartnerkollega

  • Frihed under ansvar og mulighed for at præge arbejdsgangene

  • Et arbejdsmiljø, hvor du kommer tæt på de mennesker, der bor og færdes i området

Praktiske oplysninger

  • Du skal have gyldigt kørekort til kategori B

  • Du skal kunne stå til rådighed for snerydning i vinterhalvåret

  • Arbejdstid 37 timer ugentligt

  • Arbejdspladsen er Fejøvænget 33, 8381 Tilst

  • Tiltrædelse snarest muligt

  • Løn- og ansættelsesvilkår efter gældende overenskomst ved 3F

Ansøgning

Vi behandler ansøgninger løbende og opslaget tages ned, når den rette er fundet.

Vi glæder os til at modtage din ansøgning og dit CV via job@skjoldhoj.dk, hvor alle ansøgninger behandles fortroligt.

Har du spørgsmål til stillingen, er du velkommen til at kontakte bestyrelsen på kontakt@skjoldhoj.dk

jobs.title: Lead Product Marketing Manager, Core Product
jobs.description:
WHO WE ARE

Notion is the collaborative AI workspace where teams and agents think together https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=vkpYpWfEK5s. We're building one place where your knowledge, projects, meetings, and AI tools live side by side, so work is faster, clearer, and less fragmented. Millions of individuals, small teams, and large companies run their work on Notion.



Notinos (our employees) are customer zero in bringing this future of work to life. We care about craft, building things that last, and the belief that great work is still fundamentally human. Our goal isn’t to ship the next feature. Each and every team of Notinos is working to set the standard for how humans work together in the AI era. From building a business’s system of record to making and managing AI agents to automating away the busy work, we care deeply about giving our customers more time for their life’s work.




ABOUT THE ROLE:

Notion's engineering and product teams are shipping faster than ever, which means there's more for customers to discover, understand, and adopt than ever before. We're looking for a Product Marketing Manager to drive awareness of new Notion features and capabilities, and to run the programs that turn early activation into lasting adoption. This is a full-stack role: you'll flex across launches, growth programs, and pricing and packaging. That last one means helping decide how new capabilities map to plans and tiers, and making sure customers can tell what they get and what they pay for. You're a messaging master with a genuine point of view: someone who can build narratives sharp and specific enough to cut through an increasingly noisy market, and a strategic partner to Product from early development all the way through go-to-market.

 

This role can be based in either San Francisco or New York City. We work from our offices on Mondays, Tuesdays and Thursdays (our Anchor Days) because we do our best thinking and building together in person. We’re looking for someone who’s excited to work alongside the team during those days. 




WHAT YOU'LL ACHIEVE:

 - Lead launches big and small, coordinating efforts across our Marketing and GTM org to land a successful launch day.

 - Drive continued awareness, growth, and adoption of high-PMF features well after launch day. Launch is the start of the story, not the end of it.

 - Take on pricing and packaging projects for new capabilities, working with Product, Design, and Web to decide whether something becomes a new SKU or tier or joins an existing one, then landing the change on notion.com/pricing http://notion.com/pricing, in-product, and in release comms.

 - Serve as a strategic partner to Product, informing strategy during product development, competitive positioning, and user insights.

 - Collaborate with Enterprise PMMs and Sales to build sales enablement materials that turn product capability into stories reps can use in the field.

 - Partnering with Demand Gen and Lifecycle on sequences, webinars, and more.




SKILLS YOU'LL NEED TO BRING: 

 - 10+ years directly relevant experience in product marketing or adjacent marketing function.

 - A distinctive point of view and the creativity to build narratives that stand out in a crowded, noisy market.

 - Experience running product launches, adoption, or growth programs, ideally at a fast-moving product or technology company.

 - A real point of view on pricing and packaging, or the appetite to build one fast. You can reason about plans, tiers, and value, not just features and launches.

 - Strong cross-functional skills, comfortable coordinating Product, Design, Engineering, Sales, and Marketing toward one outcome.

 - Genuine passion for shaping the future of work with AI, a growth mindset, and a scrappy, high-ownership approach to getting things done.

 - Sharp writing and storytelling instincts: you know the difference between a headline that's technically accurate and one that actually lands.




NICE TO HAVES:

 - You're already a Notion user, fluent in the product and plugged into the community.

 - You look beyond just AI & tech companies for creative inspiration

 - You're a pro at building and using agents, inside Notion and beyond.

 - You've worked through a pricing or packaging change before, such as a new tier, a plan change, or a paywall, and can talk about the tradeoffs.

 - PMM experience at a larger company, though we care more about your instincts and ownership than your resume's logos.



Notion is committed to providing highly competitive cash compensation, equity, and benefits. The compensation offered for this role will be based on multiple factors such as location, the role’s scope and complexity, and the candidate’s experience and expertise, and may vary from the range provided below. For roles based in San Francisco or New York City, the estimated base salary range for this role is $230,000 - $270,000 per year.



By clicking “Submit Application”, I understand and agree that Notion and its affiliates and subsidiaries will collect and process my information in accordance with Notion’s Global Recruiting Privacy Policy https://notion.notion.site/Notion-Global-Recruiting-Privacy-Policy-fc3eb4e829354a26a2bb6fd5e289b550?pvs=74 and NYLL 144 https://notion.notion.site/Ashby-AI-Bias-Audit-2b0efdeead05803bbbfae159ec86c528.



#LI-Onsite




A NOTE ON AI

You don’t need deep AI expertise for every role, but we do expect every Notino to be intellectually curious, drawn to tinkering and discovery, and excited to use AI as a real collaborator in their work. For some roles, AI fluency is a core requirement — when that’s the case, we'll say so explicitly in the qualifications. People who thrive here don’t treat AI as a novelty. They use it to think better, and make their work easier for others to build on.




EQUAL OPPORTUNITY & ACCOMMODATIONS

We hire talented people from a wide range of backgrounds. If you’re excited about this role but don’t meet every bullet, we still encourage you to apply. Notion is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate on the basis of any legally protected characteristic. Consistent with applicable law, we will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records. Notion provides reasonable accommodations during the application process; if you need one, please let your recruiter know.



Notion is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate in hiring or any employment decision based on race, color, religion, national origin, age, sex (including pregnancy, childbirth, or related medical conditions), marital status, ancestry, physical or mental disability, genetic information, veteran status, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, or other applicable legally protected characteristic. Notion considers qualified applicants with criminal histories, consistent with applicable federal, state and local law. Notion is also committed to providing reasonable accommodations for qualified individuals with disabilities and disabled veterans in our job application procedures. If you need assistance or an accommodation due to a disability, please let your recruiter know.

jobs.title: Field Marketing Manager, Europe
jobs.description:
At Linear, we're building the product development system for teams and agents. AI is fundamentally changing how software gets built, and we’re shaping the tools this new era requires.

Founded in 2019, Linear has become the platform of choice for more than 50,000 companies (including OpenAI, Coinbase, and Ramp) to plan, build, and ship their products. Today, our team is distributed across North America, Europe, and Australia, and we’re continuing to grow internationally. What unites us is relentless focus, fast execution, and a deep care for software craftsmanship.

Field marketing at Linear is just getting started. Its job is to put us in front of the right people in the right room: executive dinners, conferences, partner events, and programs built with our Customer team around named accounts.

We're hiring our first Field Marketing Manager in Europe to take that motion from strategy to execution. You'll own the executive dinner calendar across cities, decide which third-party events and partner programs are worth our time, and build the invitations and follow-up that help our sellers turn a good evening into a real conversation. This is a hands-on role. You'll tap your venue and vendor network, build the run of show for each program, and be on site to run it.

Location & work mode

Linear is a remote-first company, with optional co-working offices in San Francisco, New York, and London. This role is open to candidates based in Europe, with London preferred. You can work from anywhere within this region. We value deep focus and async collaboration, with intentional moments to connect in person through team off-sites, optional co-working, and occasional travel. This role involves frequent travel for events, including evenings.

What you’ll do

 - Own the executive dinner calendar across cities: pick the city, the venue, the date, and the theme for each dinner

 - Build each guest list with our Customer team, equip sellers with invitation sequences, and track RSVPs so every seat goes to someone worth having there

 - Manage venues and vendors, negotiate menus and minimums, and keep per-dinner spend, contracts, and travel logistics within budget

 - Brief our hosts and executives on who's attending and what we want to learn, be on site to run the night, and hand follow-ups to Sales afterward

 - Evaluate conferences and sponsorship offers by audience quality, account coverage, and expected return, then plan how we show up: booth or no booth, side dinners, customer meetings, and speaking slots

 - Co-host dinners, workshops, and meetups with partners, and agree up front on guest lists, costs, and who follows up

 - Sit with Sales each quarter to pick target accounts, build lightweight formats an AE can request for a key account, and report on attendance, meetings held, pipeline influenced, and feedback from attendees and account owners

What we’re looking for

 - 3+ years in field marketing, event marketing, or B2B events, ideally at a software company. Experience in developer tools, SaaS, or another technical product is a plus

 - A track record of running dinners, roundtables, or other small-format events end to end, plus experience planning around conferences: sponsorships, side events, and customer meetings

 - Experience working next to Sales. You know how to build a target account list, get an AE to care about an event, and tell them afterward what happened

 - Strong project management. You can run several cities and events at once without dropping details

 - Comfort with budgets, vendor contracts, and a spreadsheet. Hands-on time with HubSpot and event attribution is a plus

 - Clear writing and an easy way with senior guests, hosts, and partners. Experience marketing to engineering and product leaders is a bonus

 - Experience building an event series from the ground up, including a playbook someone else could run

 - Willingness to travel often, including evenings

What we offer

We're a small, focused team that cares deeply about the quality of our work and the people we do it with. Here's what you can expect:

 - Competitive salary and equity

 - Employee-friendly equity terms

 - Daily meal and coffee stipend on every workday

 - Paid co-working space or desk

 - Health coverage (based on country requirements)

 - 5 weeks paid vacation, plus local statutory holidays

 - 4 months paid parental leave

 - Paid month off after 4 years & every 2 years thereafter

 - Regular team events and off-sites

 - Remote-first with no required commute

jobs.title: Tour Guide for Christmas Season
jobs.description: Do you love Finnish history, storytelling, and meeting people from around the world?Nordic Signature Tours is a Helsinki-based tourism company specializing in engaging, historically informative, and entertaining walking tours for international visitors.Our mission is simple: **We dont just show people Helsinki. We bring its stories to life!**From Finlands journey toward independence to its extraordinary experiences during the Second World War and the political tensions of the Cold War, we believe that history should be experienced through compelling stories rather than simply memorizing dates and facts.We are currently looking for knowledgeable, enthusiastic, and reliable freelance walking tour guides to join our team, particularly during the upcoming Christmas and New Year holiday season.**Key Responsibilities**As a freelance walking tour guide, you will be responsible for:- Leading engaging and historically accurate walking tours throughout central Helsinki. - Demonstrating **extensive knowledge of Finnish history**, including Finlands Swedish and Russian periods, independence, political development, and modern society. - Possessing **strong knowledge of Finland during the Second World War**, particularly the Winter War (1939–1940), Continuation War (1941–1944), and their historical significance. - Explaining complex historical events in clear, accessible, and entertaining English for international audiences. - Delivering compelling historical narratives using storytelling, humor, and audience interaction. - Answering guests questions confidently and accurately about Finnish history, culture, and society. - Maintaining a professional, welcoming, and enthusiastic atmosphere throughout each tour. - Ensuring the safety and comfort of guests while navigating Helsinkis streets and landmarks. - Arriving punctually, managing tour schedules, and communicating professionally with guests and company management. - Conducting tours outdoors in various weather conditions, including Helsinkis winter season. **Essential Requirements**Applicants **must meet the following requirements:**- **Fluent English is mandatory**, with excellent verbal communication and presentation skills. - **Must currently reside in Helsinki or the surrounding Helsinki metropolitan area.** - **Must possess strong knowledge of Finnish history**, particularly Finnish independence, national development, and the Second World War. - Must be comfortable speaking confidently in front of international groups. - Must demonstrate excellent interpersonal skills, professionalism, and reliability. - Must be physically capable of leading walking tours of approximately 2–3 kilometers. - Must be comfortable conducting tours outdoors during winter conditions. - Must be available for agreed tour assignments and communicate scheduling availability in advance. - Must be able to work under a freelance or entrepreneurial invoicing arrangement. Previous experience in tourism, historical interpretation, teaching, acting, or public speaking is considered an advantage.While previous tour-guiding experience is not mandatory, **a strong historical foundation and the ability to communicate history effectively are essential.****Christmas Holiday Season Availability****We are particularly seeking guides who can provide tour coverage between December 1, 2026, and January 10, 2027.**During this period, additional guides will be needed to support our two primary walking tours:**Epic Helsinki: Storytelling Walking Tour**An engaging introduction to Helsinkis history, architecture, culture, and the events that shaped Finlands capital.**Helsinki During WWII Walking Tour**An immersive historical experience exploring Finlands involvement in the Second World War, including the Winter War, Continuation War, and the experiences of Finnish soldiers and civilians.Applicants who can provide reliable availability during the Christmas and New Year holiday period will be particularly valued.Tour assignments will depend on customer bookings, visitor demand, and individual guide availability.**Compensation and Freelance Contract**- €35 per completed walking tour, generally lasting approximately two hours. - Guides retain **100% of tips** received from guests. - Flexible scheduling based on agreed availability and confirmed bookings. - Compensation is arranged through a freelance or entrepreneurial invoicing agreement. - No guaranteed minimum number of tours or working hours. **Contract Extension Opportunities**Although we are currently recruiting for the Christmas holiday season, freelance cooperation may be extended beyond January 10, 2027.Extensions will depend on the number of visitors traveling to Helsinki, customer bookings, operational needs, and each guides availability.This provides an opportunity for successful guides to continue working with Nordic Signature Tours throughout the year as tourism demand allows.**How to Apply**Interested in joining Nordic Signature Tours?Please email **nordic.tours@outlook.com** the following:1. Your CV or résumé. 2. A short introduction explaining your interest in Finnish history and why you would make an excellent tour guide. 3. Details of your experience with Finnish history, particularly the Second World War. 4. Your availability between **December 1, 2026, and January 10, 2027**. 5. Confirmation that you currently reside in the Helsinki metropolitan area. Shortlisted applicants may be invited to participate in an interview.**At Nordic Signature Tours, we believe that great tour guides do more than explain history. They bring it to life, creating experiences that visitors remember long after leaving Helsinki.**We look forward to welcoming enthusiastic storytellers to our team!

jobs.title: Research and Development Engineer in Artificial Intelligence (H/F)
jobs.description: Who we are ?Télécom Paris, part of the IMT (Institut Mines-Télécom) and a founding member of the Institut Polytechnique de Paris, is one of France's top 6 general engineering schools.The mainspring of Télécom Paris is to train, imagine and undertake to design digital models, technologies and solutions for a society and economy that respect people and their environment.Modern distributed systems are increasingly complex, with multiple interconnected components, services, and autonomous agents interacting in dynamic environments. Ensuring their cybersecurity requires analysing potential attacks, understanding the strategies available to attackers and defenders, and verifying that critical security properties are preserved. Formal verification provides rigorous methods for addressing these challenges, allowing engineers to reason about system behaviours and establish mathematical guarantees. However, applying these techniques to realistic systems remains challenging. Verification problems can involve large state spaces and complex strategic interactions, while constructing formal models and specifying security properties often requires specialised expertise.The VITAMIN-C (VerIficaTion of A MultI-ageNt system for Cybersecurity) project aims to address these challenges by combining formal verification with artificial intelligence. Building on VITAMIN, an existing modular model-checking platform for multi-agent systems, the project develops methods and tools for analysing cybersecurity properties in distributed and autonomous systems. Attackers and defenders are represented as agents with specific capabilities, objectives, and available actions. Their interactions are analysed using attack graphs, temporal and strategic logics, and model-checking techniques. The project also investigates how AI can improve the efficiency and accessibility of these verification processes.A central objective of VITAMIN-C is to integrate AI techniques into the verification workflow. On the computational side, AI models will be investigated to guide the exploration of large state spaces and prioritise promising verification strategies. By learning from previously verified models and their associated results, these components can help identify relevant search directions and reduce the computational effort required by verification algorithms. On the usability side, the project explores AI-assisted interfaces that support engineers in constructing formal models and specifying security properties. These interfaces may exploit natural-language processing and large language models to interpret engineering descriptions, suggest formal representations, and assist users throughout the verification process. In both cases, the correctness of verification results remains the responsibility of the underlying formal methods, which validate the outcomes produced or suggested by AI components.Within this context, the R&D engineer will contribute to the design, implementation, and evaluation of AI techniques for VITAMIN-C. The work will focus on developing AI components for verification guidance, investigating natural-language and LLM-based assistance for formal modelling, and integrating these capabilities into the existing platform. The engineer will also participate in the preparation of training and evaluation datasets, the development of experimental benchmarks, and the assessment of the proposed approaches in terms of effectiveness, computational efficiency, and reliability. The overall objective is to make formal verification more scalable and accessible while preserving the rigorous guarantees provided by the verification framework.Your main responsibilities will include :Carry out R&D work in artificial intelligence for formal verificationContribute to the research profile of Télécom Paris and Institut Mines-Télécom

jobs.title: Konstruktionsingeniør til STEENBERGs tegnestue
jobs.description:
Vil du arbejde med bærende konstruktioner og være med til at omsætte skitser og beregninger til byggeri, der fungerer i praksis? Og trives du med en varieret hverdag, hvor statiske beregninger går hånd i hånd med tilsyn, byggetekniske gennemgange og tæt samarbejde med kollegaer, håndværkere og bygherrer?

Hos STEENBERGs tegnestue på Bornholm søger vi en konstruktionsingeniør, der har lyst til at arbejde bredt med både statik og praktiske, byggetekniske opgaver.

Om stillingen

Du bliver en del af projekter med nybyggeri, ombygninger og renoveringer i forskellige størrelser og med varierende kompleksitet. Vi arbejder som totalrådgiver, og du får mulighed for at følge løsningerne fra de første overvejelser og beregninger til udførelsen på byggepladsen.

Arbejdet spænder fra klassiske statikopgaver med beregninger, tegninger og dokumentation til mindre og større byggetekniske problemstillinger. Det kan eksempelvis være en håndværker, der står med en konkret udfordring på byggepladsen og har brug for din hjælp til at finde en byggeteknisk holdbar og bygbar løsning.

Du bliver en del af et tæt fagligt samarbejde på tegnestuen, hvor vi bringer vores forskellige kompetencer i spil. Inden for statik får du en stærk sparringspartner, som du kan drøfte beregninger, konkrete løsninger og byggetekniske problemstillinger med.

Dine opgaver vil blandt andet være:

  • Projektering og beregning af beton-, stål- og trækonstruktioner.

  • Udarbejdelse af statisk dokumentation, tegninger og konstruktionsdetaljer.

  • Byggeteknisk rådgivning og løsning af konkrete problemstillinger i dialog med håndværkere og bygherrer.

  • Byggetekniske gennemgange og fagtilsyn.

  • Samarbejde og koordinering med tegnestuens øvrige faggrupper.

  • Eventuelt byggeledelse.

Du lærer tegnestuens arbejdsmetoder og igangværende sager at kende i samarbejde med dine kollegaer. Undervejs får du ansvar for egne opgaver med mulighed for sparring om både beregninger og byggetekniske løsninger.

Hvem er du?

Du er uddannet ingeniør med speciale i bærende konstruktioner og har en praktisk tilgang til dine opgaver. Du interesserer dig for sammenhængen mellem beregninger, materialer og udførelse og har blik for både bygbarhed og økonomi.

En håndværksmæssig baggrund vil være en fordel. Erfaring fra byggepladsen er værdifuld, når du skal forstå en konkret problemstilling og finde en løsning i dialog med dem, der skal udføre arbejdet.

Vi lægger især vægt på, at du:

  • Har en bred konstruktionsmæssig forståelse og lyst til at arbejde med både statik og byggetekniske opgaver.

  • Har erfaring med relevante beregningsværktøjer, eksempelvis StruSoft Dimension og FEM Design.

  • Kan omsætte din faglige viden til praktiske og gennemarbejdede løsninger.

  • Arbejder selvstændigt, struktureret og tager ansvar for dine opgaver.

  • Kan forklare tekniske forhold forståeligt til både bygherrer og håndværkere.

  • Bidrager til den faglige sparring og er åben for andres erfaringer.

En tegnestue med korte veje mellem faglighederne

På STEENBERGs tegnestue løser vi opgaverne i fællesskab. Vi bringer vores forskellige kompetencer i spil og hjælper hinanden med at skabe sammenhæng mellem arkitektur, konstruktioner og installationer.

Hverdagen er præget af en flad struktur, fagligt engagement og en uformel, humoristisk omgangstone. Du får mulighed for at påvirke dit arbejde og bidrage med dine erfaringer og idéer.

Vi tilbyder frokostordning, pension med sundhedsforsikring og løn efter kvalifikationer.

Interesseret?

Kontakt Anders Bjerregaard på 56 95 53 30, hvis du vil høre mere om stillingen.

Send ansøgning og CV til ab@steenberg.dk. Fortæl gerne om projekter, du har arbejdet med, og hvilke opgaver du har løst.

Vi holder samtaler løbende og ansætter, når vi har fundet den rette kollega. Tiltrædelse aftaler vi sammen.

jobs.description:
Engageret Restaurationsbestyrer søges til La Viva

Er du en passioneret leder med hjertet bankende for branchen, og brænder du for at skabe uforglemmelige gæsteoplevelser? La Viva Slagelse ApS udvider og søger en driftig og ansvarsbevidst restaurationsbestyrer til vores afdeling i Køge: La Viva Køge og Slagelse.

Om stillingen

Som restaurationsbestyrer får du det overordnede ansvar for den daglige drift af La Viva Køge eller Slagelse. Du bliver omdrejningspunktet for både gæster og personale, og det bliver din fornemmeste opgave at sikre, at restauranten altid leverer høj kvalitet og fantastisk service. Stillingen er formelt klassificeret under DISCO-kode 141200, som dækker over detaljeret arbejdsfunktion og ledelse af hovedaktiviteten inden for restauration.

Dine primære arbejdsopgaver vil inkludere:

  • Daglig ledelse, motivation og vagtplanlægning af et dynamisk og serviceminded team.

  • Sikring af et højt serviceniveau og gæstetilfredshed i særklasse.

  • Økonomistyring, herunder budgetansvar, varelager, svindkontrol og indkøb.

  • Kvalitetssikring af mad, drikkevarer og hygiejnestandarder (egenkontrol).

  • Udvikling af restaurantens koncepter og tiltag i tæt samarbejde med ledelsen i La Viva.

Din profil

Vi forestiller os, at du allerede har erfaring fra restaurationsbranchen og meget gerne i en lignende lederrolle. Vigtigst er dog dit drive, dit værtskab og din evne til at gå forrest som et godt eksempel.

  • Du er udadvendt, smilende og elsker at yde branchens bedste service.

  • Du kan bevare overblikket og træffe hurtige beslutninger, selv når tempoet er højt.

  • Du har en naturlig autoritet og forstår at motivere dine medarbejdere til at yde deres bedste på hver eneste vagt.

  • Du har god forretningsforståelse og stærk sans for købmandskab.

  • Kan tale en eller flere af følgende sprog: Dansk, Engelsk eller Tyrksik.

Vi tilbyder

  • En spændende og udfordrende lederstilling med stor indflydelse på egen arbejdsdag.

  • Et stærkt bagland og en engageret ledelse i La Viva Slagelse ApS, der støtter op om din og restaurantens udvikling.

  • Et dedikeret team af medarbejdere, der glæder sig til at byde deres nye leder velkommen.

  • Løn efter kvalifikationer samt gode personalegoder.

Ansøgning og kontakt

Kan du se dig selv i spidsen for La Viva Køge eller Slagelse? Så send din ansøgning og dit CV til os hurtigst muligt. Vi holder samtaler løbende og ansætter, så snart vi har fundet den helt rette kandidat til jobbet.

Vi får løbende har brug for samme kompetencer i en af vores andre afdelinger i Danmark.

Vi glæder os meget til at høre fra dig!

jobs.title: PhD Research Fellowship in Circular Battery Strategies
jobs.description:
About the position

Center for Research on Digitalization and Sustainability (CREDS), part of Inland School of Business and Social Sciences, University of Inland Norway (INN), invites candidates to apply for a three-year PhD research fellowship. The position is connected to the field of innovation studies with a specific focus on sustainability transitions, circular economy, business model change and value chains related to electric vehicle (EV) batteries in the context of energy storage and mobility. This may include research on the circular resource flows, reuse and recycle strategies, and competing end-of-life pathways for batteries and battery materials. 

Admission to INN's PhD program, Innovation in Services in the Public and Private Sectors (INSEPP), is a condition for employment as a research fellow. The candidate is expected to participate actively in INSEPP’s activities. After commencement, the candidate must apply for admission to the PhD programme within three months. An agreement for admission to the PhD programme must be in place within six months after commencement. 

As a PhD research fellow, you will be an integral part of CREDS and actively contribute to one or both of its research groups. In addition, the candidate will be employed at a department of the Business School. The position preferably commences as soon as possible, and will conclude with the award of the Degree of Doctor upon successfully completing the program. 

The position is based at CREDS in Innlandet Science Park in Kongsvinger. A high degree of on-site presence is expected. 

For further information, please contact: 

  • CREDS Professor Johan Kask, +47 62 43 01 82, johan.kask@inn.no  
  • CREDS Director and Professor Bård Tronvoll, +47 90 78 55 68, bard.tronvoll@inn.no  
  • Head of INSEPP PhD Program Marit Engen, +47 61 28 81 07, marit.engen@inn.no 
About the project

Project overview 

The PhD research fellow will join an international team of researchers at CREDS, Inland School of Business and Social Sciences. We seek a highly motivated candidate to research circular battery strategies and future applications from a business and innovation perspective. CREDS’s overarching academic objective is accelerating research on the transitions enabling sustainable businesses and societies. The primary focus is to understand transitions at the level of ecosystems and markets and at the intersection between digitization and sustainability, for instance linked to new or changed business models, value chains and practices. 

The candidate’s PhD project should address how scarce resources in circular value chains related to energy and mobility are organized and governed across competing end-of-life pathways. Relevant topics include sustainable value creation, reuse and repair strategies, recycling systems, and business models that extend the useful life of batteries and battery materials. The project may examine how such arrangements work in practice, how they develop over time, and how different pathways can be assessed in relation to sustainability, loop extension, efficiency, resilience, and other relevant criteria. It may also focus on market formation, ecosystem dynamics, governance arrangements, power relations, and the role of technology in handling resource tensions across systems, as well as on how firms and other actors develop circular strategies under competing demands, regulatory change, and uncertainty about future resource use. One particularly relevant empirical example is end-of-life EV batteries, where tensions may arise between reusing or repurposing batteries for second-life energy storage and recycling materials back into battery production or other industrial uses. Norway provides a promising context for studying such issues due to its early and extensive adoption of battery-electric vehicles. 

Candidates are encouraged to define their own research design within this theme. This includes developing the specific research questions, theoretical perspective, empirical focus, and methodological approach in dialogue with the supervisory team and the academic environment at CREDS. A broad range of methodological approaches is relevant for the theme, including qualitative case studies, optimization models, system dynamics modelling, and agent-based modelling. Please note that the project may later be modified in accordance with the supervisors’ advice and the academic research agenda of CREDS. The successful candidate will have a primary supervisor among CREDS’ academic staff.

Qualifications
  • The candidate must have a master’s degree and thesis on a relevant topic. Relevant academic backgrounds may include business and management, innovation studies, energy systems, industrial ecology, system dynamics, systems modelling, sustainability transitions, science and technology studies, topic-related forms of engineering, and other related interdisciplinary fields. 
  • The master's degree must normally constitute 120 ECTS credits. INN’s PhD regulations require that the qualifying education includes a master’s thesis of 30 ECTS. As a rule, the average grade at master’s level must be B. 
  • The qualifying degree(s) must be awarded from institutions in Norway, the EU/EEA or Switzerland, or from an international institution accredited by AACSB, AMBA and/or EQUIS. Where applicable, candidates should specify such accreditation in the application.
  • Candidates who have not yet obtained the master’s degree at the time of application may apply. In this case, candidates must have submitted their master’s thesis by the application deadline. Temporary transcripts and the master’s thesis must be submitted with the application. The final diploma must be available by the time of employment. 
  • Candidates with a master’s degree from a university abroad must attach “Recognition of foreign higher education” from NOKUT. Instructions for obtaining this assessment are available from NOKUT, https://hkdir.no/en/foreign-education/education-from-outside-ofnorway/recognition-of-foreign-higher-education-bachelor-master-and-phd . 
  • Since the project is likely to involve extensive empirical research, dialogue with practitioners, meetings, and field-based data collection involving Norwegian and other Nordic actors, the ability to work effectively in Nordic industry and institutional contexts will be important. Relevant professional experience from industry or other practice-based settings in the Nordics, or in a comparable context, is therefore considered a strong merit. 
  • Oral and written English is required. Applicants from non-English speaking countries must document their English proficiency in accordance with the Supplementary Regulations for Admission to the PhD Programme at INN University. A command of a Scandinavian language is a strong merit. 
  • Expertise in relevant ICT software for research is an advantage. 
  • Research experience acquired after completion of the master’s degree is considered an advantage, but is not required. 
  • The candidate must be able to work independently and purposefully, and engage confidently with external actors to carry out empirical fieldwork. The role also requires the ability to collaborate well on academic research and publishing.

Evaluation of candidates for the position will be based on a total assessment of educational background, experience and personal suitability, as well as motivation and other eligibility requirements, as defined in the advertisement. In addition, the following will be emphasized: quality of the project description, documented independent research and development work or experience relevant to the project.

The position and associated tasks must be carried out in accordance with the applicable laws and regulations for government employees, including also the Act on Control of the Export of Strategic Goods, Services and Technology, etc. Candidates who, after assessment of the application and attachments, come into conflict with the criteria in the latter act, will not be able to take up the position at University of Inland Norway. Necessary approvals must be maintained throughout the employment relationship.

How to apply

Relevant applications will be considered by an expert committee. The application and all attachments are to be submitted electronically and must include the following: 

  • The applicant must submit a project proposal with a progress plan (in Norwegian or English, 5-7 pages) that explains how the research work will be carried out and addresses academic relevance, challenges and possibilities within the project. The PhD research fellow hired will, in collaboration with a supervisor, prepare a complete project proposal creating the basis for admission to the PhD program. The project proposal plays an important part in evaluating applicants and must show how the project will lead to a successful completion of a doctoral degree within three years. 
  • Application letter 
  • CV (summarizing education, job positions, and academic work) 
  • Other work that is relevant for the application 
  • Certified copies of transcripts and diplomas for the whole bachelor and master’s degree. An English translation of all education documents is required unless the documents are in Norwegian/Scandinavian. 
  • Names and contact information of at least 2 reference persons. 
  • A copy of the master’s thesis (in PDF)

Attachments must be uploaded as separate files. If the attachments exceed 30 MB, they must be compressed prior to upload. It is the applicant's responsibility to ensure that all attachments are uploaded. Documents submitted after expiry of the deadline will not be considered in the evaluation of your application.

We offer
  • An academically stimulating and supportive work environment at a developing institution. 
  • Possibility of professional development in an exciting academic research environment. 
  • Position is paid and placed in position code PhD candidate 1017 in the Government Salary Scale. 
  • Membership in the Norwegian Public Service Pension, with among other things, good pension and insurance schemes.

For more information about INN University as an employer, please see here.

Video: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=F0FVnszhpJYGeneral information

INN believes that there is strength in inclusion and diversity. We desire employees with different competencies, professional combinations, life experiences and perspectives to contribute to an even better way of solving problems. We will facilitate for employees who need assitance to realise their goals. Relevant adaptations can be, for example, technical aids, adapting furniture or adjusting routines, work tasks and working hours.

jobs.title: Ready to Work Hands-On with Technology Around the World?
jobs.employer: KONGSBERG DEFENCE & AEROSPACE AS AVD KONGSBERG
jobs.description:
Global Test Engineer / Technician – Production test 

We are looking for a technically skilled and independent colleague to support our production sites around the world in testing, test processes, training, and follow-up activities. 

The position involves extensive travel and extended stays at our production sites. The core responsibility is to train and guide local personnel, ensure that testing is carried out in accordance with our procedures, and contribute to consistent, high-quality standards across all locations. 

You will work hands-on with test stations and equipment, provide technical support when issues arise, and ensure that local teams understand both how tests are performed and how the equipment is operated and maintained. 

Key Responsibilities 

  • Travel to production sites worldwide and support local teams in performing tests and following established test processes. 
  • Train and guide operators and technical personnel in test methodologies, operation of test stations, equipment, and software. 
  • Ensure that testing is performed in accordance with established procedures, specifications, and quality requirements. 
  • Support the installation, commissioning, and implementation of test equipment and test processes at new and existing production sites. 
  • Troubleshoot, install, verify, and maintain test stations and associated equipment. 
  • Document faults, deviations, and solutions, and follow up on corrective actions. 
  • Collaborate with central engineering teams and technical specialists when issues require specialized expertise. 
  • Prepare and configure PCs, standardized system images, and test software, and assist with basic network troubleshooting. 
  • Develop and improve test instructions, user manuals, and training materials. 
  • Share experiences and lessons learned from production sites with central testing, development, and engineering teams, contributing to more robust and standardized test setups. 

Qualifications and Requirements  

  • Bachelor’s degree or equivalent technical education in electrical engineering, automation, electronics, mechatronics, control systems, IT, or a related field. Relevant qualification combined with extensive practical experience in production, testing, technical service, or industrial environments may be considered equivalent to higher education. 
  • Good technical understanding of test equipment and production processes, with a systematic approach to troubleshooting. 
  • Familiarity with PCs, software installation, and standardized system configurations, as well as a basic understanding of networking. 
  • Interest in IT/OT systems and how production IT supports testing and manufacturing operations. 
  • Ability to follow technical procedures and quality requirements. 
  • Good written and verbal communication skills in both Norwegian and English. English is the primary working language in our global projects. 
  • To be considered for the position, you must be eligible to obtain a security clearance in accordance with the Norwegian Security Act.

Experience in a production environment, technical testing, or working with test equipment is an advantage, as is previous experience in technical training or travel-based technical support roles. 

You do not need to be an IT/OT or networking specialist. What matters most is that you are comfortable with hands-on troubleshooting and enjoy learning new systems and technologies. 

Personal Qualities 

You have strong communication and training skills, enjoy sharing knowledge, and are able to explain technical processes clearly and effectively. You work independently, take initiative, and approach challenges in a calm, solution-oriented, and methodical way, even when working on your own in the field. With a hands-on and practical approach, you enjoy working directly with technical equipment and solving practical technical challenges. You are structured and organized, follow established procedures, and ensure accurate documentation of your work. You are also adaptable and culturally aware, with the ability to build strong working relationships across different cultures, teams, and locations. As the role involves frequent international travel and extended stays at production sites abroad, you must be comfortable with both. 

Location: Kongsberg. The role involves a significant amount of travel.

What We Offer 

This is a varied and hands-on technical role with extensive international exposure, offering the opportunity to work with test equipment, production processes, and technical solutions across multiple countries. You will play a key role in training colleagues and ensuring consistent testing quality across our global production sites, while working closely with production, testing, IT, and engineering teams. The role also offers excellent opportunities for professional development, as well as the chance to influence and improve testing processes and working methods. 

 

About Us 

Division Missiles & Aerostructures is part of Kongsberg Defence & Aerospace. We develop, assemble, test, and deliver advanced missile systems for naval vessels, coastal defense systems, helicopters, and fighter aircraft. 

Increasing activity and international demand are driving significant growth across our missile business and production organization. Expanding production capacity across locations requires us to develop and transfer critical manufacturing expertise effectively and consistently. 

 

Important Information 

Candidates applying for this position will undergo a background check as part of the recruitment process. The outcome will be considered as part of the overall assessment. 

To be considered for the position, you must be eligible to obtain a security clearance in accordance with the Norwegian Security Act. 

Please note that the recruitment process will continue in January.

jobs.title: Maskinsjef til Pioneer Knutsen
jobs.description:
Knutsen OAS Shipping AS er et fullt integrert rederi med en flåte på 70 skip i drift, og med flere nybygg på vei. Vårt mål er å tilby høykvalitets- og teknisk avanserte fartøy til våre kunder og samarbeidspartnere. Dette gjør oss til et rederi i stadig vekst, og vi ønsker nå å få flere med på laget. Vårt mål er å tilby høykvalitets- og teknisk avanserte fartøy til våre kunder og samarbeidspartnere. Vi har et sterkt fokus på helse, sikkerhet, miljø og kvalitet i hele verdikjeden, noe som også er grunnleggende i virksomheten. 

Til vår minste LNG tanker, som seiler langs norskekysten, ser vi nå etter maskinsjef i fast stilling på Pioneer Knutsen. Vi ser etter deg som har evne og vilje til å jobbe etter våre verdier – Credibility, Innovation and Care. Du har høyt fokus på sikkerhet og miljø, er løsningsorientert, selvdrevet og en lagspiller med gode kommunikasjonsevner.

Søkere vil bli vurdert fortløpende.

  • Engine Room Simulator IMO modellkurs 2.07
  • Assessorkurs
Personlige egenskaper

  • Du kommuniserer tydelig og bygger gode relasjoner, både internt og eksternt

jobs.title: Tapahtumapäällikkö Helsingin sydämeen – Kellotorni etsii tekijää!
jobs.description: Etsimme tapahtumapäällikköä vastaamaan upeiden ja uniikkien tilojemme tilaisuuksista Helsingin päärautatieasemalla. Kellotornissa järjestämme monipuolisia B2B- ja B2C-tapahtumia aina 10 hengen intiimeistä kokouksista 160 hengen istuviin illallisiin ja jopa 300 hengen suuriin cocktail-tilaisuuksiin.Tässä roolissa pääset loistamaan projektinhallinnan ammattilaisena ja varmistamaan, että jokainen tilaisuus on asiakkaallemme ikimuistoinen elämys.**Tehtäväsi ja vastuualueesi**Tapahtumapäällikkönä kannat kokonaisvastuun asiakkaasta ja tilaisuuden onnistuneesta vedosta. Meillä myyntitiimi hoitaa tapahtuman alkumyynnin ja sopii alustavan kulun, minkä jälkeen sinun vastuusi alkaa:· **Asiakkuuden haltuunotto:** Astut kuvaan noin 1–2 viikkoa ennen tapahtumaa. Otat yhteyden asiakkaaseen, käyt läpi kaikki yksityiskohdat huolellisesti ja vahvistat lopulliset järjestelyt.· **Tiimin johtaminen:** Toimit esihenkilönä vuoropäälliköille ja johdat operatiivisia tiimejä (0–12 henkilöä) tapahtuman koosta riippuen.· **Monipuoliset konseptit:** Luotsaat onnistuneesti niin kokouspalvelut, yritystapahtumat, yksityisjuhlat (kuten syntymäpäivät ja privaatit illalliset) kuin Kellotornin omat lennokkaat B2C-tapahtumat (esim. Halloween-bileet).· **Perehdytyksen jälkeen:** haluat myös itse päästä jakamaan Kellotornin ainutlaatuista tarinaa ja elämyksiä asiakkaillemme! Esittelet historiallisia tilojamme ja menukokonaisuuksiamme sekä tarvittaessa johdatat pienryhmiä tornin huipulle ihailemaan Helsingin upeita maisemia ja kuulemaan kiehtovia tarinoita Kellotornin historiasta. Sinulle elämyksellisyys ei ole vain sana, vaan tapa kohdata asiakkaat ja tehdä jokaisesta vierailusta ikimuistoinen.**Mitä odotamme sinulta?**· **Vankkaa tapahtuma- ja ravintola-alan osaamista:** Sinulla on jo vahva kokemus molemmilta aloilta sekä sujuva projektinhallintakyky. Langat pysyvät käsissäsi kiireessäkin.· **Ruoan ja juoman tuntemusta:** Ymmärrät laadukkaan tarjoilun merkityksen osana onnistunutta tapahtumaa ja osaat sparrata asiakasta menuvalinnoissa.· **Esihenkilökokemusta:** Tiedät, miten tiimi motivoidaan ylittämään itsensä, ja sinulla on näyttöä onnistuneesta tiimin johtamisesta.· **Joustavuutta työajoissa:** Kellotorni elää tapahtumien mukaan. Työvuorot sijoittuvat maanantain ja lauantain välille klo 06.30–03.00 välisenä aikana.· Koulutus katsotaan eduksi, mutta ennen kaikkea ratkaisevat aito osaamisesi, asenteesi ja näyttösi alalta.**Tarjoamme sinulle:**· Upean ja täysin uniikin työympäristön historiallisessa maamerkissä.· Mahdollisuuden päästä vaikuttamaan vahvasti Kellotornin omien tapahtumakonseptien kehittämiseen.· Monipuolisen ja vastuullisen työnkuvan, jossa yksikään viikko ei ole samanlainen.· Vakituisen ja kokoaikaisen työsuhteen Kellotornin kanssa._·_ Palkkaus: MaRan TES:in mukaan, kokemuksesi huomioiden, 2900-3500 €/kk + TES-mukaiset lisät.· Etuna tarjotaan vuoden työaikapankki.Rekrytoinnista vastaa Job To Do Oy. Sopimus solmitaan suoraan Kellotornin kanssa.**Kellotorni** on Helsingin päärautatieaseman historiallinen maamerkki, jonka uniikit ja arvokkaat tilat tarjoavat upeat puitteet niin liike-elämän kohtaamisille kuin elämän suurille juhlille. Toimintamme keskiössä ovat korkealaatuiset ravintola-, kokous- ja tapahtumapalvelut. Luomme asiakkaillemme räätälöityjä elämyksiä arjen yläpuolella – kirjaimellisesti Helsingin sydämessä.**Job To Do** on henkilöstöpalveluyritys, joka on erikoistunut tapahtuma- ja ravintola-alan henkilöstötarpeitten täyttämiseen. Tavoitteena on muuttaa henkilöstöpalvelutoimialaa inhimillisemmäksi ja innostavammaksi. Arvojamme ovat joustavuus, ammattitaito, kumppanuus ja turvallisuus. Välitämme ihmisiä, joista välitämme.

jobs.title: Produktionsmedarbejdere til slibe- eller maler afdeling til nat, aften eller fast weekendhold
jobs.description:
Vil du arbejde i en produktion, hvor du bruger kroppen, arbejder med kompositmaterialer og kan se resultatet af dit arbejde hver dag?

Vi søger produktionsmedarbejdere til vores kunde Integris Composites A/S i Vissenbjerg som producerer beskyttelse/paneler til bl.a. køretøjer, de er leverandører til førende virksomheder inden for bl.a. luftfarts- og forsvarsindustrien.

Om jobbet

Som produktionsmedarbejder i slibe eller maler afdelingen får du en praktisk hverdag, hvor du sliber og efterbehandler, eller sprøjtemaler kompositpaneler, så de lever op til virksomhedens kvalitetskrav. Du arbejder med emner i forskellige størrelser og skal sikre, at de er klar til videre produktion.

Du bliver en del af et produktionsteam, hvor kvalitet, stabilitet og godt samarbejde betyder noget. Arbejdet er fysisk aktivt, og du skal derfor trives med at stå op og arbejde gennem størstedelen af dagen.

Dine opgaver

  • Slibe og efterbehandle kompositpaneler

  • Sprøjtemaling af paneler

  • Klargøre og bearbejde emner til videre produktion

  • Udføre kvalitetskontrol af eget arbejde

  • Sikre, at emnerne lever op til de fastlagte kvalitetskrav

  • Løse andre forefaldende produktionsopgaver

Hvad vi tilbyder

Du får en grundig oplæring i arbejdsopgaverne og bliver en del af et team, hvor I hjælper hinanden med at holde produktionen i gang. Der er fokus på oplæring, kvalitet, sikkerhed og et godt samarbejde i hverdagen.

En fastansættelse med en startløn på 175 kr i timen og efter 3 måneder stiger du til 195 kr i timen plus + diverse overenskomstmæssige tillæg, pension og fritvalgskonto. Du får desuden mulighed for både faglig og personlig udvikling i en virksomhed i vækst.

Du bliver en del af en virksomhed med et godt arbejdsmiljø, hvor der er plads til både faglighed, humor og godt samarbejde. Her er der fokus på arbejdsglæde og trivsel i hverdagen og på sociale arrangementer, der styrker sammenholdet gennem året.

Arbejdstider

Vi søger medarbejdere til tre faste hold:

  • Fast nathold: mandag til torsdag, kl. 21.25–06.15

  • Fast aftenhold: mandag til torsdag 13.55-22.25

  • Fast weekendhold: lørdag og søndag, kl. 06.00–18.00

Oplæringen foregår på dag- og aftenhold.

Hvem søger vi?

Vi søger dig, der trives med praktisk arbejde, tydelige opgaver og en hverdag, hvor du kan se, hvad du har nået. Du møder stabilt, tager ansvar for dine opgaver og bidrager til, at teamet kan regne med dig i den daglige drift.

Det er nødvendigt, at du:

  • Trives med fysisk arbejde og gentagne opgaver

  • Har sans for kvalitet og detaljer

  • Arbejder omhyggeligt, følger instruktioner og holder fokus på opgaven

  • Kan arbejde både selvstændigt og sammen med andre

Det er en fordel, hvis du har erfaring fra produktion eller lignende praktisk arbejde. Har du erfaring med slibning, er det en stor fordel, men det er ikke et krav. Vi oplærer dig i opgaverne, hvis du har den rette indstilling og lyst til at lære.

Det vil derudover være en stor fordel hvis du har epoxy bevis, eller som minimum er indstillet på at tage det snarest efter opstart.

Er det dig?

Hvis du kan se dig selv i et praktisk produktionsjob, hvor kvalitet, samarbejde og fysisk arbejde fylder meget, vil vi gerne høre fra dig. Send dit CV via ansøgningsknappen – vi behandler ansøgninger løbende.

Vil du vide mere?

Skriv til Trine Jørgensen på tjo@medarbejderne, eller ring på 44124986, hvis du har spørgsmål til stillingen. 

Vi glæder os til at høre fra dig!

Medarbejderne ApS er et veldrevet vikar-og rekrutteringsfirma, som med baggrund i en sund forretningsfilosofi og høj etisk standard er en stærk aktør på det danske marked. 

Vi har mere end 20 års erfaring med vikar- og rekrutteringsløsninger på alle niveauer og sætter en ære i at skabe kontakt mellem arbejdsgiver og arbejdstager. Medarbejderne ApS er landsdækkende og repræsenteret med kontorer i Horsens, Fredericia, Viborg, Hjørring, Hobro, Odense, Aabenraa, og Ringsted. Vi har ingen ambition om at blive Danmarks største vikar- og rekrutteringsfirma, men om at være det bedste!

Medarbejderne ApS varetager rekrutteringen på vegne af Integris Composites A/S. Vi hjælper virksomheder og kandidater med at finde det rette match gennem vikar- og rekrutteringsløsninger.
